title: Site Supervisor
description:
Site Supervisor (Site Manager/Superintendent)


Site Based – Travel throughout Europe


Please submit your CV in English to be considered.


Who We Are:

We are a Global provider of Installation (M&E), Integration and Fit-out services, specialising in Automation, Robotics, Data Centre and MHE projects. We provide project management services and solutions for eCommerce, Retail, and Intralogistics clients across Europe. Our mission is to empower our customers to excel through innovative, tailored design and installation solutions, driven by our commitment to a Flawless Execution.

About the Role:

We are expanding our teams across Europe and are looking for Site Leads to join us across two disciplines.

Fit-Out / Construction - take responsibility for leading on-site operations across large-scale fit-out and building modification installation projects.

Robotics / Automation – take responsibility for leading on-site operations across large-scale robotics, automation, and warehouse technology projects. Including industrial/warehouse automated solutions.

In this senior, hands-on role, you will coordinate all day-to-day installation activities, manage multi-disciplinary crews and agency labour, and act as the key on-site representative for NPSG. You will support the Project Manager and take the lead in their absence to ensure installation integrity and strict compliance with all construction and safety standards across Europe.

title: Associate Strategy Consultant
description:
Intro

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in banking.

The Evident AI Index forms the basis of our benchmarking products, which help companies to understand their ranking in relation to peers and to accelerate their AI strategy. The Client Delivery team, sitting at the core of Evident’s value proposition to clients, is responsible for delivering bespoke benchmarking analysis to clients and shaping the strategy of our benchmarking products.

Why join us:

  • We are index experts. Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world.

  • We are building a cutting edge research team that uses the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools.

  • We are backed by some of the world’s leading tech investors, including the backers of Revolut and the tech commentator Scott Galloway, and have built a network of advisors that includes the Global AI Lead at AWS, Mastercard’s President of Cyber & Intelligence, Ocado’s former CTO, the former CCO of the Alan Turing Institute, the Chair of the UK Government AI Council and the former Head of the UK Government Office for AI.

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI here. Our commitments to diversity and inclusion are set out at the end of this job description.

The Role

We are seeking sharp, analytical and strategically minded individuals who are interested in working with C-Suite decision makers at the world’s largest financial institutions to shape AI strategies.

As part of our Client Delivery team, you will apply strategic thinking and analytical rigour to support the delivery of bespoke benchmarking analysis to clients (comparing their AI maturity against peers and industry leaders), playing a pivotal role in contributing to the team’s overarching goal of building high levels of client engagement and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Preparing content for clients - leveraging data and insights from the Index, Data and Intelligence teams to produce bespoke analysis for clients

  • Strategic analysis - applying analytical rigour to content preparation by interpreting data, developing insights and identifying strengths and opportunities

  • Subject matter expertise - developing expertise in how AI is used in financial services, including up to date examples of case studies and impact to date

  • Relationship management - supporting client management across the lifecycle: from onboarding, through all deliverables and touchpoints within the year

  • Facilitation - leading recurrent client touchpoints and supporting team members in the presentation of benchmarking content to clients.

  • Product development - support development of existing product set and new offerings by sharing client feedback to support Index evolution

Core Skills

  • 2-3+ years of experience: ideally in strategy consulting, financial services or another role that involved the key responsibilities listed above

  • Proven experience in producing strategic, analytical content for clients through data and insights

  • Ability to proactively identify client needs and opportunities to deliver exceptional value to clients

  • Attention to detail and highly organised: able to support the team in managing multiple clients and deadlines in parallel

  • Collaborative: proven experience of working effectively with a range of cross-functional team members

  • Proactive: you take ownership without being asked

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you communicate concisely and effectively with stakeholders, internally and externally

  • Understanding of AI applications in large-scale organisations, with particular relevance to the Financial Services industry.

If you do not fulfil all requirements in the job description, we encourage you to submit your application nonetheless.

Benefits

  • Share options: we offer all employees share options over a 4 year vesting period

  • Holidays: 28 days of holiday + public bank holidays

  • Flexible working: 3-4 days per week in our Central London office, 1-2 days remote

  • Learning & development budget: £1000/year

  • Pension

  • Private health insurance

Our commitments to diversity and inclusion

  • Evident is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating all forms of discrimination. Our aim is for our workforce to be truly representative of all sections of society and our customers, and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best.

  • During our recruitment process, you will not be discriminated against for any of the following reasons: race (including colour, nationality, ethnic and national origin), age, disability, gender reassignment, being married or in a civil partnership, being pregnant or on maternity leave, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need us to make certain changes (known as reasonable adjustments) to make sure you are not disadvantaged during the recruitment process, you should contact us as soon as possible.

  • We strive to create a working environment free of bullying, harassment, victimisation and discrimination, promote dignity and respect for all, and value and recognise individual differences and the contributions of all staff.

title: Senior Director, Implementations
description:
Overview

Nexcess is building a unified implementation organization to own the customer journey from signed deal through successful go-live across all three business units.

We have implementation and migration resources in place today, but the current model is fragmented, inconsistent, and difficult to measure. The quality and duration of an implementation can vary significantly depending on who owns the project, and our current metrics do not provide a reliable view of how long it actually takes customers to reach value.

The Senior Director of Implementations will inherit the existing implementation and migration teams with an explicit mandate to dismantle the current structure and rebuild it as a single, scalable organization serving all three business units.

This leader will own the full post-sale implementation journey, including migrations, and establish a common implementation standard with distinct delivery motions underneath it. They will determine the appropriate balance between human-led implementation and self-service based on delivery economics, customer complexity, and time-to-value.

This is both an operational and transformational leadership role. The successful candidate will build the organization, establish reliable measurement, implement the tooling and processes required to scale, and create a foundation that can ultimately support a professional services revenue stream.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full post-sale journey from signed deal through successful customer go-live, including customer migrations.
  • Rebuild the existing implementation and migration teams into a single organization serving all three business units.
  • Establish one shared implementation methodology, operating standard, and set of quality expectations across the organization, with distinct delivery motions based on customer and product requirements.
  • Assess the existing team structure and redesign organizational structure, roles, responsibilities, staffing levels, and reporting lines as needed.
  • Build and execute a hiring, leveling, and career development strategy for the implementation organization.
  • Establish reliable measurement and reporting for implementation performance, recognizing that current data and metrics are not sufficiently reliable to inherit.
  • Define and own key performance indicators including time-to-value, migration success rate, implementation duration, and first-90-day churn.
  • Establish trustworthy baseline metrics within the first 90 days and create an ongoing operating cadence around implementation performance.
  • Select, implement, and manage the tooling stack required to operate the function at scale, including PSA, project management, ticketing, and related systems.
  • Define the appropriate threshold between human-led implementation and self-service based on delivery economics, customer complexity, product requirements, and expected customer outcomes.
  • Develop standardized processes for scoping, project kickoff, implementation, migration, escalation, and go-live.
  • Design a fast, customer-friendly sign-off process for complex or high-risk deals, allowing the business to move quickly while identifying situations where implementation risk is genuinely unacceptable.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Architecture, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to ensure commitments made during the sales process can be delivered successfully.
  • Define automation requirements and work with Engineering to prioritize and deliver the automation needed to reduce implementation effort and improve scalability.
  • Influence and drive outcomes through teams outside of direct management, particularly Engineering, Product, and other shared functions.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce implementation costs, improve customer time-to-value, and increase the percentage of implementations that can be delivered through standardized or self-service motions.
  • Establish a consistent executive-level view of implementation capacity, pipeline, delivery risk, customer outcomes, and organizational performance.
  • Develop the business case for evolving implementations from a primarily cost-center function into a professional services revenue stream where the economics and customer value support it.
  • Establish the operating model, pricing considerations, service definitions, and delivery economics necessary to evaluate and potentially build a professional services offering.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Success Looks Like

  • A single, unified implementation organization operates consistently across all three business units.
  • Implementation quality is consistent regardless of which team or individual owns the project.
  • Reliable data exists for implementation duration, time-to-value, migration success, and first-90-day churn.
  • Time-to-value and implementation efficiency improve without sacrificing customer outcomes.
  • The organization has a clear structure, appropriate staffing levels, defined career paths, and a scalable hiring plan.
  • A standardized implementation methodology and operating cadence is adopted across the organization.
  • The tooling stack provides reliable visibility into project status, capacity, risk, and performance.
  • Clear criteria exist for when customers receive human-led implementation versus a self-service experience.
  • Complex deals have a fast, well-defined sign-off process that protects the business without unnecessarily slowing sales.
  • Engineering and other shared teams are effectively engaged in building automation and capabilities defined by the implementation organization.
  • Implementation costs become increasingly predictable and scalable.
  • A credible business case exists for generating professional services revenue from implementation capabilities where appropriate.
  • First-90-day customer outcomes improve, including a reduction in early-life churn.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant leadership experience building, scaling, or rebuilding a professional services, implementation, or migration organization.
  • Experience in hosting, cloud infrastructure, B2B SaaS, or a closely related technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading implementation or professional services delivery for mid-market and enterprise customers.
  • Experience managing organizational transformation, including redesigning teams, processes, operating models, and delivery methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of implementation economics, capacity planning, project delivery, and customer time-to-value.
  • Experience establishing operational metrics and building reliable reporting in an environment where existing data may be incomplete or unreliable.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to understand the economics of implementation and professional services.
  • Experience selecting or implementing PSA, project management, ticketing, or similar operational tooling.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to drive outcomes through teams and leaders outside of their direct organization.
  • Comfortable working closely with Sales and Solutions teams to assess implementation complexity and establish appropriate deal sign-off processes.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Services.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance customer experience, delivery quality, operational efficiency, and commercial outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience transitioning an implementation or professional services organization from a cost center toward a revenue-generating model.
  • Experience designing self-service versus human-led delivery models.
  • Experience leading migrations in cloud, hosting, infrastructure, or SaaS environments.
  • Experience implementing automation or product-led improvements to reduce manual implementation effort.
  • Experience supporting multiple business units, product lines, or delivery motions within a single services organization.
  • Experience with professional services automation (PSA) platforms and project management systems.
  • Experience operating in a PE-backed, acquisitive, or multi-brand technology environment.

Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • While performing the essential duties of the job, the individual is regularly required to speak and hear.
  • While performing the essential duties of the job, the individual is regularly required to use hands for keyboarding, gross manipulation, and fine manipulation.
  • Works at a desk and computer screen for extended periods of time.
  • Works in a traditional climate controlled office environment or from home.
  • Works in a highly stressful environment dealing with a wide variety of challenges, deadlines and diverse employee population.

Disclaimer

This job description is only a summary of the typical functions of the position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all job responsibilities, tasks, or duties. Additional duties and tasks may be assigned as part of the job function. Nexcess reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply this job description in a way that best supports the organizational needs. The job description in no way creates or implies an employment contract. The employment contract remains “at will”.

Equal Employment Opportunity Policy: Nexcess is committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military status, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Food Services Coordinator
description:
Overview:

As a growing 501(c)(3), non-profit organization, CRCI is always looking for new talented individuals who can be an addition to its efforts. It is CRCI’s Management's desire that each person involved with the organization (paid or not paid) has a burden for the lost, the sick, and the suffering. It is also important that all staff recognize that they are a representative of CRCI, and the actions will affect the community's outlook upon it. Staff is a representation of the CRCI program, and it will be expected for them to conduct themselves in a manner that would always promote and elevate the image of CRCI to the community. Any behavior that promotes a negative image of the organization is unacceptable.



Position Summary: The Food Services Coordinator (FSC) is responsible for the full oversight, management, and implementation of all food service operations across CRCI programs. This position ensures that every resident and employee within CRCI receives nutritious meals, maintains all required compliance for food programs, manages inventory and procurement, and oversees resident support within food operations.The FSC will maintain the USDA Food Program, ensure compliance with federal and state food service standards, organize and submit resident rosters to DSS twice monthly through the authorized representative (COO), and oversee a 4-week rotating menu with monthly food ordering. The role also requires excellent leadership skills, a strong focus on safety, and the ability to conduct and enforce safety training within the kitchen environment.


Key Responsibilities:

Food Service Management

  • Oversee all food service operations for every CRCI program and campus.
  • Ensure all CRCI residents and employees are fed daily according to program schedules.
  • Manage and maintain a rotating 4-week menu that meets nutritional, dietary, and program requirements.
  • Adjust menus as needed for special events, holidays, emergencies, or resident health needs.
  • Conduct monthly food orders and maintain strategic inventory to meet program needs.

USDA / DSS / Compliance

  • Maintain the USDA Food Program, including documentation, reporting, and compliance with all federal and state guidelines.
  • Maintain resident rosters for DSS and submit them twice monthly to the COO (authorized representative).
  • Ensure full compliance with all state, federal, and grant-based requirements related to food services, nutrition, safety, and sanitation.
  • Participate in internal and external audits.

Food Sourcing & Procurement

  • Oversee procurement for the Food Services Department, including purchasing, inventory, and vendor/donor relationships.
  • Seek out cost-saving opportunities, donations, and partnerships to reduce expenses while maintaining food quality.
  • Collaborate with other CRCI program kitchens to standardize sourcing, accept shared donations, or coordinate bulk orders.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain accurate inventory records of all food items, supplies, and equipment.
  • Track expiration dates, rotate stock, and minimize waste.
  • Conduct monthly full inventory reviews and maintain usage reports to inform procurement planning.

Resident and staff Supervision & Training

  • Supervise residents assigned to work in the kitchen on a rotating basis.
  • Provide training, mentorship, and skills development in kitchen operations.
  • Ensure residents follow food safety, sanitation, and operational protocols at all times.
  • Collaborate with program staff to maintain a structured, safe, and recovery-supportive work environment.

Safety & Sanitation

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary kitchen environment at all times.
  • Ensure strict compliance with all health department, USDA, and internal CRCI standards.
  • Lead safety training for kitchen residents and staff, including food handling, equipment safety, emergency procedures, and sanitation.
  • Conduct monthly safety audits and enforce corrective actions immediately when needed.

Recurring Responsibilities

  • Daily
  • Ensure preparation and service of all meals for residents and staff.
  • Maintain kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
  • Supervise assigned resident workers.
  • Monitor and rotate food stock.
  • Perform daily inventory checks of essential items.
  • Weekly
  • Maintain and adjust the 4-week rotating menu as needed.
  • Provide weekly coaching and training to residents serving in the kitchen.
  • Implement weekly deep-cleaning tasks and sanitation checklists.
  • Coordinate with other CRCI kitchens and teams to evaluate needs and distribute donations.
  • Monthly
  • Conduct monthly food orders and verify budget alignment.
  • Oversee full inventory review and usage reporting.
  • Complete USDA program reporting, documentation, and compliance tasks.
  • Submit required departmental reports to the Director of Facility Management.
  • Conduct monthly safety training refreshers and safety audits.

title: Admissions Clerk
description:
Overview

The Admissions Clerk is responsible for efficient and courteous registration, transfer, and discharge of patients.

Responsibilities

  • Serves as general receptionist for the hospital, greeting patients and visitors in person or by phone in a courteous manner.
  • Provides general information concerning the hospital and/or patient's condition in accordance with hospital guidelines and secures signatures on documents if required.
  • Operates communication system placing and answering telephone calls, paging or contacting staff, and keeping appropriate records and assists in locating patient's families.
  • Determines patient's needs by admitting to hospital or referring to appropriate facility and escorts patient to proper area or arranges for transportation.
  • Maintains a roster of inpatients by names, bed number, and religious preference, reporting daily on admissions and discharges; maintains elective admission schedule and contacts patients when rooms are available.
  • Prepares all necessary records relating to admission, payment, and discharge of patient.
  • Pulls patient charts, maintains appointment schedules, handles money, retains custody of hospital keys as required.
  • May assist patients in and out of vehicles.
  • Operates various office equipment.
  • Performs cashier duties; e.g. receipts of payment and issuance of receipts.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Minimum Work Experience

  • Experience dealing with the public preferred.
  • Three (3) to six (6) months of on-the-job training required to achieve proficiency in assigned duties and responsibilities.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Ability to operate routine office equipment, including postage meter, typewriter, display terminal and printer, adding machine, copy machine, fax machine, Medifax machine, and communication systems.
  • Ability to type accurately at a minimum of 30 words per minute.
  • Strong customer service and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to interact professionally with patients, visitors, and staff.
  • Basic clerical and office administration skills.
  • Ability to learn and perform assigned duties efficiently following training.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in completing clerical tasks.

title: Mortgage Servicing Representative
description:
Bankers' Bank is a fast-growing, state-chartered financial institution with over $1.5 billion in assets committed to assisting community banks with their payments and financial service needs for over 40 years. In addition to specializing in providing correspondent banking products and services to community banks we also provide bank holding company loans, commercial lending, leasing, secondary mortgage products, cash letter/cash management, investment trading, safekeeping and portfolio accounting, correspondent credit services, international services, bank card products, and risk management solutions. Bankers' Bank has offices in Madison, WI, Des Moines, IA, Chicago, IL, Columbus, OH, and Indianapolis, IN.

Bankers' Bank is seeking an engaging, Mortgage Servicing Representative to join our team in the Mortgage department of our Madison, WI headquarters office. This position services mortgage loan portfolio including answering calls from borrowers and correspondent banks and processing payments for insurance and taxes.

Servicing:

  • Processes payments, payoffs, satisfactions and late notices.

  • Review new loans in MS for accuracy and send new loan packets to borrowers.

Ideal candidates will possess experience providing outstanding professional customer service. Previous banking experience is a plus along with previous experience with mortgage investor balancing.

title: Technician (Opto-mechanical)
description:
Role

Be the hands of the integration team: assemble, align, and test precision optomechanical hardware for Azora's space terminals and ground stations. You will build engineering and flight units, run alignment procedures, and support environmental test campaigns.

Responsibilities

  • Assemble precision optomechanical hardware: optical benches, telescope assemblies, fiber routing, FSM and gimbal subassemblies, and structural elements.

  • Perform optical alignment using autocollimators, interferometers, alignment lasers, and CMM/metrology equipment, following documented procedures.

  • Execute bonding, staking, torquing, and fastener installation to aerospace workmanship standards, with full traceability documentation.

  • Handle, clean, and inspect optical components (mirrors, lenses, fibers, windows) per cleanliness and contamination control protocols.

  • Support environmental testing: vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, and thermal cycling – including fixture setup, instrumentation, and test execution.

  • Maintain cleanroom standards, tool calibration records, and electrostatic discharge (ESD) and foreign object debris (FOD) controls.

  • Red-line and improve assembly procedures; provide manufacturability feedback to design engineers.

  • Support ground station site builds and installations, including occasional travel to remote sites.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years as a mechanical, optical, or aerospace assembly technician, including experience on space flight or other high-reliability hardware.

  • Demonstrated precision assembly skills: small fasteners, torque control, adhesive bonding, and delicate component handling.

  • Experience working in cleanroom environments with contamination control, ESD, and FOD discipline.

  • Ability to read and work from engineering drawings, GD&T callouts, and written procedures.

  • Strong documentation habits (travelers, as-built records, non-conformance reporting).

Preferred

  • Optical alignment experience (telescopes, laser systems, imaging payloads) and familiarity with optical metrology tools.

  • Experience supporting TVAC, vibration, or shock test campaigns.

  • IPC/NASA workmanship certifications (e.g., NASA-STD-8739.x series) or J-STD soldering certification.

  • Fiber optic termination, polishing, or splicing experience.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: Patient Guide — Stewardship Pathway
description:
Patient Guide — Stewardship

Behind every great session, someone made sure the path stays clear.

Oaklin Lane is hiring Patient Guides for our Stewardship Pathway — the people who keep the revenue cycle, authorizations, and credentialing flowing so our clinicians can stay focused on the kids.

On our Lane, you keep things moving

Great therapy doesn’t happen in a vacuum — it happens because the claims are clean, the authorizations are current, the credentialing is in order, and the family isn’t left wondering. At Oaklin Lane, the Stewardship Pathway is the team that holds all of that together. Within this pathway, there are four specializations — you’ll bring the one or two that fit your strengths.

About Oaklin Lane

Oaklin Lane is your neighborhood pediatric therapy clinic — a growing network of purpose-built clinics providing compassionate, expert care to kids from infancy through adolescence. We believe in evidence-backed therapy where hard work feels like play, and progress happens on each kid’s own terms.

What you’ll do

  • Own the financial and operational backbone that lets Oaklin Lane care reach families

  • Keep your part of the revenue cycle clean and moving — claims, authorizations, credentialing, or billing oversight

  • Coordinate with payers, families, clinicians, and other guides professionally and clearly

  • Maintain accurate records in the EMR, billing systems, and payer portals

  • Spot patterns, recommend process improvements, and help build the Stewardship playbook

  • Support the Access Pathway and clinical teams to keep eligibility, authorizations, and documentation on track

Choose your specialization

Within this pathway, you’ll focus on one or two specialty areas based on your strengths and experience. Each specialization is its own lane — and each one is fully supported by the others. When you apply, tell us which one or two you’re drawn to.

Billing

The higher-level eye on revenue cycle integrity. You review unbilled and uncovered charges, run end-of-day billing, audit payer contracts, and handle the escalations.

  • Review unbilled and uncovered charges and resolve them daily

  • Execute end-of-day billing updates and verify accuracy

  • Audit fee schedules and payer contracts for alignment and compliance

  • Handle Level II denials and escalated appeals

  • Investigate intricate billing discrepancies and recommend process fixes

  • Maintain network payer spreadsheets and lead the rollout of revenue cycle tools (e.g., Availity Plus)

  • Schedule · Full-time · Remote or hybrid · No nights or weekends

Claims & Remittance

The day-to-day engine of the revenue cycle. You submit clean claims, process remittances, handle Level I denials, and keep patient billing accurate.

  • File primary and secondary electronic and paper claims

  • Process routine remittances and post payments accurately

  • Manage Level I denials and rejections

  • Address baseline billing errors and submit corrections

  • Oversee patient payment statements, deductibles, and copay configurations

  • Respond to family billing questions clearly and warmly

  • Schedule · Full-time · Remote or hybrid · No nights or weekends

Authorizations

The full-time guardrail on payer authorizations and benefits. You track every auth and re-auth window so a kid’s care is never paused by a paperwork gap.

  • Track payer authorizations, compliance windows, and benefit restrictions across every active family

  • Execute pre-certifications for new and ongoing care

  • Manage re-authorizations and extensions every 3–6 months for specialized insurance

  • Lead appeals for immediate authorization denials to prevent compliance risk

  • Partner with the clinical team to align documentation with authorization requirements

  • Stay ahead of payer policy changes that affect authorization workflows

  • Schedule · Full-time · Remote or hybrid · No nights or weekends

Credentialing & Enrollment

The builder of Oaklin Lane’s payer relationships. You enroll providers, maintain credentialing, and keep network access clean across every entity.

  • Manage provider payer enrollments and insurance network outreach

  • Track in-network status across all Oaklin Lane business entities

  • Update CAQH, state license revalidations, and other credentialing records on schedule

  • Monitor EFT transfers and payer portal access (Availity, TMHP, others)

  • Maintain portal access rules and audit credentials regularly

  • Ensure clinicians maintain valid compliance standards to submit clean billing claims

  • Schedule · Full-time · Remote or hybrid · No nights or weekends

Why this role at Oaklin Lane

A space built for the work. Our clinics are purpose-built from the ground up for pediatric therapy. Designed for how kids actually move, play, and learn.

A team that shows up for each other. We celebrate progress, support each other, and create a place people genuinely want to be. That’s how culture works on our lane.

A pathway to grow. We invest in our clinicians — continued education, mentorship, and real opportunities to deepen your expertise. When you grow, our kids do too.

Work that carries beyond the clinic. Clean systems are how our doors stay open. Every claim, authorization, and credential you steward is one more family that gets to start — and keep — their care on our lane.

Who you are

You are:

  • Organized, persistent, and detail-driven

  • Someone who sees a denial or paperwork snag as a puzzle to solve, not a dead end

  • A calm, professional communicator — whether you’re on the phone with a payer or explaining a statement to a family

  • Comfortable navigating complexity without losing track of the details

  • A team player who keeps the clinical and access teams ahead of issues

You bring:

  • Experience in medical billing, claims, authorizations, credentialing, revenue cycle, or insurance coordination (preferred)

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured processes consistently

  • Comfort communicating with insurance companies and explaining billing clearly to families

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and time-sensitive tasks simultaneously

  • Comfort using EMR systems, payer portals (Availity, TMHP, others), spreadsheets, and basic office software

  • A professional, solutions-oriented communication style

What to expect

  • Subsidized Health Care Plans + Free Vision + Free Dental

  • 401(k) with employer match

  • Paid professional development

  • All equipment and systems provided

  • Mentorship and a clear pathway for career growth

  • Schedule and work location set by specialization — see above

  • Most Stewardship roles are primarily remote with occasional time at our Rockwall or Lake Highlands location

Come see what we are building

The first move is the hardest one — we’ll take you through the rest. If you’re curious, we’d love to start the conversation. Reach out to meet the team or schedule a time to visit the clinic.

Oaklin Lane is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a workplace where every clinician is welcome on our lane.

Learn more about Phillips 66 Total Rewards.

Phillips 66 has more than 140 years of experience in providing the energy that enables people to dream bigger and go farther, faster. title: Program Manager
description:
Program Manager, Data Center Buildout

About ByteBridge

ByteBridge is a widely trusted innovator of IT services, including data center, enterprise IT, and unified communications. The company has gained trust from some of the world's leading international companies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Program Manager, Data Center Buildout to lead the coordination and execution of data center buildouts across Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and Power Delivery systems. This role owns the day-to-day delivery of these workstreams on assigned sites, coordinating contracted labor and ByteBridge field resources to ensure installations are delivered safely, on schedule, and to specification.

The ideal candidate combines working technical knowledge of low voltage, liquid cooling, and power delivery systems with hands-on program management experience, contractor coordination, and the ability to direct both third-party crews and internal field personnel in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.

Work Location

Hybrid — Hayward, CA; Manassas, VA; or Houston, TX, with travel to project sites as needed (~25%, domestic and occasional international)

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the coordination and execution of data center buildouts across Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and Power Delivery from kickoff through commissioning and handoff

  • Coordinate contractors and ByteBridge field resources to manage day-to-day buildout activities on site

  • Maintain buildout schedules, staffing plans, and resource forecasts for assigned workstreams

  • Support contractor relationships, including qualification, RFP/bidding, contract negotiation, contract management, and performance tracking

  • Coordinate with pre-sales engineering, network, service delivery, vendors, and other cross-functional teams to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification

  • Serve as the first point of escalation for buildout issues, schedule delays, and field-level risks while driving mitigation plans

  • Review installation drawings, specifications, and change orders to validate scope and identify dependencies

  • Manage project budgets, purchase orders, cost tracking, vendor invoicing, and change orders

  • Support inspections and regulatory/code compliance for low voltage, cooling, and electrical work

  • Prepare regular program communications, including status dashboards, risk registers, and milestone reporting

  • Drive commissioning readiness and coordinate the transition from buildout to live operations

  • Lead project closeout, including final documentation, punch-list resolution, and stakeholder sign-off

  • Conduct post-buildout reviews and capture lessons learned to improve future program planning and processes

  • Represent ByteBridge in customer meetings, site walks, and delivery reviews

  • Coordinate day-to-day activities with ByteBridge field resources supporting the project

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of program or project management experience in data center buildouts, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale infrastructure environments

  • Experience managing buildout projects involving Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and/or Power Delivery from kickoff through closeout

  • Working knowledge of low voltage systems, liquid cooling infrastructure, including CDUs, RDHx, piping and manifolds, and power delivery/electrical distribution

  • Experience coordinating contractors and internal field resources on active job sites

  • Experience working with contractors and vendors, including RFP/bidding and contract negotiation

  • Ability to manage buildout budgets, cost tracking, and change order processes

  • Proficiency with scheduling and project management tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore, Smartsheet, or similar platforms

  • Ability to read and interpret installation drawings, specifications, and BIM models using Autodesk ACC, Revit, or similar tools

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with field teams and leadership

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred

  • Willingness to travel to project sites as needed (~25%, domestic and occasional international)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential

  • Experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center buildouts for AI or high-density computing environments

  • Familiarity with liquid cooling manufacturers such as NVIDIA, Vertiv, CoolIT Systems, Motivair, and Schneider Electric, as well as low voltage and power delivery vendors

  • Experience directly coordinating internal field technicians alongside contractor crews

  • Background in commissioning processes for mission-critical facilities

title: Network Architect
description:
Role

Define the end-to-end network architecture connecting Azora's space terminals, optical ground stations, and customer delivery points. You will own how data, telemetry, and control flow across a hybrid space-ground network with intermittent, weather-dependent optical links – covering everything from link-layer protocols and ARQ schemes to ground network topology, routing, scheduling, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Architect the end-to-end network: space-to-ground optical links, inter-site terrestrial backhaul, network operations center (NOC) integration, and customer data delivery.

  • Define protocol stacks for optical links operating over fading atmospheric channels, including framing, FEC/interleaving strategy at the network layer, ARQ, and delay/disruption-tolerant networking (DTN) where appropriate.

  • Design site-diversity and handover strategies that exploit multiple ground stations to maximize network availability under cloud cover.

  • Develop network-level scheduling and resource allocation across satellite passes, ground stations, and customer demand.

  • Specify ground segment IT/network infrastructure: routing, VPNs/encryption, QoS, monitoring, and integration with cloud delivery (AWS/Azure ground-station-style interfaces).

  • Define security architecture across the network, including key management and encrypted command/telemetry paths.

  • Produce ICDs and requirements that flow down to software, FPGA, and ground systems teams; support trade studies and customer technical engagements.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

  • 7+ years in network architecture or space communications systems engineering, with at least 2 years on space or satellite programs.

  • Deep knowledge of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, transport protocols over high-latency/lossy links, and performance-enhancing techniques.

  • Experience with space link protocols (CCSDS suite – AOS/USLP, COP-1, CFDP – or equivalent proprietary stacks).

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear architecture documents, ICDs, and requirements.

Preferred

  • Direct experience with optical space-to-ground or inter-satellite links and their availability/fading characteristics.

  • Familiarity with DTN (Bundle Protocol), QUIC, or custom reliable transport over intermittent links.

  • Experience designing ground station networks, teleports, or satellite operations infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of crypto/key management for space systems (e.g., CCSDS SDLS) and relevant security accreditation processes.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
In a nutshell

As a Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes, you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.

You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Based in Hamburg, Germany; you will join a globally distributed team in support of our European Environmental Testing business, with a primary focus on chromatography data processing application.

How can you help us?

You will work on the following main areas:

Strategy & Operational Analysis, to:

  • Assess the EU Environmental Testing market, regulatory expectations, and laboratory operational data to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality improvement, and margin enhancement.
  • Support EU‑focused pricing, client segmentation, and demand modeling to guide product and investment priorities.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance turnaround time (TAT), analytical quality, data reliability, and regulatory alignment.

Product / Requirements Ownership (Chromatography Data System Software), to:

  • Serve as primary liaison between EU laboratory stakeholders and the Product Development team.
  • Elicit, document, and refine Business Requirements, User Requirements, and acceptance criteria (including non‑functional needs like performance and usability).
  • Maintain and update process documentation, including BRD (Business Requirements Document), URD (User Requirements Document), and BPMN (Business Process Model & Notation).
  • Collaborate with Product Development team to translate requirements into functional designs; help groom backlogs and support release scoping.
  • Lead EU‑regional user acceptance testing (UAT), business sign‑off, and change management for new features and workflow updates.

Cross‑Functional Business Support, to:

  • Partner with laboratory directors, technical leads, and product teams across the EU to harmonize chromatography data workflows.
  • Facilitate workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to challenge assumptions, streamline workflows, and improve cross‑site alignment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

Process Optimization & Quality Alignment, to:

  • Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.
  • Ensure alignment with Eurofins Quality System Documents (SOPs, methods, work instructions).
  • Ensure processes, requirements, and software workflows comply with key EU laboratory frameworks, including: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel testing requirements, and EU Member State national accreditation bodies operating under EA (European co‑operation for Accreditation)
  • Support audit preparation, nonconformity resolution, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.
  • Track corrective actions and measure system/process impact post‑deployment.

Data, Reporting & Financial Insight, to:

  • Build dashboards (performance, throughput, error rates, QC metrics, method performance, adoption/usage).
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational reviews with EU‑specific actionable insights.
  • Validate product requirements with data, quantify product value, and measure outcomes.

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

You have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner/Analyst in software, laboratory operations, or scientific environments.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation in an Agile environment (e.g., Jira/Confluence).
  • Familiarity with laboratory informatics such as LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) and CDS (Chromatography Data System).
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills across multi‑cultural EU teams.
  • Working knowledge of EU environmental testing compliance frameworks, including but not limited to: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel requirements, and European Accreditation (EA)
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel (SQL/BI tools a plus).

You are:

  • A strong communicator in English (written/oral).
  • A fast learner.
  • Self-motivated with a can-do attitude.

What else should I know?

The following skills are an advantage:

  • Experience in environmental (chromatography workflows is a plus), food, agroscience or biopharma testing and laboratory operations in EU‑regulated scientific environments.
  • Experience building BPMN workflows and writing functional specifications.
  • Exposure to LIMS, CDS, or scientific data management platforms; understanding of instrument integration.
  • MBA, M.Sc., or advanced scientific/technical degree.

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

title: Senior Shared Tech QA Analyst
description:
CD PROJEKT RED is looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Shared Tech QA Analyst to join our Shared Tech QA function. Shared Tech QA supports studio-wide technologies used across multiple products and teams – covering engine systems, tools, pipelines, and cross-project features. Daily responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive testing and verification of shared engine systems, tools, pipelines, and cross-project features, including performance, stability, integration, and cross-platform checks across multiple teams.

  • Collaborate closely with shared technology developers, tools programmers, technical artists, and downstream project teams to identify, document, and resolve issues – ensuring reliable solutions for studio-wide use.

  • Analyze test results, identify systemic root causes, and provide actionable insights that improve robustness, performance, and adoption of shared technologies.

  • Participate in risk assessments, quality strategy planning, and process improvements, adapting to shifting priorities across multiple projects and platform roadmaps.

  • Create and refine quality reports and dashboards using data/analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to highlight cross-project trends and support strategic decision-making.

  • Contribute to maintaining and improving technical documentation for shared technologies, including test coverage guidelines, known limitations, and QA best practices for broad studio use.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multiple cross-functional teams in a shared services environment.

  • 5+ years of experience as a Tech QA Analyst or in a similar senior technical QA role, ideally supporting internal tools, platforms, pipelines, or shared technologies.

  • Deep understanding of testing methodologies for complex systems, including integration, regression, performance, stress, and long-term stability testing.

  • Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to identify cross-team risks and long-term improvement opportunities.

  • Proven experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, test plans, quality guidelines, and test reports for broad internal use.

  • Ability to mentor, guide, and support other QA team members through knowledge sharing and best practices (no formal people management required).

  • Fluency in English (spoken and written).

  • Passion for games and game development, with a strong sense of ownership over the quality of shared technologies.

Working mode

Perks & Professional Growth

Social Activities & Life in the Office

title: Space Systems Lead
description:
Role

Support the development of Azora's space segment: the flight terminals and supporting avionics that carry our optical communications technology to orbit. You'll work hands-on across system architecture, requirements, and verification as part of a small hardware team.

Responsibilities

  • Own space segment architecture work across the optical terminal, avionics, structures, thermal, power, and interfaces to host spacecraft or bus.

  • Contribute to requirements development and flow-down from mission and link-budget level to subsystem and component specifications.

  • Own the design review cadence (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and the verification and validation program, including environmental qualification (vibration, shock, TVAC, EMC, radiation).

  • Assist with technical interfaces to launch providers, bus manufacturers, and hosted payload partners, including ICD development.

  • Support risk management and parts/materials assurance activities (EEE parts, radiation lot testing) for the flight program.

  • Own assembly, integration, and test (AIT) campaigns and launch site operations; support on-orbit commissioning and anomaly resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Aerospace, Electrical, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related field.

  • Hands-on experience with real flight hardware or flight-like hardware—through research, or industry. We're looking for demonstrated contact with actual systems (built it, tested it, broke it, fixed it).

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals: requirements, budgets (mass, power, link, pointing), V&V planning.

  • Some exposure to environmental qualification or AIT (vibration, shock, TVAC, EMC).

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and take technical ownership of a problem.

Preferred

  • Experience with optical payloads, laser communication terminals, or precision pointing systems in space.

  • Familiarity with smallsat / NewSpace development models and hosted payload integration.

  • Knowledge of radiation effects and mitigation for electronics and optics.

  • Prior startup or small-team experience scaling engineering processes.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for test campaigns and vendor/manufacturing visits.

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. title: Process Optimization Specialist

Current State Process Documentation

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather input and insights on current processes

Root Cause Analysis

Continuous Improvement Initiatives

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze complex processes and determine the best course of action or recommendation

  • Strong project management and organization skills

  • Experience with process mapping and process modeling (iBPMS) tools

  • Experience with Global People and HR process improvement strongly preferred

  • Experience with change management methodologies strongly preferred

  • Experience with Process Mining applications a plus

  • Understanding of low-code and no-code automation and AI capabilities a plus

  • Experience in ServiceNow Human Resources Service Delivery (HRSD) a plus

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills with ability to effectively communicate with employees at all levels

  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities

  • A ‘can do’ attitude towards fast-paced and dynamic situations, challenges, and stakeholders

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

title: Sr. Acquisition Logistician
description:
Overview

Abacus Technology is seeking a Sr. Acquisition Logistician to support the planning, development, implementation and management of a comprehensive, affordable and effective systems support strategy at Wright-Patterson AFB. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in producing or reviewing documents for program office use that support the breadth of acquisition and sustainment logistics efforts.
  • Support the program office during Materiel Solution Analysis, Technology Maturation and Risk Reduction, EMD, Production and Deployment, and Operations and Support phases, to include all milestone activities.
  • Assist with the planning, managing, and coordinating the total cradle-to-grave life cycle logistics support for assigned weapon systems or subsystems, integrating separate functions of supply, maintenance, procurement, and quality assurance into logistics activities required to sustain the system fielding.
  • Assist with monitoring functional and organization compliance with milestones and performance criteria.
  • Assist in the coordination and integration of taskings.
  • Assist in the continuous evaluation of the status and effectiveness of program support in all functional areas to ensure adequate support plans and accurate time phased schedules.
  • Assist in the development of logistics support and maintainability programs or plans as well as systems acquisition requirements analysis.
  • Assist in the management, monitoring, evaluation, and coordination of ILS implementation.

Qualifications

15+ years experience in acquisitions including at least 5 years working in a DoD environment. Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Possess the advanced knowledge, experience and recognized ability to be considered an expert in the technical/professional field, possess the ability to perform tasks and oversee the efforts of junior and journeyman personnel within the technical/professional discipline. Demonstrate advanced knowledge of technical/professional discipline as well as possess a comprehensive understanding and ability to apply associated standards, procedures and practices in their area of expertise. Knowledge of logistics policy and guidance to include Title 10 U.S. Code Section 2466, Limitations on the Performance of Depot-Level Maintenance of Materiel (as amended by the National Defense Authorization Acts [NDAAs]), and all applicable AF systems. Understands the theories and principles of ILS planning, development, and execution sufficient to coordinate and integrate functions into a total, well structured, and viable program. Demonstrate a working knowledge of logistics and maintainability programs to include, but not be limited to, product support RAM-C program test and evaluation planning and execution, technical evaluation and identification of weapon systems logistics requirements and resources. Demonstrate an understanding of budgetary or financial analysis and control and life cycle cost analysis and control. Must be a US citizen and hold a current Secret clearance.

Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Job Summary

Job Title: Systems Engineer
Industry: Technology / Aviation
Job Type: Full-time (Hybrid)
Headquarters: Ottawa, Ontario
Job Level: Technical Level 2
Salary Band: $80,000 to $120,000

About the Job

Searidge Technologies, a global leader and preferred partner for Remote Tower and Digital Airport solutions is currently recruiting for a Systems Engineer who is ready to work in a fast pace, dynamic environment. It is a high-energy position that requires a winning can-do attitude. Reporting to the Vice President of the PMO, the successful candidate will demonstrate superb technical competency, work closely with the Chief Architect and Lead Developers to design and deliver innovative technologies that improve the safety and efficiency of airport operations while ensuring the highest levels of security.

As a System Engineer at Searidge you will be collaborating with a team of experienced engineers who are spearheading innovation and change to be at the forefront of technology in Aviation. We promote a culture of continuous development and improvement to foster growth and opportunity for advancement within our organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with customers and project stakeholders to define, analyze, and refine system requirements and technical specifications.

  • Support the design of logical and physical system architectures, including network layouts and infrastructure configurations.

  • Install, configure, integrate, and test operating systems, application software, virtualization platforms, and system management tools.

  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, networking, and system integration issues during installation, testing, and commissioning.

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Software Developers to support system design, deployment, and validation activities.

  • Support the integration of distributed, containerized, and microservices-based applications.

  • Develop and execute system acceptance test plans and support customer validation activities.

  • Prepare customer-facing technical documentation, including design documents, installation guides, operating procedures, and training materials.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, engineering standards, and technical best practices.

  • Support multiple projects concurrently and provide technical expertise for future business opportunities.

Key Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.

  • 3+ years of experience delivering systems integration or systems engineering projects involving complex, business-critical environments.

  • Strong understanding of systems integration, networking, and software deployment across Linux and Windows environments.

  • Experience in at least two of the following: systems integration, systems design, or systems analysis.

  • Experience translating customer requirements into technical specifications and system designs using systems engineering principles (e.g., V-Model).

  • Experience with virtualization technologies (Proxmox preferred) and containerized environments, including Kubernetes and microservices architectures.

  • Strong networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, switching, routing, firewalls, and network troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark.

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot software, hardware, and system-level issues during deployment and testing.

  • Experience producing customer-facing technical documentation, including design documents, acceptance test plans, and technical training materials.

  • Understanding of software development lifecycles and project management methodologies.

  • Must currently hold or be eligible to obtain Government of Canada security clearance.

  • Excellent analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to travel for multiple weeks, 30 to 40% of the time; mainly within the United States, but occasional travel within Europe, North America, APAC region may be required.

Why Searidge?

Searidge Technologies is an innovative technology company working in the mission critical world of aviation. As a pioneer and global leader in Digital Tower and Advanced Airport solutions, our team is on the forefront of technology and driving change in how aircraft and vehicles in the vicinity of an airport have been traditionally managed.

As a member of the Searidge team, you will be part of exciting industry firsts, encounter challenging problems, be exposed to a variety of internal functions, and encouraged to learn, grow and expand both professionally and personally.

We are an equal opportunity employer offering competitive compensation, a respectful and positive work environment where creative solutions, empowerment, and collaboration to achieve our shared goals are part of our corporate DNA.

Work Hard / Play Hard

  • Catered lunches (lunch club)

  • Birthday Off

  • Fitness Allowance

  • RRSP Matching

  • Carryover vacation

  • Annual Office Retreat

Investing in You

  • Competitive benefits package

  • Telus Health EAP

  • Education budget

At Searidge, we value our people, and we know that a great workplace is about more than just the work, it's about the experience.

The final salary and job level will depend on your experience and qualifications. We know great talent shows up at different points in a career - whether you're earlier in your journey or bring senior-level experience, we encourage you to apply. Depending on fit, the role level may shift accordingly.
