title: Assistant Vice President, Deal and Cash Operations
description:
Our Company

Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,400 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide.

We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.

For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at

The Assistant Vice President on the Deal and Cash Operations team is responsible for private deal investment accounting including recording deal activity, investment lifecycle events, investment proceeds, loan activity, and dispositions into Oaktree’s accounting system. Additional responsibilities include operational activities such as facilitating deal fundings, cash positioning, and hedging.


Scope and Responsibilities

•Translate deal documents into accounting records that accurately reflect deal economics and meet accounting requirements, ensuring timely and accurate entry into Oaktree’s accounting system
•Identify and record investment proceeds (e.g., principal, interest, paydowns, sales) in Oaktree’s accounting system timely and accurately
•Process deal lifecycle events from an investment accounting perspective by booking credit events, reorganizations, amendments, and exits in Oaktree’s accounting system timely and accurately
•Process and account for cash movements through complex legal entity structures, ensuring proper booking in Oaktree’s accounting system
•Work with various stakeholders to fund and close private deal transactions including cash positioning and funding deals within demanding timelines
•Coordinate with and respond to inquiries and requests from investment teams, fund accounting, auditors, custodians, fund administrators, and counterparties
•Stage FX orders to raise cash and to hedge currency risk
•Ensure cash availability for upcoming purchases, redemptions, and other transactions
•Forecast available cash balances
•Monitor for and prevent account overdrafts in various currencies
•Participate in cross-functional initiatives relating to the private deal workflow
•Manage resources, including developing new team members
•Establish SLAs with internal teams to ensure high success rates
•Establish KPIs to measure and continually improve processes
•Identify, measure, and mitigate process risk
•Address daily issues, understanding root causes, and implement process improvements
•Build effective working relationships with internal stakeholders
• Write effective procedures and train others when necessary


Experience Required

•9–11 years of relevant experience at an asset management firm, investment bank, or other financial services company
•Investment Accounting and Operations experience with Alternative Investments including Private Credit, Real Assets, Syndicated Loans, Private Equity, and Asset-Backed Finance
•Processing transactions, credit activity, and accounting entries in Advent Geneva and Global World Investor
•Using Microsoft office suite of applications, with expertise in Excel including data analysis, pivot tables, charts, and formulas
•Utilizing SharePoint, Power BI, SQL and VBA a plus
•Track record of process improvement
•Working with complex fund and deal entity structures
personal attributes

•Collaborative, team-oriented individual with strong sense of integrity and professionalism
•Must have outstanding initiative and be a self-starter
•Demonstrate non-linear thinking and have excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
•Must be able to critically think and independently solve issues and participate in projects for improved efficiency and automation
•Able to work under tight deadlines and high pressure
•Ability to prioritize and manage multiple competing tasks
•Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate in clear and concise manner
•Strong quantitative and analytical skills
•Strong attention to detail

Education

Bachelor’s degree is required.
A Certified Public Accountant (CPA) with private deal experience is strongly preferred.

Base Pay Range: $125,000–$185,000

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

Oaktree is committed to diversity and to equal opportunity employment. Oaktree does not make employment decisions on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, past or present physical or mental disability, HIV status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, veteran status, military service, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic violence victim status or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state and local laws and ordinances. This policy applies to hiring, placement, internal promotions, training, opportunities for advancement, recruitment advertising, transfers, demotions, layoffs, terminations, recruitment advertising, rates of pay and other forms of compensation and all other terms, conditions and privileges of employment. This policy applies to all Oaktree applicants, employees, clients, and contractors. Staff members wishing to report violations or suspected violations of this policy should contact the head of their department or Human Resources.

For positions based in Los Angeles

For those applying for a position in the city of Los Angeles, the firm will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Resident Assistant-Hendersonville
description:
Resident Assistant Position Summary

Residents Assistants are an essential part of our wellness team by providing basic personal assistance to the residents in maintaining their highest level of functional independence and psychosocial wellness under the direction and supervision of a RN or LPN.

About American House

Start here, grow your career. American House offers paid training, clear advancement paths, and the chance to build a meaningful future in senior care—one resident at a time. American House Senior Living Communities has served Seniors for more than 40 years. Our Resident Assistants play a vital role in helping residents live with dignity, comfort, and independence.

Job Summary

As a Resident Assistant (RA) at American House, you will play a critical role supporting seniors, enriching their lives, and helping them live their best life. The meaningful relationships you develop will help you support the daily care needs of the residents and support community activities while creating a safe, warm and welcoming environment.---

What You’ll Do

· Assist residents with Activities of Daily Living (ADLs), including bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, and mobility.

· Monitor residents for changes in condition and report observations to leadership.

· Encourage resident engagement in activities, programs, and social events.

· Follow individualized care plans to ensure high-quality, person-centered care.

· Maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment in resident apartments and common areas.

· Support residents with meals, hydration, and light housekeeping.

· Build positive, respectful relationships with residents, families, and team members.

· Support new resident orientation and help them feel welcome in the community.

Qualifications

· A passion for serving seniors and a compassionate, patient approach.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

· Previous caregiving, senior living, or healthcare experience required.

· Ability to lift, push, or pull up to 25–50 lbs as needed for resident care.

What We Offer

· Competitive pay and shift differentials

· Paid training and ongoing development

· Opportunities for advancement (Medication Tech, Lead Caregiver, Supervisor roles)

· Supportive, mission-driven leadership

· A workplace culture centered on respect, teamwork, and hospitality

· Benefits available for eligible team members (medical, dental, vision, PTO, retirement options)

Why You’ll Love Working at American House

· Your work makes a real difference every day.

· You’ll be part of a welcoming team.

· You’ll help seniors live with purpose, comfort, and joy.

Apply Today

If you’re compassionate, dependable, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to meet you. Join the American House family and help us enrich the lives of those we serve.

#INDLP

Company Overview

Founded in 1979, American House Senior Living Communities’ vision is to provide high-quality housing for senior at a price affordable for retirees and their families. That vision of excellence has endured for nearly 40 years and expanded to serve residents at a number of senior housing communities. Our mission is to enrich the lives of those we serve, providing an environment that fosters meaningful relationships. Our vision is to be an innovative senior housing company that created sustainable excellence and stakeholder value, with an unparalleled commitment to passionate care provided by compassionate people.

title: Product Development & Packaging Designer
description:
Turn product ideas into retail-ready products that look great, are clearly specified, and are ready to manufacture.

We’re looking for a hands-on designer to support the development of consumer products sold through Amazon and other e-commerce channels. You’ll work across product design, packaging, graphics, and production specifications—taking concepts from initial idea through factory-ready execution.

Location: LatAm - Fully Remote


Your Mission: Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Develop new consumer products for Amazon and e-commerce marketplaces.

  • Create packaging designs, layouts, labels, inserts, and product graphics.

  • Build detailed product specifications and production-ready files for manufacturers.

  • Develop specs for home, textile, apparel, and other consumer products.

  • Translate product concepts and references into clear factory instructions.

  • Review samples and make design, color, material, sizing, and construction updates.

  • Prepare and organize artwork, dielines, tech packs, and production files.

  • Collaborate with product development, sourcing, and manufacturing partners.

  • Ensure products and packaging are visually consistent, functional, and e-commerce ready.

Your Toolbox: Skills to be Successful

  • Experience in product development, production design, packaging, or consumer goods.

  • Strong Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop skills.

  • Experience creating packaging artwork and print-ready production files.

  • Ability to create detailed product specifications, tech packs, or factory-ready documentation.

  • Strong understanding of color, typography, layout, materials, and product presentation.

  • Comfortable working with physical products, measurements, samples, and revisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple products simultaneously.

  • Amazon or e-commerce product experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience with home goods, textiles, apparel, accessories, or similar consumer products is a plus.

Why Adaptive Teams?
At Adaptive Teams, we don’t just fill positions – we create pathways to success. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just starting out, we’re here to help you grow, innovate, and make an impact. If you’re looking for exciting opportunities and, a team that’s as passionate as you are, this is the place to be.

What to Expect from Our Application Process?
Once you apply, you’ll receive an email guiding you through the next steps, including an assessment tailored to the role.

After that, we’ll ask you a few brief questions about your experiences and work style—this is your opportunity to showcase what makes you unique and how you approach challenges. Be sure to check your inbox (and your spam folder, just in case) for further instructions.

We understand your time is valuable, so we strive to keep the assessments under 45 minutes whenever possible, though some roles may require a slightly longer time investment.

Once selected, you’ll have the chance to schedule an interview with our team. We aim to make the process as smooth and transparent as possible, so you’ll always know where you stand.

title: Senior Tech Advisor
description:
Join Tsquared as a Senior Tech Advisor!

About Us
Tsquared is a modern MSP focused on cybersecurity advisory and proactive IT support for tech-forward accounting firms and SMBs. We're a small, fully remote team — everyone here communicates directly, takes ownership of their work, and genuinely cares about the clients they serve.

Role Overview
The Senior Tech Advisor sits at the intersection of cybersecurity advisory, client success, and senior technical support. You'll be the trusted advisor our clients rely on — guiding them on security posture and technology decisions — while also serving as the L2 escalation point for our service desk. This isn't a purely advisory role — hands-on technical depth is a must from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary security and technology advisor for a portfolio of tech-forward accounting firms and SMBs

  • Conduct security posture assessments and translate findings into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

  • Guide clients on security policies, MFA enforcement, access controls, and compliance requirements

  • Monitor and respond to security alerts: suspicious logins, email forwarding rules, malware, missing MFA

  • Own day-to-day client relationships — lead meetings, set expectations, manage escalations

  • Serve as the L2 escalation point for the service desk technician

  • Lead and mentor the service desk technician day-to-day

  • Contribute to SOPs, runbooks, and internal documentation

Requirements

  • 3+ years of MSP experience — non-negotiable

  • M365 and Google Workspace admin experience

  • Proven client-facing experience — comfortable owning relationships independently

  • Cybersecurity advisory experience — security posture, policies, client-facing guidance

  • Strong written and verbal English communication

  • Collaborative, team-first mindset

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading or mentoring junior technicians

  • Familiarity with SuperOps, Guardz, Front, Mosyle, or Keeper Security

  • Background working with accounting firms or compliance-sensitive industries

What's in it for you

  • 100% remote

  • Paid time off

  • Compensated local holidays

  • Competitive USD compensation

  • Real opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • A team that has your back

title: Security & Protective Services Instructor
description:

title: Logistics Delivery Coordinator III

title: Director, E-Commerce

title: Patient Eligibility Specialist and Navigator
description:
The Position

  • The Patient Eligibility Specialist and Navigator plays a key role in supporting patients with bleeding disorders by guiding them through the financial aspects of their care. This role ensures that patients understand their insurance coverage, billing statements, and available financial assistance programs. The Patient Eligibility Specialist and Navigator collaborates with clinical staff, billing specialists, and external payers to resolve billing concerns and facilitate a seamless experience for patients and their families.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients with billing and insurance-related questions and medication access issues
  • Explain insurance benefits, coverage, co-pays, prior authorizations, and out-of-pocket costs to patients in a clear and compassionate manner.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of and enroll patients in hemophilia-specific financial resources, including manufacturer co-pay programs, foundation grants, and patient assistance programs
  • Support billing dept responsibilities including claims submissions, payment posting, and other AR activities including insurance follow-up
  • Work closely with the billing team to monitor outstanding patient balances and proactively address potential billing issues.
  • Update and help maintain patient insurance information within our pharmacy and billing software
  • Educate patients on the financial aspects of their care and provide ongoing support throughout the treatment process.
  • Help patients understand billing issues that may interfere with treatment, including prior authorizations, coverage, and eligibility.
  • Coordinate with clinical and pharmacy staff to ensure accurate and timely insurance documentation. Track insurance denials and work with the billing department to support appeals or corrections.
  • Work with clinical and billing teams to analyze denial trends, streamline workflows, and develop patient-facing educational materials on insurance literacy
  • Maintain accurate, confidential records of patient interactions in compliance with HIPAA regulations. Participate in team meetings and collaborate with clinical and administrative staff to improve patient-centered financial services.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, social work, or related field preferred.
  • At least 3 years of experience in a healthcare setting, preferably in billing, insurance coordination, or patient navigation.
  • Knowledge of insurance processes, including Medicaid, Medicare, and commercial payers.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive conversations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Ability to translate complex insurance terminology into language accessible to patients and non-experts
  • Experience with electronic health records (EHR) (NextGen) and billing software preferred.

title: Metal Fabrication Shop Foreman
description:
Pay: $23.00 - $30.00 per hour

Why This Is a Great Opportunity

  • Step into a hands-on leadership role overseeing a busy metal fabrication operation.
  • Lead a skilled shop team while staying involved with cutting-edge CNC, AXYZ, and programmable fabrication equipment.
  • Have a direct impact on production efficiency, quality, safety, and on-time project delivery.
  • Use your fabrication expertise to troubleshoot problems, improve processes, and keep work moving.
  • Join a team offering comprehensive benefits, PTO, and 401(k).

Location: Las Vegas, NV — an on-site shop leadership role for someone who enjoys hands-on fabrication and leading from the floor.

Note: Must have proven metal fabrication experience, experience with programmable and/or CNC and AXYZ fabrication machinery, blueprint-reading ability, and OSHA 30 Certification. Leadership experience as a shop foreman, lead fabricator, supervisor, or similar role is strongly preferred.

About Us

We are an established metal fabrication and roofing organization serving customers with a strong focus on quality, precision, safety, and dependable project execution. Our team combines skilled craftsmanship with modern fabrication technology, and we are looking for a hands-on leader who can help drive our shop forward. Confidential Employer.

Job Description

  • Supervise and coordinate daily metal fabrication shop operations.
  • Lead, assign, and monitor work performed by fabrication shop employees.
  • Plan and prioritize production according to project requirements and deadlines.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, specifications, and fabrication plans.
  • Oversee cutting, forming, bending, punching, drilling, welding, fitting, assembly, and related fabrication processes.
  • Set up, operate, troubleshoot, and oversee programmable, CNC, and AXYZ metal fabrication equipment.
  • Assist with programming, machine setup, tooling, and production adjustments.
  • Troubleshoot equipment, programming, and fabrication issues and determine effective solutions.
  • Ensure materials, measurements, layouts, tolerances, and finished products meet specifications.
  • Inspect work throughout production to maintain high standards for quality and accuracy.
  • Maintain production schedules and ensure projects are completed safely and on time.
  • Monitor material usage, inventory, tooling, and equipment requirements.
  • Train, mentor, and provide direction to shop employees.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, organized, and efficient shop environment.
  • Enforce company safety procedures and applicable OSHA requirements.
  • Coordinate with project managers, estimators, purchasing, field personnel, and other departments.
  • Perform hands-on fabrication and equipment operation when needed.
  • Identify opportunities to improve shop efficiency, production processes, quality, and equipment utilization.

Qualifications

  • Proven metal fabrication experience.
  • Previous shop foreman, lead fabricator, supervisor, or comparable leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of metal fabrication processes and equipment.
  • Experience with programmable and/or CNC and AXYZ metal fabrication machinery.
  • Ability to read blueprints, shop drawings, and fabrication specifications.
  • Ability to work with computerized machine controls and fabrication programs.
  • Strong knowledge of measurements, layouts, tolerances, tooling, and fabrication techniques.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment and production problems.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and production priorities.
  • OSHA 30 Certification required.
  • Ability to work safely in a fabrication shop and lift/move materials up to 50 pounds.

Why You Will Love Working Here

You'll have the opportunity to lead from the shop floor, combining your fabrication expertise with real leadership responsibility. We value people who take ownership, solve problems, develop their teams, and care about doing the job right. You'll also receive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, PTO, and 401(k) benefits.

JPC-1966

Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Retirement plan

title: Event Management Assistant
description:
Working at Yale means contributing to a better tomorrow. Whether you are a current resident of our New Haven-based community, eligible for opportunities through the New Haven Hiring Initiative, or a newcomer, interested in exploring all that Yale has to offer, your talents and contributions are welcome. Discover your opportunities at Yale!

Overview

This position assists the Yale Athletics Event Management Department in meeting its goal of running first-class home athletic events for all our Student-Athletes, Coaches, Visiting Teams, Students, and fans.

title: Cabling Solution Engineer
description:
About the Role

ByteBridge is looking for a Cabling Solution Engineer to support the design, costing and delivery of structured cabling and data center infrastructure solutions.

This role will work closely with the Sales, Pre-Sales, Engineering and Project teams to develop practical and cost-effective cabling solutions for data centers, offices and other critical IT environments.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on knowledge of copper and fiber cabling, with the ability to understand customer requirements, conduct site surveys, prepare technical solutions and support projects through implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct site surveys and gather technical requirements for structured cabling and data center infrastructure projects.

  • Design copper and fiber optic cabling solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions.

  • Prepare cabling layouts, cable schedules, pathway requirements, rack elevations and related technical documentation.

  • Develop Bill of Materials (BOM) and support project costing and quotation preparation.

  • Perform cable quantity take-off based on drawings, layouts and site conditions.

  • Recommend suitable cabling products, components and installation methods.

  • Support solutions involving:

    • Copper structured cabling (Cat6 / Cat6A)

    • Fiber optic cabling (SMF / MMF)

    • High-density fiber solutions

    • Patch panels, fiber panels and connectivity

    • Cabinets and server racks

    • Cable trays, ladder racks and containment

    • Overhead and underfloor cable management

    • Rack-to-rack and network connectivity

  • Review drawings, specifications, tender documents and customer requirements.

  • Prepare technical proposals, solution presentations and scope of work.

  • Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams during customer discussions and tender submissions.

  • Work with vendors and suppliers on product selection, pricing and technical compliance.

  • Coordinate with Project Managers and site teams to ensure the proposed solution can be implemented effectively.

  • Provide technical clarification and troubleshooting support during project execution.

  • Support testing, labeling, documentation and final project handover.

  • Ensure cabling designs and installations follow applicable industry standards and customer requirements.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, IT or related discipline.

  • Around 3–5 years of experience in structured cabling, ICT infrastructure, data center infrastructure or a related field.

  • Good knowledge of copper and fiber optic cabling systems.

  • Familiar with fiber termination, splicing, patching and testing concepts.

  • Understanding of data center racks, network cabinets, cable pathways and cable management systems.

  • Able to interpret floor plans, cabling layouts, rack elevations and technical drawings.

  • Experience preparing BOM, costing, quotations or technical proposals is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with structured cabling standards such as TIA/EIA and ISO/IEC is an advantage.

  • Experience with cabling brands such as Siemon, CommScope, Panduit, Corning, Belden, R&M or equivalent is advantageous.

  • AutoCAD or similar drawing experience would be an advantage.

  • Strong communication and coordination skills.

  • Able to work independently and manage multiple project requirements in a fast-paced environment.

  • Willing to travel or attend project sites when required.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following will have an advantage:

  • Data center white space fit-out

  • Hyperscale or colocation data center projects

  • Structured cabling design and implementation

  • Fiber backbone and high-density fiber deployment

  • Rack & stack projects

  • Tender preparation and technical costing

  • Site survey and solution design

  • Testing and certification of copper/fiber cabling

  • Working with contractors, vendors and data center operators

title: (Intern) Junior Smart City Advisor – Northern Europe
description:
Job Details

Are you ready to embark on a transformative journey at the intersection of smart cities, sustainable urban development, and innovation? Look no further than BABLE – an organization dedicated to accelerating positive change in cities and communities.

As we continue our mission to bridge the gap between the public and private sectors, we're excited to offer an opportunity to join our dynamic team as a Junior Smart City Advisor – Northern Europe, based in Stuttgart, Germany.

About BABLE

BABLE Smart Cities is the Facilitator for Smart Cities in Europe, born as a spin-off from Fraunhofer Research Society. With a decade of experience in the field, we offer practical insights gained by practitioners, for practitioners.

Our mission is to accelerate change in the public and private sectors by providing market access and knowledge. We have already facilitated €2 billion in Smart City projects with cities, towns, and regions. Our free knowledge hub connects innovators and the public sector, providing access to some of the most comprehensive Smart City datasets and insights in Europe.

With a growing presence across Europe, we combine local knowledge with global best practices to implement more projects faster. Join us on the journey to a better urban life!

The Opportunity

We are looking for a motivated and curious Junior Smart City Advisor to join our Northern Europe team in Stuttgart, Germany.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to consultancy and innovation projects across smart cities, sustainable urban development, climate action, energy, mobility, and digital transformation. Working as part of an international and multidisciplinary team, the successful candidate will support projects involving cities, public sector organisations, and innovation ecosystem stakeholders across Northern Europe.

The position provides an excellent opportunity to develop professional expertise in the smart city sector while contributing to projects that help cities and regions address complex urban challenges.

What You Will Do

• Contribute to consultancy projects related to smart cities, sustainable urban development, climate action, energy transition, mobility, and digitalisation.

• Conduct research and analysis on market developments, technology trends, innovative solutions, and urban development topics.

• Support the development of project concepts, strategic recommendations, presentations, reports, and other materials for public and private sector clients.

• Conduct market research and identify relevant technologies, companies, solutions, and innovation trends.

• Support stakeholder engagement activities and collaborate with municipalities, public sector organisations, companies, and other innovation ecosystem actors.

• Contribute to project meetings, workshops, and stakeholder interactions by preparing relevant materials, conducting research, and supporting project activities.

• Assist with the preparation of project deliverables, including reports, presentations, strategic recommendations, and other consultancy materials.

• Take ownership of assigned tasks and contribute ideas and insights to support the successful delivery of projects.

What We Expect from You

We're looking for exceptional individuals who share our passion for sustainable urban development, innovation, and smart cities. If this sounds like you, here's what we're looking for:

A Can-Do Attitude!

Problem-Solving Prowess: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to approach challenges in a structured and solution-oriented way.

Research Wizardry: Excellent research skills and curiosity across areas such as smart cities, technology trends, market developments, urban development, and sustainability.

Tech Savvy: Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Independence: The ability to take initiative, work independently, manage assigned tasks, and contribute effectively within a team.

Communicative Genius: Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international and multidisciplinary environment.

Your Profile

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Smart Cities, Urban Planning, Urban Development, Sustainability, Environmental Engineering, Energy Engineering, Sustainable Mobility, Business, Management, Geography, Public Policy, or another relevant field.

• Relevant practical experience in smart cities, urban development, sustainability, innovation, consulting, or related fields is highly valued.

• A professional level of English, both written and spoken, is required.

• Familiarity with German or any Nordic language would be beneficial for working across the region.

• A strong interest in smart cities, sustainable urban development, innovation, and emerging technologies.

• The ability to understand and connect different topics across technology, sustainability, urban development, and innovation.

• While your academic background and experience matter, what truly excites us is your potential to make an impact. Our team is a vibrant mix of engineers, geographers, economists, policy specialists, and urban planners, all bringing different perspectives to the table.

Why BABLE?

We don't just offer jobs; we provide opportunities for transformation. At BABLE, you'll find:

Global Collaboration: Be part of an international team with over 50 colleagues from diverse backgrounds, all united by English as our working language.

Growth Galore: Grow personally and professionally with training, coaching, and on-the-job support.

Innovation at Your Fingertips: Contribute to a movement that turns visionary ideas into reality.

Hybrid Working Opportunity: Enjoy flexible working hours and hybrid working opportunities.

Time to Recharge: Full-time employees are entitled to annual leave in accordance with local employment regulations.

Tools of the Trade: Receive a laptop and the tech equipment needed to support your work.

Seamless Onboarding: Experience a smooth transition into our team with dedicated buddy support.

Empowered Autonomy: Embrace a flat company structure that provides the autonomy to take ownership and make a meaningful impact.

How to Apply

We are accepting applications on a rolling basis, starting ASAP. Apply by sending your CV and a concise motivation letter.

Tell us your story, your aspirations, and your vision. If you're unsure whether your profile aligns with our expectations, reach out to us. Sometimes, the most exceptional candidates break the mold.

Join Our Inclusive Movement

BABLE Smart Cities proudly champions equal opportunities. We're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that welcomes candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

Your unique perspective is valued here.

title: Product Marketing Manager (AI & Security Solutions)
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a strategic and execution-oriented Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to support the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for our SaaS and AI-enabled products and solutions. In this role, you will deeply understand our customers, market, products, and emerging AI capabilities, and translate that insight into compelling narratives that drive adoption, retention, and recurring revenue. As the first PMM in this newly centralized function, you will design the blueprints for how Landi launches and manages its SaaS and AI-powered solutions globally.

You will work cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Finance, Legal, Communication and Operations to ensure our solutions deliver clear value at every stage of the customer lifecycle.

The Product Marketing Manager has the responsibility to define and support product positioning, messaging and value proposition of our SaaS and AI-enabled offerings. As the Product Marketing Manager in Landi Central the role will be to define go-to-market strategy for new solution launches, features, AI capabilities and external partners integration. He/She will conduct market, competitive and customer research to inform messaging and roadmap decisions, with particular attention to AI use cases, customer value, adoption barriers and evolving market trends.

Responsibilities

  • Build value propositions per segment, market and vertical

  • Cooperate with Product Management to influence product direction and prioritize customer needs

  • Own the Pricing and Packaging lifecycle; Collaborate with Finance and Product to define the subscription models that balance market competitiveness with high-margin SaaS profitability.

  • Enable Sales teams with sales decks, battle cards, demos, pricing narratives and training — and go further than materials: actively push and animate the sales organization around the story through field engagement, deal support, and regular pipeline-facing touchpoints

  • Define and maintain the commercial structure of solutions portfolio (SKU, software bundles, service packages, options and add-ons)

  • Assist in RFP/RFI responses and design tailored commercial offers if required

  • Shape and execute go-to-market strategies

  • Collaborate with Communication team on campaigns that drive pipeline, conversion, retention and expansion

  • Support customer lifecycle marketing including onboarding, adoption, retention, upsell & cross-sell initiatives

  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback to improve product-market fit and messaging

  • Conduct market analysis and competitive intelligence to ensure SaaS profitability

  • Own product marketing for AI-enabled features and solutions, translating AI capabilities into clear customer use cases, business outcomes and differentiated value propositions

  • Partner with Product, Engineering and relevant AI/technology teams to understand AI capabilities, limitations, roadmap and customer requirements, and bring market insights into product planning

  • Develop go-to-market strategies for AI-powered product launches, including target segments, use cases, positioning, messaging, launch plans, adoption programs and success metrics

  • Conduct AI market, competitor and technology trend analysis to identify emerging customer needs, whitespace opportunities and differentiation for Landi's solutions

  • Create AI-focused sales enablement materials such as solution narratives, use-case decks, demos, battle cards, FAQs and objection-handling guides to support customer conversations

  • Support customer education and adoption of AI capabilities by communicating practical use cases, expected business value and responsible-use considerations in clear, non-technical language

  • Work with Legal, Security and Product teams to ensure AI-related product messaging and go-to-market materials accurately reflect data privacy, security, governance and responsible AI considerations

  • Establish and track key performance indicators for AI solution launches, including awareness, adoption, usage, conversion, customer feedback and commercial impact, and use insights to refine positioning and GTM strategy

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in marketing, Business, or a related field

  • At least 4-7 years of experience in product marketing or related roles within a SaaS or B2B software environment

  • Proven track record marketing AI-enabled or intelligent-automation solutions in a B2B/B2B2C SaaS environment, with direct, hands-on involvement in getting deals across the line

  • A track record of pushing and animating a sales organization around a story — in the field with reps and prospects, not just producing collateral from behind a desk

  • Entrepreneurial, high-energy operator profile: comfortable building a function and a narrative from a near-blank page

  • Strong understanding of SaaS business models, pricing, packaging and customer lifecycles

  • Experience launching SaaS products and features to market

  • Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear customer value

  • Proven cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

  • Experience in Atlassian products (JIRA/Confluence) is a plus

  • Strong understanding of AI/GenAI concepts and the ability to translate technical capabilities into customer-centric business value; hands-on technical development experience is not required

  • Experience marketing AI-enabled, data-driven or automation products in a B2B environment is highly desirable

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security and AI governance considerations is an advantage

  • Not required: a payments-hardware, POS-device, or terminal-manufacturing marketing background — this is a software/AI/solutions positioning role, not a hardware product marketing role

Preferred skills

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, familiar with Telecom and/or Payment, FinTech or Financial Services industries

  • Experience with competitive intelligence and win/loss analysis

title: Welding Lead
description:
About the Team

Production is currently seeking an individual with metal and aluminum with welding experience for our Port Orchard, WA manufacturing facility. The Welding team works together with other departments to create, build, assemble and ship products for the commercial construction industry.

About the Role

As a Welding Lead, you will lead the day-to-day execution of production activities for a team of approximately 5–8 employees. You will work under the direction of the Shift Supervisor to ensure work is completed safely, on schedule, to established quality standards, and at expected productivity levels.

You will help maintain the flow of materials and jobs through the welding department, support team members as needed, monitor progress against the production schedule, and address routine production obstacles before they impact delivery.

You will also be involved in processing materials for custom products from CAD drawings and will support continuous improvement efforts designed to improve safety, quality, productivity, and flow. You’ll have a direct hand in accomplishing our #1 goal – a successful project in every way.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the day-to-day execution of production activities for an assigned team of approximately 5–8 employees.
  • Ensure production work is completed safely, on schedule, to established quality standards, and at expected productivity levels.
  • Maintain and use visual production boards to communicate priorities, hourly targets, and progress against the production schedule.
  • Monitor actual production performance versus the plan throughout the shift and take appropriate action when performance falls behind schedule.
  • Assign and balance work among team members based on production priorities, workload, skills, and available resources.
  • Maintain product flow through the welding departments while minimizing unnecessary waiting and work-in-process.
  • Read and interpret production schedules, work orders, drawings, and applicable work instructions.
  • Support the processing of materials for standard and custom products, including work from CAD drawings.
  • Anticipate and address routine production obstacles, including material shortages, equipment issues, quality concerns, staffing gaps, and other issues that may affect production.
  • Escalate safety, quality, equipment, staffing, material, and schedule issues to the Shift Supervisor when they cannot be resolved within established procedures or authority.
  • Inspect and verify material before, during, and after the various processes to ensure quality requirements are met.
  • Identify defects at the source and prevent defective or questionable material from moving to the next process.
  • Coach and assist team members with production processes, quality requirements, safety practices, and standard work.
  • Support cross-training and development of team members to improve flexibility and reduce dependence on individual employees.
  • Maintain accurate production and other required records.
  • Complete required paperwork for inventory purposes.
  • Report defective material, faulty equipment, safety concerns, and other abnormal conditions to the Shift Supervisor promptly.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment and abide by all plant safety regulations and work rules.
  • Participate in continuous improvement activities and help identify opportunities to improve safety, quality, productivity, flow, and workplace organization.
  • Help implement and sustain approved process improvements, standard work, and visual controls.
  • Encourage team members to identify problems and improvement opportunities and provide input on practical solutions.
  • Perform other production-related duties and responsibilities as assigned, consistent with the needs of the operation.

What You Will Need

  • Proven experience in metal fabrication
  • Ability to read and interpret CAD drawings and production schedules.
  • Operating forklift, electric pallet jacks and jib cranes
  • Minor computer experience
  • Understanding of inventory control
  • Able to read measuring tape and basic measuring tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with and lead a team.
  • Reliable transportation, regular attendance and punctuality are critical

What We Offer

· Competitive salary

· Paid time off

· Paid holidays

· Medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance

· 401k with employer match

· Profit sharing

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on tenure, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use a computer. Work will require individual to enter plant areas where performance factors such as heat, noise, dust, lifting of materials, and working around equipment will be encountered.

Tournesol Siteworks provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, Tournesol Siteworks complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

title: Assistant Director of Training & Development
description:
About the role

As the Assistant Director of Training and Development you'll report to the Chief Human Resources Officer, leading staff professional development programs, facilitating our Cultural Intelligence (CQ) and Biblical Diversity workshops, and equipping campus leaders. By blending practical workplace tools with scriptural principles, you'll help our community navigate cultural differences, build stronger working relationships, and live out our shared faith in the workplace.


In this role you'll play a vital part in Bethel’s mission to educate and equip students in a Christ-centered community. As a member of our staff, you serve as a minister of the gospel by helping our employees grow in their careers, build strong leadership skills, and foster a welcoming, culturally intelligent campus environment where everyone can thrive.


This is an in-person role with a salary range of $82,800 to $90,000.


What you'll do


Staff Professional Development – 40%

  • Partner with campus leaders to identify, design, and deliver impactful staff and faculty training programs.
  • Create and run engaging workshops, onboarding programs, and ongoing professional development sessions across various learning formats (in-person, online, asynchronous).
  • Build practical learning tools, guides, and accessible digital resources.
  • Evaluate program effectiveness through feedback and metrics to continuously enhance learning initiatives.


Customer Service and Leadership Development – 25%

  • Design and deliver customer service training that empowers teams to provide excellent, welcoming support across campus.
  • Develop training cohorts and workshops designed to equip supervisors and team leaders.
  • Teach practical workplace skills, including clear communication, conflict resolution, and healthy team management.


Cultural Intelligence and Biblical Diversity Facilitation – 25%

  • Facilitate interactive campus workshops on Cultural Intelligence (CQ) and Biblical Diversity, using scriptural foundations alongside CQ principles to foster strong cross-cultural relationships.
  • Administer individual and team CQ assessments, providing thoughtful debriefs and personal growth plans for staff.


Departmental Support and Strategy – 10%

  • Partner with department leaders to address specific team dynamics and custom training needs.
  • Support campus-wide culture events and strategic HR projects as needed.


Qualifications

Education, Licensure & Experience

  • Required Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, communication, education, leadership or a related degree.
  • Preferred Education
    • Master’s in a related field.
  • Required Experience
    • 5+ years of related experience.
  • Preferred Experience

description:
Title: Editorial Assistant - Internal Only
Specifications: Permanent Full Time

Closing date: 14 Aug 2026

Cochrane is a global, independent network of health practitioners, researchers, patient advocates and others, responding to the challenge of making vast amounts of research evidence useful for informing decisions about health. We do this by synthesising research findings to produce the best available evidence on what can work, what might harm and where more research is needed. Our work is recognised as the international gold standard for high quality, trusted information. Though we are spread out across the globe, our shared passion for health evidence unites us and it is important that the role holder can work effectively and collaboratively with a diverse range of contacts across the world.

Our Central Executive Team supports this work and is divided into four directorates.

This role reports to the Executive Editor and sits within the Central Editorial Team in the EPM Directorate.

Key areas of responsibility include:

  • Supporting the smooth running of the editorial process, including tracking articles and maintaining editorial records.

  • Coordinating the peer review process, including inviting reviewers, monitoring progress, and following up where required

  • Performing quality checks on submitted manuscripts to ensure compliance with editorial policies and procedures.

  • Reviewing articles prior to publication to ensure required statements and information are accurately included.

  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and supporting the implementation of new editorial processes and systems.

The successful candidate is expected to have:

  • Previous experience of providing administrative or editorial support to a team.

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English.

  • The ability to work independently, accurately, and methodically.

  • Strong interpersonal skills together with a proactive and flexible approach to work.

Don’t have every single qualification? We know that some people are less likely to apply for a job unless they are a perfect match. At Cochrane, we’re not looking for “perfect matches.” We’re looking to welcome people to our diverse, inclusive, and passionate workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role but don’t have every single qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. Whether it’s this role or another one, you may be just the right candidate.

Our organization is built on four core values: Collaboration: Underpins every thing we do, locally and globally. Relevant: The right evidence at the right time in the right format. Integrity: Independent and transparent. Quality: Reviewing and improving what we do, maintaining rigour and trust.

You can expect:

  • An opportunity to truly impact health globally

  • A flexible work environment which includes remote-first working (although you will be required to attend in person meetings from time to time, depending on your location and the needs of the role)

Cochrane welcomes applications from a wide range of perspectives, experiences, locations and backgrounds; diversity, equity and inclusion are key to our values. We are a Disability Confident Employer which means that applications from candidates who share they are disabled, and who meet the criteria for the role, will be guaranteed an interview.

Please note that candidates appointed and based in the UK, Denmark or Germany will be offered the advertised salary. Candidates appointed outside of these locations will be offered a local salary aligned to local market rates, which will be confirmed at the point of offer.

title: Field Clinical Specialist - Atlanta
description:
About EBR Systems

At EBR Systems, we're not imagining the future of cardiac care. We're building it. We are the team behind the world's first FDA-approved leadless left ventricular endocardial pacing device for heart failure. It's a breakthrough that's redefining what's possible, and it's just the beginning.

Based in Silicon Valley, we're advancing the WiSE System, a first-of-its-kind device in cardiac rhythm management. Your work here has a direct line to patients whose lives depend on what we build. We hire people who want to solve hard problems and who care about getting it right.

We invest in our people as much as our technology. Expect a collaborative, transparent culture, real career growth in a fast-moving startup, competitive compensation, equity, comprehensive benefits, and generous PTO.

If you want your work to matter, EBR is where you belong.


The Opportunity:

As a Field Clinical Specialist, you will provide comprehensive clinical, technical, and educational support to ensure the safe and effective use of our leadless left ventricular (LV) Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy (CRT) devices. Working closely with physicians, electrophysiology (EP) lab staff, and other healthcare professionals, you will deliver in-depth product training, procedural guidance, and ongoing support. Your expertise and engagement will be instrumental in improving patient outcomes and achieving the company’s strategic goals.


Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
Clinical & Technical Support:

  • Analyze feedback data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities for innovation.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product development to inform product enhancements and future innovations.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Kilo Code
description:
Summary:


We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to lead the evolution of Kilo Code, our flagship VS Code extension with over 5 million downloads processing more than 10 trillion tokens per month. You'll join a 15-person engineering team (average 10+ years of experience) working on one of the most-used AI-assisted coding tools in the world. You'll ship your first PR on day one and have hands-on ownership of high-impact features at the velocity we expect from everyone on this team. You'll set the technical direction that lets the team move faster on everything after, including performance optimization at scale, defining architectural patterns for advanced AI-assisted workflows, and elevating the team's engineering practices while maintaining the velocity and quality our users expect.

What You'll Do:

  • Set technical direction for performance optimization initiatives across startup time, memory footprint, and CLI communication, establishing patterns and instrumentation that the team can leverage
  • Design, build, and ship advanced features including granular auto-approval rules, context optimization, and Smart Apply workflows, then extract the patterns so the team can reuse them
  • Drive cross-team initiatives that span the extension, backend services, and AI infrastructure, translating business priorities into technical roadmaps and breaking down complex problems into shippable increments
  • Mentor engineers on the team through code review, architectural discussions, and pairing sessions, raising the bar for code quality, testing practices, and performance rigor
  • Own end-to-end delivery of high-impact features from technical design through production deployment, including rollout strategy, telemetry design, and post-launch iteration based on user feedback
  • Establish engineering standards for AI coding workflows including context window optimization, token compression strategies, and chat interface patterns that serve 6T+ tokens per month
  • Identify and prioritize technical debt and performance bottlenecks proactively, balancing feature velocity with long-term system health on a mature codebase serving millions
  • Partner with Product and Design to shape roadmap priorities, advocating for technical feasibility and incremental delivery while representing engineering constraints and opportunities
Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:
  • Feature impact: user engagement and performance metrics for high-complexity features you own, including adoption rates, performance benchmarks, and production stability
  • Delivery cadence: your first PR on day one, then a sustained pace of high-complexity features shipped to production, setting the tempo for the team
  • Technical leverage: measurable improvements in team velocity, code quality, or system performance that compound over time through patterns, tooling, or mentorship you introduce
  • Architectural decisions: adoption and success of technical approaches you champion, measured through feature reliability, performance gains, and team consensus
  • Cross-functional influence: successful delivery of initiatives requiring coordination across Product, AI Services, and other engineering teams with clear outcomes and minimal friction
What You Need:
  • 10+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems serving large user bases

  • Deep experience building developer tools, IDE extensions, or similar productivity software with 100K+ users, including performance optimization and scale considerations
  • Expertise in TypeScript and modern JavaScript including asynchronous patterns, event-driven architectures, and Node.js runtime optimization
  • Track record of performance optimization work at scale including profiling, instrumentation, and measurable improvements in startup time, memory usage, or throughput
  • Experience working with AI-assisted coding tools, chat interfaces, or agent-based development workflows, including context window management and LLM integration patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions across teams, mentor other engineers, and elevate engineering practices through code review, documentation, or tooling
  • Strong product sense and ability to partner with non-engineering stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions and tradeoffs
  • Based in and willing to work Eastern TimeZone hours

  • You've set technical direction for developer tools at companies building IDE extensions, AI coding assistants, or productivity platforms, with measurable impact on product quality or team velocity
  • You have deep expertise in performance optimization for high-scale systems, with specific experience profiling and optimizing VS Code extensions, Electron apps, or similar runtime environments
  • You've led cross-functional initiatives in fast-paced startup environments where you balanced technical leadership with hands-on contribution and shipped with minimal process overhead
  • You've mentored engineers through architectural decisions, code review, or technical design, with clear examples of engineers leveling up through your guidance
  • You've contributed to open-source projects as a core maintainer or technical lead, navigating community dynamics while maintaining code quality and project direction
  • You have experience working at AI or data science-focused companies building tools for technical audiences, with deep understanding of developer workflows and pain points
  • You embody our values: 'Curious by Default', 'Build Together', 'Own It', and 'Lead with Guts and Heart', and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish
Why You'll Like Working Here:

  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.

title: Pediatric PT | Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX
description:
Pediatric Physical Therapist — Per Session

Do the work you love, session by session, on a schedule that fits your life.

Oaklin Lane is hiring a pediatric Physical Therapist on a per-session basis at our neighborhood clinic in Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX — a clinician who wants meaningful caseload time without giving up flexibility.

On our Lane, every session counts

You got into physical therapy because you believed in the work — the first independent steps, the stairs finally climbed, the kid who keeps up on the playground for the first time. At Oaklin Lane, we’ve built a place where that belief drives everything: purpose-built gross motor spaces, equipment ready when you arrive, and a team that celebrates every milestone alongside you.

About Oaklin Lane

Oaklin Lane is your neighborhood pediatric therapy clinic — a growing network of purpose-built clinics providing compassionate, expert care to kids from infancy through adolescence. We believe in evidence-backed therapy where hard work feels like play, and progress happens on each kid’s own terms.

At Oaklin Lane, sensory integration is core to how we practice. All clinicians—across speech, occupational, and physical therapy—are expected to incorporate sensory-based techniques into their work with the children we serve. If you don't yet have experience with sensory integration, that's okay: we provide dedicated training and mentorship to help you build these skills and apply them confidently within your discipline.

What you’ll do

  • Provide one-on-one, play-based physical therapy sessions for kids from infancy through adolescence

  • Deliver evidence-based treatment across gross motor development, strength, balance, coordination, and mobility

  • Build treatment plans and goals that meet each kid where they are

  • Document sessions in our EMR with accuracy and care

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately with kids, families, and your interdisciplinary teammates

  • Coordinate care with SLP and OT so every kid gets one connected plan

  • Create a play-based environment where kids are treated like kids first

Why this role at Oaklin Lane

Pay tied to the work itself. You earn $50–$70 per hour — clear, simple, and connected directly to the care you provide.

A schedule that works for you. Per-session means flexibility. Build a caseload that fits your life — whether that’s a few sessions a week or a full schedule.

A space built for the work. Our clinics are purpose-built from the ground up for pediatric therapy. Designed for how kids actually move, play, and learn.

A team that shows up for each other. We celebrate progress, support each other, and create a place people genuinely want to be. That’s how culture works on our lane.

Who you are

You are:

  • Self-motivated and mission-driven

  • Deeply knowledgeable in pediatric gross motor development

  • Someone who meets kids where they are

  • A clear, compassionate communicator

  • A team player who cares as much about the clinicians around you as the kids on your schedule

You bring:

  • Current Texas licensure as a Physical Therapist (PT) in good standing

  • Pediatric experience across gross motor development, strength, balance, coordination, and mobility

  • Comfort using EMR systems and keeping documentation accurate and timely

  • A team-first mindset aligned with Oaklin Lane’s values

What to expect

  • Pay: $50–$70 per hour, based on experience

  • Schedule: Per-session · Flexible caseload built around your availability · Clinic is open 8:00AM to 6:00PM

  • All therapy materials, supplies, and equipment provided

  • A collaborative, interdisciplinary team around you

  • In-person at an Oaklin Lane clinic in Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX

Come see what we are building

The first move is the hardest one — we’ll take you through the rest. If you’re curious, we’d love to start the conversation. Reach out to meet the team or schedule a time to visit the clinic.

Oaklin Lane is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a workplace where every clinician is welcome on our lane.

description:

title: Senior Security Engineer & CISO (Spain)
description:
Senior Security Engineers & CISOs (Spain), we want to hear from you!

About Ledn
Ledn is the leading bitcoin-backed lender dedicated to providing secure, transparent, and efficient digital asset-based solutions. Our mission is to help clients build long-term wealth in hard assets by offering a suite of innovative products, including interest-earning accounts, loans, and trading services. Serving 100+ markets with $11B in loans issued since 2018, Ledn continues to expand its reach, ensuring clients can access reliable financial products wherever they are.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!


The Opportunity:

As a full-time Senior Security Engineer & CISO(Spain), you will be a hands-on, high-ownership individual contributor responsible for strengthening Ledn's product, cloud, and software delivery security. You will find vulnerabilities before attackers do, build controls that prevent entire classes of issues from reaching production, and help engineers ship securely. This is a builder-and-breaker role: you will assess our applications, APIs, AWS environment, Cloudflare edge, and GitHub workflows from an adversary's perspective, then partner with owners to remediate findings and validate the fixes. You will turn lessons from individual issues into practical standards, automation, and measurable improvements.

You'll work closely with Software Engineering, DevOps & Infrastructure, Risk, and Compliance. In a regulated digital-asset environment, you will contribute technical controls, evidence, and incident readiness that support Ledn's security and regulatory obligations

This is a unique, dual-mandate role based in Spain. Alongside the hands-on security engineering work above, you will also serve as the Ledn Spain entity’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), operating within the second line of defense. In that capacity, you will own the local Information Security Framework and ICT Risk Register, report periodically to the Board on information security and ICT risk, and act as the primary point of contact for the CNMV and external auditors on cybersecurity and DORA matters.

About The Role:

Senior Security Engineer Core Responsibilities:

  • Secure Design & Threat Modeling Lead security reviews for new designs and existing features, translating threats into concrete engineering requirements before code reaches production.

  • Penetration Testing Plan and execute hands-on testing of web applications, APIs, mobile-facing services, and infrastructure; document reproducible findings, validate remediation, and coordinate independent assessments where needed.

  • Adversarial Validation Run red-team and purple-team exercises around realistic attack paths, then work with defenders to improve preventive controls, telemetry, detections, and response playbooks.

  • Secure Pull Requests Define a risk-based security standard for pull requests, including review requirements and tuned merge gates for secret scanning, SAST, dependency review, and sensitive-code ownership.

  • Product & API Security Review production code and architecture for vulnerabilities in authentication, authorization, session handling, data protection, and business logic; help teams address root causes rather than isolated symptoms.

  • AWS Security Assess and harden our multi-account AWS environment across IAM, network boundaries, encryption, logging, workload identity, and service configuration, using automation and policy-as-code where practical.

  • Cloudflare Security Review and harden WAF rules, rate limiting, bot controls, DNS and TLS configuration, edge access policies, and change governance without disrupting legitimate client traffic.

  • GitHub & Software Supply Chain Own security governance for repositories and CI workflows, including branch protection, CODEOWNERS, least-privilege tokens, pinned actions, dependency controls, artifact integrity, and guardrails for AI-assisted code.

  • Vulnerability Management Triage findings from internal testing, scanners, third-party assessments, and vulnerability disclosures; set risk-based remediation targets, track issues to closure, retest fixes, and report meaningful trends.

  • Incident Readiness & Security Enablement Support security investigations, tabletop exercises, and post-incident hardening while providing secure patterns, targeted guidance, and security-champion support that help engineering teams move safely at scale.

CISO, Ledn Spain Entity Core Responsibilities:

  • Cybersecurity Framework & Board Reporting Own and oversee the local Information Security Framework and ICT Risk Register; report periodically to the Board on information security and ICT risk; ensure immediate reporting of major incidents to Management and the Board.

  • DORA Governance & Compliance Direct the ICT Risk Management Framework and sign off its annual regulatory report; oversee the annual digital operational resilience testing programme (system and network testing plus BCP/DRP exercises) to confirm resilience against disruption; validate the ICT third-party register for CNMV submission.

  • Regulatory & Audit Liaison Serve as the point of contact for the CNMV and external auditors on information security and DORA matters, in Spanish, including CNMV notification of significant incidents within DORA deadlines.

  • Security Operations Oversight Supervise vulnerability management and day-to-day technical security operations, escalating critical vulnerabilities and driving remediation with the ICT team.

What You Bring To Ledn:

  • 5+ years in security engineering, application or product security, or software/platform engineering with a sustained and demonstrable security focus.

  • Hands-on penetration testing experience across web applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to produce clear, reproducible findings and validate fixes.

  • Production code review skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language, with practical knowledge of authentication, authorization, injection, data exposure, and business-logic risks.

  • Threat modeling and secure design experience that turns ambiguous risks into actionable engineering requirements and defensible architecture decisions.

  • Strong AWS security expertise in multi-account environments, including IAM, networking, KMS, logging and detection services, and workload configuration.

  • Cloudflare or comparable edge-security experience covering WAF, rate limiting, bot management, DNS/TLS, and access controls.

  • GitHub and CI/CD security experience with branch protection, review workflows, repository rules, workflow permissions, token hygiene, and secure automation.

  • Secure SDLC tooling knowledge of SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, secret scanning, container scanning, and how to tune controls so engineers act on the results.

  • Software supply-chain and IaC security including dependency and artifact risks and the ability to review Terraform, Helm, or similar configuration for security gaps.

  • Practical automation skills in Python, Bash, Go, or JavaScript to extend testing, analyze evidence, and build lightweight security tooling.

  • Vulnerability lifecycle ownership from risk-based triage and remediation targets through retesting, closure, and useful metrics.

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated environment where audit trails, evidence quality, data protection, and cross-functional partnership matter.

  • Fluent English and Spanish with the ability to explain a technical finding to an engineer and communicate its business risk to senior stakeholders; required given this role's CNMV and Board-facing responsibilities in Spain.

  • DORA and regulatory governance experience in a European financial-services environment, including ICT risk management frameworks, digital operational resilience testing, ICT third-party registers, and acting as a regulator or Board point of contact; CNMV experience is a strong plus.

  • Must be willing to undergo applicable background checks, in compliance with local laws and regulations, if selected.

Nice to Have:

  • Offensive security depth demonstrated through an OSCP, OSWE, comparable certification, research, responsible disclosures, or a strong practical portfolio.

  • Digital-asset, fintech, or payments security experience, especially with account-takeover, fraud-adjacent, custody, or transaction-integrity threat models.

  • Detection and response engineering experience using cloud telemetry, SIEM tooling, or attack simulation to improve actionable detections and playbooks.

  • Vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty experience triaging researcher reports, managing communication, and coordinating fixes and retests.

  • MiCA familiarity or other EU digital-asset regulatory frameworks, alongside your core DORA expertise.

  • Experience working in GDPR / SOC regulated environments.

Culture Fit:

We're looking for more than technical security expertise — we want an individual who thrives in a startup technology environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:

  • Be adaptable and resilient, with a passion for progress and comfort navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

  • Bring a builder’s mindset and be excited to create, iterate, and scale.

  • Collaborate across functions and cultures, influencing with empathy and clarity.

  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across multiple teams.

A Taste of What We Provide:

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset businesses, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

    • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

    • Ownership in the business. Through shared equity, Ledn staff are stakeholders in the business and the future of the digital economy.

  • We offer every staff member the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for 180 days (subject to restrictions).

  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing accessibility@ledn.io for reasonable accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Vice President, Real Estate Investor Relations
description:
