title: Junior Analyst
description:
Introduction

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI across the sector by creating the most complete, unbiased and transparent public benchmarks of AI capability.

Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in banking.

Why join us:

  • We are index experts. Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world

  • We are building a cutting edge research team that uses the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools

  • We’ve been backed by some of the world’s leading tech investors, including the backers of Revolut and the tech commentator Scott Galloway

  • We’re working with some of the world's largest banks, helping them shape their AI strategies impacting millions of customers

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI. Our commitments to diversity and inclusion are set out at the end of this job description.

The Role

Evident is hiring Junior Analysts to join our Graduate Program. This Program offers outstanding graduates the opportunity to launch their careers in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment at the forefront of AI adoption in financial services. From day one, you’ll gain exposure to the opportunities and challenges that AI presents to some of the world’s largest and most influential financial institutions.

As part of the Program, you’ll develop a strong understanding of how AI is shaping business strategy, operating models, and competitive advantage across the banking sector. Working alongside experienced analysts and industry experts, you’ll build the analytical, research, and communication skills needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving industry.

You’ll also play an active role in producing the analytics and insights that underpin our research, thought leadership, and strategic guidance for clients. Your work will contribute to the globally recognised Evident AI Index, helping to inform how leading financial institutions measure, benchmark, and accelerate their AI capabilities.

Core Skills:

  • 2026 graduate or 0-2 years experience working in research, policy and/or consulting

  • Experience with desktop / qualitative research

  • Quantitative and qualitative analysis skills

  • Proactive, with an eagerness to take on ownership without being asked

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • An interest in technology, digitalisation and/or AI (either professional or personal).

  • Experience in research design - asking insightful questions, formulating hypotheses and conducting rigorous research (e.g. academic research, think tank research, strategy consulting, equity research).

Please note: You must be eligible to work in the UK without visa sponsorship

Nice to have

  • Previous experience with desktop research within AI or Financial Services

  • Experience using analytics software such as Google Sheets, Tableau or other BI tools

  • Experience working on long-term research projects

  • Experience writing content or insights on AI or Financial Services

Benefits

title: Multi-Site Leasing Consultant - DFW
description:
Position Overview

The Multi-Site Leasing Consultant is a high-impact, versatile role responsible for the successful leasing and strategic marketing across multiple residential communities. This professional serves as a tactical troubleshooter, deployed to various assets to drive occupancy, mentor on-site teams, and implement best-in-class leasing practices. The role requires a strategic thinker capable of analyzing market trends and executing tailored sales strategies to maximize rental revenue and ensure operational excellence across diverse geographical areas.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sales & Market Analysis

  • Portfolio Strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive sales and leasing strategies tailored to the unique market conditions of different communities within the assigned region.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct regular competitive analysis, encompassing rental rate benchmarking and competitor marketing tactics, to identify strategic opportunities for revenue growth.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyze internal performance metrics and lead-to-lease conversion rates to identify and address bottlenecks in the sales funnel.

Tactical Leasing & Operations

  • Direct Leasing: Conduct professional property tours at various sites, effectively communicating each community’s unique value proposition and amenities to prospective residents.
  • Application Processing: Accurately process rental applications, perform background checks, and prepare lease documentation in strict compliance with Fair Housing laws and company policies.
  • Asset Presentation: Verify that communities meet brand expectations, including curb appeal and the market-readiness of vacant units, implementing corrective action plans as required.

Mentorship & Team Development

  • Peer Leadership: Serve as a leader and mentor to on-site leasing teams, providing hands-on coaching in advanced sales techniques and telephone sales protocols.
  • Standardization: Ensure the consistent application of company Standardized Operating Procedures (SOPs) and best practices across all visited sites.
  • Training Support: Assist in developing and delivering training materials that can be leveraged to provide continuous professional development to team members.

Resident Relations & Retention

  • Strategic Retention: Participate in the planning and execution of resident events and retention programs designed to maximize lease renewals and satisfaction scores.
  • Conflict Resolution: Professionally manage complex resident inquiries and concerns, ensuring prompt and satisfactory resolutions that uphold high service standards.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Occupancy Rate: Achievement of budgeted occupancy targets across the assigned multi-site portfolio.
  • Lease Conversion Rate: Maintain a lead-to-lease conversion rate aligned with the top 10% of industry standards.
  • Resident Retention: Achieve and maintain an average annual resident retention rate of 50% or higher.
  • Shop Scores: Attain quarterly mystery shop scores of 90% or higher.
  • Portfolio Leasing Velocity: Produce a consistent volume of new leases as required to meet stabilization or occupancy goals at target assets.

title: Head of Partnerships
description:

You’ll own our creator, streamer, influencer and brand partnership strategy, building the channel from the ground up and driving both acquisition and long-term brand value. You’ll manage the partnerships budget end to end and be accountable for commercial performance, from sourcing and negotiating deals through to execution and measuring return.

  • Own the partnerships budget end to end — allocation across partners and deal types, pacing, and accountability for the return on every USD committed

  • Forecast and model channel performance: build the business case for each deal before it is signed, and the forecast the wider marketing plan relies on

  • Own ROAS calculation and reporting for the channel, working to the same payback and CAC standards as every other channel

  • Own the partnerships contribution to FTPs, CAC and payback

  • Build the creator, streamer and influencer programme from a handful of early relationships into a repeatable acquisition channel

  • Source, negotiate and close five- and seven-figure brand partnership, sponsorship and co-marketing deals with corporations and media owners

  • Build a qualified pipeline of larger-scale opportunities and manage it to a predictable close rate

  • Own commercial terms end to end: deal structures, rate negotiation, contracting with Legal, and performance management of live partnerships

  • Line-manage and develop the Partnerships & Community Executive

  • Build the commercial playbook: deal structures, approval thresholds, partner onboarding, performance review cadence

  • Represent Xcite at industry events and build the partner network

  • Work with Creative on partner-facing assets and co-branded campaigns, and with Marketing Insights on channel attribution

  • Use AI tooling for partner prospecting and qualification, outreach personalisation at scale, and deal and cohort analysis. Contribute partner-facing use cases to the wider marketing toolset.


What we are looking for

  • A strong track record of building creator, influencer or brand partnership programmes, ideally within iGaming with a focus on social casino/sweepstakes, or within an adjacent consumer vertical.

  • Experience working with the US market.

  • Demonstrable experience sourcing, negotiating and closing five- to seven-figure commercial deals.

  • Strong business development instincts, with the ability to proactively open doors, build relationships and create a pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluency in CPA, revenue share, flat-fee and hybrid deal structures, with the commercial judgement to determine which model works best for each opportunity.

  • Flexibility around working hours, as US-focused creators, streamers and partners may occasionally require availability outside standard working hours.

  • Comfortable building a function and processes from the ground up, without an established playbook.

Nice to have

  • Existing relationships within the gaming creator and streamer ecosystem.

  • Experience working with talent agencies, MCNs and creator management networks.

  • Community-led growth experience, particularly through Discord.

  • Experience taking a partnerships function from an ad hoc approach to a structured and scalable channel.

  • Affiliate marketing background.

title: GTM Strategy, Planning & Operations Lead
description:
Position Overview

The GTM Strategy, Planning & Operations Lead owns the strategy, planning, and operating rhythm behind the go-to-market engine. This role frames and drives the company's most important GTM questions, owns revenue forecasting and unit economics modeling, runs the operating cadence that keeps the revenue organization on plan, and owns the New Year Readiness process end to end.

In an AI infrastructure environment, this role is especially focused on translating strategy into capacity, coverage, and targets, blending recurring revenue forecasting with usage-driven economics, and bringing planning discipline to a business growing faster than its processes.

This is a central role rather than a business-partner role: the Lead designs the global processes that serve the entire revenue organization. It reports to the Head of Revenue Operations with cross-functional partnership across Finance, HR, Sales leadership, and the broader leadership team. It is a senior individual contributor role focused on ownership and influence rather than direct management.


Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Executive Decision Support

  • Structure and break down complex, ambiguous GTM problems, develop hypotheses, drive the analysis, and deliver clear recommendations
  • Build high-quality, executive-ready deliverables that turn data into decisions the CRO and Head of RevOps can act on
  • Serve as a thought partner to revenue leadership on segmentation, coverage, pricing direction, investment tradeoffs, and growth strategy
  • Lead special projects that are top of mind for the RevOps team, moving from strategy through execution as the work requires

Revenue Forecasting and Planning

  • Own weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue forecasts, including rolling forecasts, scenario analysis, and variance reporting
  • Build and maintain driver-based models using HubSpot pipeline data, historical performance, cohort trends, and sales productivity assumptions
  • Forecast across contract revenue, recurring subscriptions, and usage-based revenue streams
  • Deliver actionable insights on forecast risk, pipeline quality, conversion trends, and revenue attainment
  • Partner with the CRO and Head of RevOps on board-level forecast commitments and scenario planning

Unit Economics and Portfolio Analysis

  • Build and maintain models for CAC, LTV, payback, retention, expansion, and overall sales efficiency at the cohort and portfolio level
  • Analyze segment performance, customer cohort behavior, and revenue mix trends
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analysis on headcount, capacity, and investment decisions to support executive and board planning
  • Translate unit economics into actionable insights on GTM investment, segment prioritization, and growth quality

Operating Cadence and Fiscal Planning

  • Design, build, and run the GTM operating rhythm, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, big deal reviews, and monthly and quarterly business reviews
  • Own the annual New Year Readiness process end to end: the cross-functional program that ensures the revenue organization is ready to sell on day one of the new fiscal period. This includes target setting, territory design, quota assignment, comp plan readiness, headcount and capacity alignment, systems and data readiness, and sales kickoff planning, coordinated across Sales, Finance, HR, and the systems teams
  • Drive the annual and in-year planning cycles, connecting strategy to targets to territory and quota
  • Establish the metrics, dashboards, and reporting that give leadership a single, trusted view of revenue performance

Revenue Performance Reporting

  • Produce executive-ready reporting on revenue performance, forecast accuracy, and sales productivity
  • Assemble the revenue reporting layer and translate financial and operational data into clear business narratives for the CRO, Head of RevOps, and executive team
  • Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, and Product on data quality and decision support
  • Help establish a scalable reporting foundation across CRM, BI, and finance systems

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and the technical teams to improve efficiency and effectiveness across the revenue organization
  • Partner with the data and systems teams to ensure data accuracy, availability, and the systematic implementation of new processes
  • Partner with Finance on target setting, capacity planning, and the annual planning cycle
  • Partner with Sales leadership on territory design, quota setting, and coverage model decisions


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in revenue operations, strategy, business operations, or FP&A at a high-growth technology company
  • Experience in cloud, AI infrastructure, or technology environments strongly preferred
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; strong SQL and Tableau or Power BI proficiency
  • Experience working with HubSpot or a comparable CRM
  • Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver executive-ready recommendations
  • Experience owning or running a GTM operating cadence (forecasting, pipeline reviews, QBRs) and a fiscal planning cycle
  • Experience with territory design, quota setting, and capacity or headcount planning for GTM teams
  • Exceptional project management skills, with a track record leading complex cross-functional initiatives

title: Product Manager
description:
Introduction

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI across the sector by creating the most complete, unbiased, and transparent benchmarks of AI capability.

Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in financial services. We now have an evolving suite of products that power strategic decision-making for the world's largest institutions.

Why join us

  • We are index experts: Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world.

  • We are building a cutting-edge research team: We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools.

  • World-class backing: We've been backed by some of the world's leading tech investors, including the backers of Revolut and the tech commentator Scott Galloway.

  • Market Impact: We're working with some of the world's largest banks, helping them shape their AI strategies impacting millions of customers.

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI.

The Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented Product Manager to support the execution of our Index and Intelligence product roadmap. Reporting into a Senior Product Manager, you'll take ownership of the day-to-day delivery of product initiatives, from writing clear specs and acceptance criteria through to QA and monitoring how features perform after launch.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Engineering, Data, Index, Intelligence and Design, and with our client-facing teams, and you'll be the person making sure that what we build is well-scoped, properly tested, and grounded in what our clients are actually telling us.

Key Responsibilities

1. Delivery & Execution

  • Support the timeline and project management of Index and Intelligence product launches, coordinating across Marketing, Engineering, Data, Index, Intelligence and Design to keep delivery on track.

  • Flag risks and dependencies early, and keep the Senior Product Manager and wider team updated on progress.

2. Specs, QA & Release Quality

  • Write detailed specs and acceptance criteria from a Senior Product Manager's direction, translating strategic decisions into requirements the team can build against.

  • Own QA ahead of releases, testing against acceptance criteria and catching issues before they reach clients.

  • Manage and quality check the data files made available on the Member Hub at each Index launch, ensuring accuracy before they go live.

3. Client Feedback, Metrics & Market Insight

  • Triage inbound feedback from Client Delivery and Business Development into bugs, feature requests and training issues, turning it into clear, structured input for the roadmap.

  • Monitor basic product metrics, such as feature adoption and monthly active users, and flag meaningful changes worth investigating.

  • Carry out light competitive and market scanning to feed the team's research, surfacing what's relevant to explore for our roadmap.

Core Skills

  • Execution & Organisation: A track record of managing multiple moving parts and deadlines without losing sight of detail.

  • Structured Thinking: Comfortable turning a senior PM's direction into clear, specific requirements that engineering and design can build against.

  • Attention to detail: A meticulous eye, comfortable being the last check before something reaches a client.

  • Clear Communication: Able to adapt communication styles for technical and non-technical departments at all levels.

  • High-impact collaboration: Proactive about chasing dependencies and closing loops across teams, so nothing stalls waiting on someone else's input.

  • Curiosity & Ownership: Proactive about spotting issues and asking the right questions, and confident taking ownership of a task once pointed in the right direction.

Benefits

  • Share options: We offer all employees share options over a 4 year vesting period.

  • Holidays: 28 days of holiday + public bank holidays

  • Flexible working: minimum 3 days per week in our Central London office

  • Learning & development budget: £1000/year

  • Pension & Private Health Insurance

Our commitments to diversity and inclusion

Evident is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating all forms of discrimination. Our aim is for our workforce to be truly representative of all sections of society and our customers, and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best.

During our recruitment process, you will not be discriminated against for any protected characteristics. If you need us to make certain changes (known as reasonable adjustments) to make sure you are not disadvantaged during the recruitment process, you should contact us as soon as possible.

title: Director, Channel Development (Managed Cloud)
description:
Overview


The Director, Channel Development will build and scale the Managed Cloud partner program from the ground up, with a focus on generating measurable new-logo revenue through resellers, referral partners, MSPs, and other strategic partners. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for a proven channel leader who has successfully built a partner program from the ground up and can demonstrate measurable revenue results. The Director will own the partner lifecycle, from prospecting and recruitment through onboarding, enablement, co-selling, and ongoing growth. With no existing team or year-one headcount, the Director will be responsible for establishing the strategy, building the pipeline, developing partner relationships, and creating the processes needed to scale the function. The role will work closely with Sales and cross-functional leadership and will have significant autonomy to build and execute the channel strategy.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a channel strategy aligned with Managed Cloud business objectives, revenue targets, customer segments, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Design and launch the initial partner program, including partner segmentation, program tiers, eligibility criteria, engagement models, referral and margin structures, and onboarding requirements.
  • Establish scalable processes, documentation, tools, and operating standards for partner recruitment, activation, opportunity management, and ongoing engagement.
  • Monitor market and competitive trends to identify opportunities for new partner relationships and channel growth.
  • Identify, prospect, qualify, and recruit resellers, referral partners, MSPs, VARs, digital agencies, and other organizations with the potential to generate qualified business opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with prospective partners through outbound prospecting, networking, industry events, referrals, and other appropriate business-development activities.
  • Manage the partner lifecycle from initial engagement through qualification, commercial negotiation, agreement execution, onboarding, opportunity development, and ongoing growth.
  • Evaluate partner performance and engagement and recommend adjustments to partner investment, support, or program participation based on business results and strategic value.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key partner stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Develop qualified partner-sourced pipeline and convert partner opportunities into new-logo revenue.
  • Work directly with partner representatives and their customers to support opportunity development, solution positioning, presentations, and sales activities.
  • Collaborate with internal Sales and other business functions to ensure appropriate ownership, opportunity management, forecasting, and sales-crediting practices.
  • Support partners through their initial sales opportunities and develop the capabilities necessary for partners to independently generate and progress opportunities.
  • Monitor partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, conversion, and other agreed performance indicators and provide regular reporting to Sales leadership.
  • Develop and maintain partner-facing enablement materials, including presentations, battlecards, pricing resources, product information, demo materials, technical resources, and onboarding documentation.
  • Deliver partner training and enablement sessions as appropriate.
  • Work with internal subject-matter experts to ensure partner materials and training accurately represent the company's products, services, pricing, and capabilities.
  • Identify recurring partner questions, obstacles, and enablement gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Support, and other functions to establish effective processes for channel development and partner management.
  • Provide feedback from partners and prospective partners to help identify opportunities to improve products, services, messaging, pricing, and the overall customer experience.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Sales leadership regarding partner economics, revenue attribution, forecasting, and performance reporting.
  • Work with Legal and other appropriate stakeholders to ensure partner agreements and program structures follow established company requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely partner information, opportunities, activities, and forecasts in the company's designated CRM and business systems.
  • Establish a regular operating cadence for partner pipeline reviews, performance reporting, and program optimization.
  • Analyze channel performance and use data to prioritize partner recruitment, development, and resource allocation.
  • Provide regular updates to Sales leadership regarding channel pipeline, revenue performance, partner activity, risks, and opportunities.
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned based on organizational and business needs.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured primarily by partner-generated revenue, partner engagement, and sustainable channel growth. Performance targets are intended to establish initial expectations for the role and may be adjusted based on business conditions, available resources, market opportunity, and the development of the channel program.

  • Revenue: Achieve $100K in partner-sourced MRR within the first 12 months.
  • Partner Growth: Establish a qualified partner pipeline and onboard up to 10 strategic partners within the first 90 days, with at least 60% becoming active.
  • Program Launch: Launch the initial partner program, including strategy, structure, onboarding, and enablement, within 60 days.
  • Partner Performance: Develop a sustainable base of repeat-producing partners, with at least 40% of activated partners generating two or more closed deals by the end of year one.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in channel sales, partner development, alliances, business development, or a related field.
  • Proven ability to build and scale partner programs that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.
  • Track record of personally carrying and achieving a revenue quota or comparable sales responsibility.
  • Established relationships or demonstrated ability to develop relationships within the MSP, VAR, agency, IT services, hosting, cloud, or related ecosystem.
  • Strong knowledge of partner-led sales models, including referral, reseller, and white-label programs.
  • Experience with partner recruitment, commercial negotiations, enablement, and program development.
  • Technical understanding of hosting, cloud infrastructure, web technologies, or related platforms.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, build structure, and execute in a developing business function.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 10–20% as business needs require, including partner meetings, conferences, and industry events.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in managed hosting, cloud infrastructure, WordPress, web/eCommerce technology, or a related industry.
  • Familiarity with partner economics, tier structures, incentive programs, and referral models.
  • Proficiency with CRM and channel-management tools.
  • Experience building programs in a high-growth or entrepreneurial environment.


Physical Demands & Work Environment


The physical demands and work environment characteristics described below are representative of those that may be encountered while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.

  • The position requires regular use of a computer, keyboard, and other standard office equipment.
  • The individual may be required to remain in a stationary position and work at a desk or computer for extended periods.
  • The position may be performed in a climate-controlled office environment or an approved remote work environment.
  • The role involves managing multiple priorities, responding to evolving business needs, and meeting time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Occasional movement of office materials or equipment weighing up to 15 pounds may be required.

You will help maintain the flow of materials and jobs through the grinding, prep and powder departments, support team members as needed, monitor progress against the production schedule, and address routine production obstacles before they impact delivery.

  • Coach and assist team members with production processes, quality requirements, safety practices, and standard work.
  • Support cross-training and development of team members to improve flexibility and reduce dependence on individual employees.
  • Maintain accurate production and other required records.

  • Report defective material, faulty equipment, safety concerns, and other abnormal conditions to the Shift Supervisor promptly.

  • Show up for team huddles, case discussions, and learning moments

  • Keep growing your craft through continued education and professional development

  • Create a play-based environment where kids are treated like kids first

Why this role at Oaklin Lane

A space built for the work. Our clinics are purpose-built from the ground up for pediatric therapy — feeding rooms included. Designed for how kids actually eat, explore, and learn.

A team that shows up for each other. We celebrate progress, support each other, and create a place people genuinely want to be. That’s how culture works on our lane.

A pathway to grow. We invest in our clinicians — continued education, mentorship, and real opportunities to deepen your expertise. When you grow, our kids do too.

Work that carries beyond the clinic. Oaklin Lane is expanding access to pediatric therapy across a growing network of neighborhood clinics. Your work here reaches further than one family’s table — you’re helping us build a place every family can find.

Who you are

You are:

  • Self-motivated and mission-driven

  • Deeply knowledgeable in pediatric feeding and swallowing

  • Someone who meets kids where they are

  • A clear, compassionate communicator

  • A team player who cares as much about the clinicians on your team as the kids on your schedule

  • 401(k) with employer match

title: Integrated Photonics Engineer
description:
Role

Develop the photonic integrated circuit (PIC) technology at the heart of Azora's high-sensitivity optical transceivers. You will design, simulate, and characterize integrated photonic devices and modules; shepherding them from foundry tape-out through packaging and system integration.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate integrated photonic components and circuits: waveguides, couplers, 90° hybrids, MZI modulators, phase shifters, photodetector interfaces, and on-chip filters.

  • Own foundry tape-outs on silicon photonics, SiN, or InP platforms, including DRC, layout, and process design kit (PDK) workflows.

  • Develop test plans and carry out wafer- and chip-level characterization: insertion loss, polarization behavior, bandwidth, responsivity, and phase noise.

  • Work with packaging partners on fiber attach, hermetic packaging, and co-packaging with electronics for space environments.

  • Integrate PICs into coherent and photon-counting receiver chains and validate end-to-end sensitivity against quantum-limit targets.

  • Assess radiation tolerance and thermal behavior of photonic devices for flight applications.

  • Collaborate with mixed-signal and FPGA engineers on driver/TIA interfaces and DSP requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • MS/PhD in Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Physics, or related field (or equivalent industry experience).

  • 3+ years of hands-on PIC design and characterization experience.

  • Proficiency with photonic simulation and layout tools (Lumerical, Synopsys, KLayout, IPKISS, or similar).

  • Experience with at least one commercial foundry PDK and tape-out cycle.

  • Strong lab skills: fiber alignment, RF probing, optical test instrumentation (OSA, LCA, tunable lasers).

Preferred

  • Experience with coherent optical communications (DP-QPSK/QAM, DSP-based receivers) and/or photon-counting detection.

  • Familiarity with free-space-to-chip coupling, optical phased arrays, or integrated beam steering.

  • Knowledge of space qualification of photonic components (radiation, TVAC, vibration).

  • Experience with hybrid integration (III-V on Si, micro-transfer printing) or co-packaged optics.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: People and Culture Lead
description:
About N4 Studio

N4 is Webflow's number one global agency partner. We build and run websites for a living, from full start-to-finish builds through to N4+, our ongoing managed retainer model, for a client list that's mostly large US corporates, alongside AU/NZ and UK Accounts.

We're a team of circa 70, spread across Auckland, Australia, the UK, Serbia, Poland and the US. There's no single hub, no single time zone that runs the show, we're global by default, and we move fast because of it, not despite it. We're looking for the right people to come with us on our growth journey.

Role purpose

This is a brand new role for N4, and a genuinely strategic one. As we grow, we want to level up how we show up to shape our people's experiences; building our talent pipeline, shaping how it feels to work at N4, and keeping a genuinely global, keeping people spread across the globe working as one team. That means two things sit side by side in this role.

One is the practical engine room: full-cycle recruitment, employment documentation, and the everyday mechanics of a workforce that spans full-time employees, part-time contractors and fixed-cost contractors across several countries.

The other matters just as much: actively driving culture, connection and engagement across a team that rarely sits in the same room, or even the same time zone, and being a genuine thought partner to the Managing Director on how we grow our people alongside the business.

This isn't a standard HR role, and we don't want it to feel like one. Compliance and process are table stakes; the real job is making sure the experience of building a career at N4 matches how ambitious the business already is, wherever in the world you're logging on from.

What you'll own

Talent acquisition

You'll run recruitment end to end across multiple regions: writing and placing job ads, sourcing and headhunting directly rather than waiting on inbound applicants, and managing candidates through to offer. Department leads support you with interviews and final selection for their own teams, but building and running the pipeline is yours. You'll be constantly researching and testing new ways to find great people, including scoping out new regions and talent pools as N4 grows into them. This isn't just filling roles as they open; it's building a pipeline and a network that gets stronger over time, one that's genuinely yours to keep and draw on.

Culture & global connection

This is the part of the role that goes beyond process. You'll drive the initiatives, rituals and communication that keep a team spread across regions genuinely connected: culture programs, recognition, internal comms, and ways of working that don't assume everyone's online at the same time. You'll run employee lifecycle surveys and engagement checks, but more importantly you'll act on what they tell you, and be the person constantly asking how connected our people actually feel.

Employee lifecycle & operations

From onboarding through to off-boarding, you own the mechanics that make employment at N4 feel seamless, no matter which country or contract type someone's on: employment documentation and contracts, including EOR via Deel, probation and performance processes, and the policies that keep our frameworks up-to-date as the business grows.

People partnering & Business Support

You'll be a sounding board and advisor to department leads and the Managing Director on the people side of running the business: performance conversations, team dynamics, structuring roles as teams grow, and coaching leads. You're not just executing what's asked of you here, you're bringing a people-lens, foresight, and the right tools to shape how leaders make decisions.

Who we're looking for

We're open to two different kinds of candidates for this role. Either an experienced P&C or HR professional who thrives working autonomously, and can take full ownership of building this function out for a global team from day one. Or a senior recruiter who's spent their career filling roles, but has had exposure to broader people initiatives and is genuinely hungry to step into owning them, with hands-on support and mentorship along the way.


Either way, this is a genuine opportunity to run a people function as your own. You love connecting the dots across a fast-moving, global team, and you're energised by the challenge that comes with it.

You'll likely have

  • Experience in a fast-moving environment; i.e. agency, SaaS, Start-ups, or tech, where you've not just grown a team, but shaped the initiatives that grew alongside it

  • Experience running full-cycle recruitment, including direct sourcing and headhunting, not just managing an agency

  • A background in HR or people & culture generalist work: employee lifecycle, documentation, engagement

  • Comfort working across different employment types (employees, contractors, EOR arrangements) and jurisdictions

  • Hands-on experience with EOR platforms, ideally Deel, for managing international contractors and employees

  • A strength in staying across a lot of moving pieces at once and spotting gaps before they surface

  • The ability to work autonomously and bring structure to a function that's starting from scratch

  • Comfortable using AI tools to support and enhance how you work day to day

That includes keeping the Managing Director informed on hiring pipeline, headcount, retention and engagement, and being the person who spots where the people side of the business needs investment next, ahead of the curve.

title: Implementation Lead — Clinical Trial Operations
description:
We are looking for an Implementation Lead who combines deep clinical trial operations experience with a strong technology and product mindset to help customers successfully implement and adopt Tilda.

Role Overview

The Implementation Lead sits at the intersection of Clinical Operations, Clinical Project Management, Product, and Customer Implementation.

This is not a traditional software engineering or infrastructure deployment role.

We're looking for someone who understands how clinical trials actually operate and can translate customer processes and requirements into effective workflows within the Tilda platform.

You will work directly with clinical research customers to understand their study operations, identify workflow and process requirements, configure the Tilda platform, coordinate implementation activities, support testing and validation, and guide customers through successful go-live and adoption.

The ideal candidate started their career in Clinical Operations, Clinical Project Management, Site Operations, Clinical Data, or a related clinical research function and has subsequently gained experience working with clinical trial technology or SaaS products.

What You'll Do

Lead Customer Implementations

  • Own customer implementations from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, go-live, and adoption.
  • Lead implementation and workflow-discovery sessions with clinical research customers.
  • Understand the customer's existing clinical trial processes, systems, pain points, and operational requirements.
  • Develop implementation plans, workflows, milestones, dependencies, and launch criteria.
  • Coordinate implementation activities across customer stakeholders and internal Tilda teams.
  • Identify implementation risks and proactively drive issues toward resolution.
  • Ensure customers are operationally ready to use Tilda successfully.

Translate Clinical Operations Into Technology

  • Translate clinical trial workflows and business requirements into product configurations and technical requirements.
  • Understand how study teams operate and determine how Tilda should support or improve those workflows.
  • Partner with customers to redesign inefficient or manual processes rather than simply recreating legacy workflows.
  • Document customer requirements, use cases, workflows, configuration decisions, and product gaps.
  • Translate clinical requirements clearly for Tilda's Product and Engineering teams.
  • Help bridge communication between clinical users and technical teams.

Configure & Validate the Tilda Platform

  • Oversee the configuration Tilda based on customer study and operational requirements.
  • Support workflow configuration, data setup, user setup, permissions, and study-specific requirements.
  • Coordinate and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and implementation validation.
  • Identify product issues, workflow gaps, and configuration problems during implementation.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Support customers through go-live and early production adoption.

Clinical Trial Operations Expertise

  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource on clinical trial operations and study workflows.
  • Understand the relationships and operational responsibilities across Sponsors, CROs, Sites, Investigators, and Study Teams.
  • Apply knowledge of clinical study startup, study conduct, monitoring, data collection, quality, and closeout where applicable.
  • Understand the operational impact of introducing new technology into clinical research workflows.
  • Help ensure implementations align with appropriate clinical research processes and GCP requirements.

Product Partnership

  • Bring the voice of the customer and clinical operations perspective back to Product and Engineering.
  • Identify recurring customer requirements that should become standardized product capabilities.
  • Participate in discussions around workflow design and product improvements.
  • Help Product teams understand the operational impact of proposed features.
  • Identify opportunities where automation and AI can reduce manual clinical trial work.
  • Support testing and validation of new product capabilities.

Customer Enablement & Adoption

  • Train clinical and operational users on Tilda workflows.
  • Conduct implementation workshops, workflow reviews, and customer training sessions.
  • Develop implementation documentation and best practices.
  • Support customers during their transition from legacy processes to Tilda.
  • Partner with Customer Success following go-live to ensure successful adoption and value realization.

Required Qualifications

  • 4–5+ years of experience in Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Project Management, Clinical Research, or related clinical trial functions.
  • Experience working within a CRO, pharmaceutical/biotechnology company, clinical research organization, or clinical research site environment.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial operations and study lifecycle workflows.
  • Experience managing clinical projects, studies, operational workstreams, or cross-functional clinical initiatives.
  • 2+ years of experience working with and implementing clinical trial technology, SaaS platforms, or clinical software products - is REQUIRED
  • Demonstrated ability to translate clinical/business requirements into system workflows, product requirements, or configurations.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Technology, or software implementation teams.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills.
  • Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both clinical/operational stakeholders and technical/product teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a technology-oriented mindset.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with platforms such as:

  • Medidata
  • Veeva
  • Oracle Clinical
  • IQVIA clinical technologies
  • Florence Healthcare
  • Signant Health
  • Clario
  • TrialKit
  • Similar clinical trial SaaS platforms

Additional preferred experience:

  • Product Management or Product Owner experience within clinical technology.
  • Experience participating in UAT, QA, product testing, workflow design, or requirements gathering.
  • Experience implementing new clinical systems or migrating clinical teams from legacy processes.
  • Familiarity with ICH-GCP and regulated clinical research environments.
  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment.

title: Producer, Integrated Content & Production
description:
About Sundial Media & Technology Group (SMTG)

Sundial Media & Technology Group (SMTG) is a human connections platform — the signal powered by culture, scaled by technology, and built for community. SMTG connects, elevates, and empowers the most influential consumer segment in the market: HER, the Chief Influence Officer. With over 100 years of community knowledge and insights, SMTG is redefining the media model into a next-generation platform. Powered by proprietary intelligence and AI technology, it activates an ecosystem that scales HER influence and economic power. Its portfolio includes some of the most iconic, purpose-driven brands and experiences shaping culture today — ESSENCE (Girls United, ESSENCE Studios, ESSENCE Festival of Culture®), Refinery29, AFROPUNK, Beautycon™ (including NaturallyCurly), the Global Black Economic Forum, the Academy for Advancing Excellence, and the New Voices Fund. Through storytelling, products, and platforms, SMTG delivers the tools and technology to shape the future of media, commerce, and community — on HER terms.

Role Overview

SMTG is looking for an experienced, organized and solutions-oriented Producer to develop and execute cross-platform content and production operations supporting ESSENCE, Refinery29, live experiences, branded content, social storytelling, and key company initiatives.

This role is designed for a producer who operates across content production and production operations—someone equally comfortable supporting creative development, managing productions, overseeing budgets and workflows, and contributing to scalable systems that support high-volume, fast-moving content demands.

The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, can manage multiple productions simultaneously, and brings operational rigor, strong communication, and creative problem-solving to every stage of the process. They should have experience supporting premium shoots, agile social-first productions, talent-driven content, branded partnerships, and live-event capture while maintaining excellence across timelines, budgets, logistics, and execution.

This person will partner closely with the VP of Video & Production, creative leadership, marketing, social, editorial, strategy, and external production partners to support an agile, efficient, and future-facing production operation capable of meeting the evolving needs of a modern media and culture company.

This will be a hybrid role based out of our Brooklyn, NY office: Tuesday–Thursday onsite, and Monday/Friday remote.

Responsibilities

Production & Operations

  • Manage end-to-end production across multiple concurrent projects spanning premium video, social content, branded campaigns, editorial storytelling, photography, and live-event coverage.

  • Function as a hands-on producer across projects of varying scale, complexity, and business need.

  • Support leadership in maintaining and improving production workflows, processes, timelines, and operational systems to improve team efficiency and executional consistency.

  • Manage production schedules, staffing plans, crews, vendors, production freelancers, budgets, logistics, call sheets, approvals, and delivery timelines across all stages of production.

  • Oversee shoots involving talent, partners, multiple stakeholders, and fast-turn deliverables with professionalism and composure.

  • Serve as a primary production contact between internal teams and external production partners, ensuring communication, accountability, and execution remain aligned.

  • Oversee post-production workflows including editing, color, sound, and finishing; provide written scripts and outlines where applicable.

Creative Development & Content Execution

  • Partner with creative, editorial, social, and strategy teams to help shape compelling, platform-native content concepts from development through execution.

  • Vet creative ideas for production feasibility, budget alignment, platform optimization, and operational scalability.

  • Manage production execution across a wide range of formats including social-first content, branded content, talent capture, interviews, event recaps, editorial storytelling, and franchise programming.

  • Collaborate with editors and post-production teams to ensure projects maintain strong creative integrity, pacing, storytelling, and platform relevance.

  • Ensure all deliverables align with brand standards, audience expectations, and evolving platform behaviors.

  • Support the ideation, development, and pitch process of new video series, formats, and one-off projects aligned with platform strategy across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and emerging channels in partnership with the Creative team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Partner Management

  • Serve as a trusted production partner and key point of contact across internal stakeholders, creative teams, marketing, social, editorial, partnerships, and external clients.

  • Collaborate closely with strategy, sales, and partnerships teams to scope production needs, budgets, timelines, and creative approaches for custom content opportunities.

  • Source, manage, and maintain strong relationships with production companies, directors, photographers, editors, and freelance crews across a variety of production styles and scales.

  • Contribute to maintaining a scalable, flexible production partner ecosystem that supports both premium storytelling and rapid-turn content needs.

Brand & Client Partnership

  • Serve as a key in-house producer on priority brand accounts, ensuring excellence, continuity, and high standards across all deliverables.

  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external client teams; serve as a clear and confident point of contact throughout production.

  • Collaborate with pre-sale and strategy teams to scope, price, and package custom content for pitches and proposals.

Vendor & Network Management

  • Source, hire, and manage production companies, directors, photographers, and freelance crew across formats and styles.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams and external production partners.

  • Build and maintain a strong, diverse network of trusted production vendors; contribute to an internal repository of preferred partners.

  • Facilitate music licensing in collaboration with music supervisors when applicable.

What You Bring

  • 4–6+ years of experience in content production, digital media, branded content, agency, publisher, or entertainment environments.

  • Proven experience producing across a range of formats including premium video, social-first storytelling, live-event capture, branded content, commercial shoots, and fast-turn digital content across multiple platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, etc.).

  • Strong operational and production management skills with experience overseeing productions, budgets, timelines, staffing, and external vendors.

  • Experience managing projects from development through execution in hands-on production environments.

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple productions and shifting priorities simultaneously.

  • Calm, collaborative working style with strong communication and problem-solving abilities.

  • Deep understanding of social platforms, digital storytelling, audience behavior, and platform-native production approaches.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with high creative expectations and rapid turnaround timelines.

  • Strong foundation in analytics and a demonstrated ability to incorporate data into creative and workflow decisions.

  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as needed, occasionally with short notice.

  • Open to working extended hours and weekends when production demands require it.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality content delivered on time, on budget, and resonating with audiences across the SMTG brands.

  • Consistent production leadership across both internal teams and external partners.

  • Strong collaborative relationships across commercial, creative, strategy, and brand teams.

  • A growing and reliable network of production partners contributing to an efficient, scalable workflow.

  • Data-informed decisions that sharpen editorial output and platform performance over time.

What We Offer

  • Salary: The salary range for this role is $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 USD. The salary range is subject to change and may be amended in the future. Experience, education, skills, and other factors are considered when determining the salary offered.

  • Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, EAP, Annual Bonus eligibility.

Accessibility & Accommodations: Sundial Media Group is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible hiring experience. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact hr@sundialmediagroup.com and we will work with you to meet your needs.

Agencies: Sundial Media & Technology Group is not partnering with agencies nor accepts unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for any fees or expenses related to such unsolicited resumes and/or applicants.

Dopo un primo periodo di affiancamento alla Direzione Tecnica, la risorsa diventerà il punto di riferimento operativo per garantire la continuità produttiva, l’efficienza degli impianti, il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza e la corretta esecuzione degli interventi manutentivi e progettuali.

Responsabilità principali

  • Seguire i nuovi progetti impiantistici, le modifiche tecniche e proporre interventi di automazione, revamping e miglioramento continuo.

Profilo ideale

  • Esperienza: Background in contesti produttivi industriali, preferibilmente nel settore alimentare.

  • Competenze tecniche richieste:

    • Conoscenza di impianti automatici, sistemi PLC, sensoristica e automazione.

    • Competenze in manutenzione meccanica, elettrica e pneumatica.

    • Conoscenza delle utilities di stabilimento: freddo industriale, aria compressa, vapore/acqua calda, impianti CIP, linee di confezionamento.

Caratteristiche personali

Ricerchiamo un professionista con una mentalità concreta e orientata al reparto. È richiesta la capacità di interfacciarsi efficacemente con manutentori e operatori, comprendendo rapidamente le problematiche tecniche per trasformarle in soluzioni pratiche.

title: Assistant Director of Operations - Food Services
description:
Overview: As a growing 501(c)(3), non-profit organization, CRCI is always looking for new talented individuals who can be an addition to its efforts. It is CRCI Management’s desire that each person involved with the organization, paid or not paid, has a burden for the lost, the sick, and the suffering. It is also important that all staff recognize that they are representatives of CRCI, and their actions will affect the community’s outlook upon it. Staff are a representation of the CRCI program, and it will be expected for them to conduct themselves in a manner that always promotes and elevates the image of CRCI to the community. Any behavior that promotes a negative image of the organization is unacceptable.


Position Summary: The Assistant Director of Operations - Food Services is responsible for leadership, oversight, planning, and implementation of all food service operations and food-related logistics across CRCI programs. This position functions as an operational leadership role under the Director of Facility Management & Operations and is responsible for supervising food service personnel, coordinating farm operations as they relate to the program food stream, maintaining active inventory systems, planning food procurement, managing schedules, and ensuring that CRCI residents and approved staff receive nutritious meals in a consistent, safe, and cost-effective manner.

This position oversees the connection between CRCI’s kitchens, farm operations, food donations, purchasing, inventory, storage, transportation, and resident meal service. A major focus of this role is to incorporate as much farm-produced food as possible into CRCI’s resident food stream in order to reduce waste, improve stewardship, lower food costs, and support the broader mission of the ministry.

The Assistant Director of Operations - Food Services must be a highly qualified, mission-aligned leader who is capable of managing people, schedules, inventory, systems, compliance, and logistics with excellence. This person must be able to think strategically, plan ahead, solve problems, communicate clearly, and lead staff and residents in a manner consistent with CRCI’s mission, values, and Christ-centered recovery model.


Key Responsibilities

Food Service Management

  • Oversee all food service operations for every CRCI program and campus as assigned.
  • Ensure all CRCI residents and approved employees are fed daily according to program schedules and operational needs.
  • Provide leadership for kitchen operations, menu planning, food preparation, meal service, storage, sanitation, and food distribution.
  • Manage and maintain a rotating menu that meets nutritional, dietary, budgetary, and program requirements.
  • Adjust menus as needed for special events, holidays, emergencies, resident health needs, food donations, inventory availability, and seasonal farm production.
  • Ensure that food service operations are organized, efficient, safe, sanitary, and aligned with CRCI standards.
  • Coordinate with program leadership to ensure food service supports the daily schedule and structure of the residential program.

Operations Leadership & Logistics

  • Serve as an operational leader under the Director of Facility Management & Operations for all food service operations and related logistics.
  • Strategically plan food service operations in advance, including staffing, purchasing, inventory, meal schedules, campus needs, storage capacity, and transportation needs.
  • Coordinate food distribution between kitchens, campuses, storage areas, farm operations, and donation sources.
  • Develop and maintain systems that improve operational efficiency, accountability, cost control, and consistency across CRCI food service operations.
  • Prepare for seasonal needs, emergency food service needs, campus growth, program changes, and special events.
  • Communicate clearly with leadership regarding operational needs, risks, staffing concerns, budget concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

Farm Operations & Farm-to-Food Stream Integration

  • Supervise or coordinate with farm and agricultural staff as they relate to CRCI food production and food service operations.
  • Work with farm staff to plan, harvest, store, and distribute farm-grown food in a way that supports CRCI’s menu and resident meal needs.
  • Coordinate planting and production goals with anticipated kitchen needs whenever possible.
  • Help identify which crops, produce, or farm products can be most effectively used in the resident food stream.
  • Ensure harvested food is properly washed, stored, recorded, and transferred into kitchen inventory.
  • Maintain consistent communication between farm staff and kitchen staff so available food is used before it spoils.
  • Create systems for preserving or processing excess food when appropriate, including freezing, approved canning methods, dehydrating, or preparing food for later use.
  • Track farm production usage and report how farm-grown food is being incorporated into meals.
  • Ensure farm operations support CRCI’s goals of stewardship, resident skill development, cost reduction, and sustainability.
  • Work with instructors from higher education institutions to provide the best learning experience possible while utilizing these resources to serve the needs of the farming operation in the best way possible.

USDA / DSS / Compliance

  • Assist with management of the USDA Food Program and EBT/SNAP programs, including documentation, reporting, and compliance with all federal and state guidelines.
  • Ensure full compliance with state, federal, grant-based, and internal requirements related to food services, nutrition, safety, sanitation, and documentation.
  • Participate in internal and external audits and ensure all required documentation is accurate, complete, and accessible.
  • Ensure farm-grown food, donated food, purchased food, and stored food are handled according to applicable food safety expectations.
  • Maintain required certifications, logs, rosters, reports, and inspection readiness at all times.

Food Sourcing & Procurement

  • Oversee procurement for the Food Services Department, including purchasing, inventory, vendor relationships, donor relationships, and coordination of food donations.
  • Seek out cost-saving opportunities, donations, bulk purchasing options, and partnerships that reduce expenses while maintaining food quality.
  • Collaborate with CRCI kitchens and campuses to standardize sourcing, accept shared donations, and coordinate bulk orders.
  • Reduce unnecessary purchasing by using existing inventory, donated food, and farm production first whenever possible.
  • Develop purchasing plans based on active inventory, menu needs, resident census, seasonal farm production, and budget limits.
  • Maintain vendor and donor relationships in a professional manner that reflects CRCI’s mission and reputation.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain an accurate and active inventory of food items, supplies, equipment, donations, and farm products.
  • Track expiration dates, rotate stock, monitor usage, and minimize waste.
  • Conduct regular inventory reviews and maintain usage reports to inform procurement planning.
  • Ensure food from the farm is entered into inventory and used in a timely manner.
  • Monitor freezer, refrigerator, dry storage, kitchen, warehouse, and farm storage areas for cleanliness, organization, and proper rotation.
  • Develop systems for identifying surplus food and redirecting it into meals, preservation, donation, or other approved uses before it is wasted.
  • Use inventory data to forecast future needs, reduce unnecessary purchases, and strengthen stewardship of ministry resources.

Staff Supervision, Scheduling & Training

  • Supervise kitchen staff, farm staff, LDI assistants, resident workers, volunteers, and other assigned support staff.
  • Develop and manage staff schedules to ensure adequate coverage for meal preparation, service, cleaning, receiving, inventory, farm coordination, and logistics.
  • Provide training, mentorship, accountability, and skills development in kitchen operations, food safety, farm-to-kitchen systems, sanitation, inventory, and stewardship.
  • Ensure residents assigned to kitchen or farm-related food service duties follow safety, sanitation, and operational protocols at all times.
  • Collaborate with program staff to maintain a structured, safe, and recovery-supportive work environment.
  • Hold direct reports accountable to CRCI policies, schedules, expectations, and standards.
  • Communicate performance concerns, staffing needs, safety issues, and operational concerns to the Director of Facility Management & Operations.

Safety & Sanitation

  • Maintain clean, organized, and sanitary kitchen, storage, farm food handling, and food distribution environments.
  • Lead safety training for kitchen residents, food service staff, and farm-related food handlers.
  • Conduct monthly safety audits and enforce corrective actions immediately when needed.
  • Ensure farm-grown food is handled safely from harvest to storage to preparation.


Recurring Responsibilities

Daily

  • Ensure preparation and service of all scheduled meals for residents and approved staff.
  • Maintain kitchen cleanliness, sanitation, and organization.
  • Supervise assigned staff and resident workers.
  • Monitor food stock and rotate inventory as needed.
  • Communicate with farm staff regarding available produce and immediate food needs.
  • Ensure farm-grown food is properly received, stored, documented, and used when available.
  • Address urgent kitchen, inventory, staffing, safety, logistics, or sanitation concerns.

Weekly

  • Review and adjust the 4-week rotating menu based on inventory, donations, resident census, budget needs, and farm production.
  • Review employee schedules and adjust staffing assignments as needed.
  • Communicate with farm staff regarding upcoming harvests and kitchen needs.
  • Provide coaching and training to residents serving in kitchen or farm-related food service roles.
  • Implement weekly deep-cleaning tasks and sanitation checklists.
  • Coordinate with CRCI kitchens and campuses to evaluate food needs and distribute donations or surplus food.
  • Review waste patterns, inventory movement, and purchasing needs to identify improvements.

Monthly

  • Conduct monthly food orders and verify budget alignment.
  • Oversee full inventory review and usage reporting.
  • Complete USDA program reporting, documentation, and compliance tasks.
  • Submit required departmental reports to the Director of Facility Management & Operations.
  • Conduct monthly safety training refreshers and safety audits.
  • Review farm production usage and report how much farm-grown food was incorporated into meals.
  • Evaluate food waste, purchasing patterns, inventory movement, and opportunities for cost reduction.
  • Meet with leadership as needed to discuss farm-to-kitchen goals, staffing, compliance, logistics, and operational improvements.

title: Event Hosts (Global Sporting Event)
description:
The iLUKA Collective is a specialised agency developing and delivering coordinated strategic activations for sponsors and other stakeholders at global sports events. We are experts in executing cutting edge event hospitality experiences born from intelligent strategic direction. Our heritage is big events for big companies looking for strategic and measured solutions which focus on creating unforgettable experiences for stakeholder's integral to sponsors success.

Our experience working with Sponsors, Organising Committees, International Sporting Federations, Governing Bodies and City stakeholders enables us to develop our client's sponsorship story to ensure that activations maximise the communication of their messages as well as guide global teams and their local markets through the unique complexities of delivering effectively at global sports events.

Working at The iLUKA Collective is a unique experience. We take people seriously, hospitality is about people, It is our people that drive the difference. We work with talented people from around the world who are renowned for their hard work and industry expertise. We are defined by our passion for sport, hospitality and creativity.

We’re looking for passionate, energetic and enthusiastic Event Hosts to join us in Los Angeles for an incredible global sporting event in 2028. · Management of guest lists

· Meet and greet guests in a friendly and welcoming manner

· Provide information and assistance to guests as required

· Accompany guests on their journey and ensure a smooth transition to other host teams on arrival at the destination

· Management of guest lists

Venue/Showcasing

· Manage and Organise the safe and efficient flow of guests through the venue

· Provide VIP reception services/cloak room services

· Manage queue and crowd issues in a safe manner

· Provide information and assistance to guests as required

This is not an exhaustive list and all team members will be expected to contribute to any other aspects of the business, as necessary.

Skills, Knowledge, Expertise:

· Experience using smart phones/tablets

· Highly effective communication and interpersonal skills

· A fun, ‘Can Do’ attitude

· Confidence to manage and engage with groups of people in a variety of settings

· Ability to think on your feet and resolve problems calmly and efficiently

· A desire to deliver the very best levels of customer service

· High energy, comfortable working potentially long hours in a demanding but rewarding and friendly environment

· Flexible, enthusiastic, confident, outgoing, well organised

· Willing to roll sleeves up and get involved

· Team Player

· Self-motivate

Attributes:

· High energy, comfortable working potentially long hours in a demanding but rewarding and friendly environment

· Flexible, enthusiastic, confident, outgoing

· Willing to roll sleeves up and get involved

· Passionate about sport, hospitality and delivery

· Able to work in a calm, kind and professional manner in a pressured environment

title: Junior Travel Planner - Open Application
location: United States, Latin America, Overseas Morocco - Tech
description:
We’re always open to meeting exceptional talent interested in building a career in luxury travel.

This is an open application, meaning we may not have an active role available at the moment. That said, we thoughtfully review every submission and keep strong profiles in mind as new opportunities arise.

If you bring relevant experience; particularly in luxury travel, sales, or client-facing roles, and a genuine interest in our industry, we’re always open to continuing the conversation when there’s a potential fit!

About Us:

At Overseas Network, the story starts with YOU. Since 2000, we’ve built our success on people — the talent, creativity, and passion that fuel every journey we design. When you join our team, you’re not just filling a role; you’re becoming part of the story we tell the world. Our purpose is simple: every destination has a story to tell. Each department brings that vision to life in its own way. We continue to expand our business offerings into digital products, which are unique to the hospitality space. In the past 5 years, our growing involvement in the world of sports has led us to offer official packages to the FIFA World Cup, UEFA Champions League, English Premier League, Formula 1 GPs, and NBA matches.

What you'll do:

Your role is to understand client needs, select the right mix of hotels, experiences, and logistics, and deliver accurate, compelling proposals that align with budgets, supplier availability, and internal sales targets. Once confirmed, you will oversee the full production process—you will oversee the production process until completion of the trip, supported by our quality control and finance departments, to ensure every detail is executed seamlessly through trip completion.

We have offices in Barranquilla, Colombia; São Paulo, Brazil; and Casablanca / Marrakesh, Morocco.

Who we’re looking for:

Freshly graduated or needing a change of path, you have great communication skills, you are at ease with any basic computer usage, and you feel that you are a sales closer. Multiple languages are a plus, such as French, Spanish, Arabic, Portuguese, and German, but being skilled at generating enthusiasm in English might do the trick!

  • Not afraid of challenges and being a team player.

Benefits:

  • Discounted hotel rates for personal travel (after 3 month probation period)

  • Opportunities to travel in incentive trips offered by Overseas Network

title: Product Engineer
description:
What you'll be working on:

As our Product Engineer, you will sit at the critical link that transforms novel alloy breakthroughs into manufacturable, reproducible, and market-ready products with a focus on hands-on testing and characterization within the Product Department.

  • Own post-testing failure analysis of customer tests, determining root cause and translating findings into actionable feedback for the product and R&D teams.
  • Design and build custom tests, rigs, and proxy methods that let us creatively and rigorously measure how our products perform under complex, real-world operational conditions.
  • Work with external labs on standard and specialized testing, including high temperature properties, wear, fatigue, oxidation, corrosion, DBTT, Gleeble, and spectroscopic analysis by vetting lab partners and arranging quotations, testing conditions, and timelines.
  • Maintain detailed, organized documentation of test data by alloy and product for the whole organization.
  • Own calibration and maintenance of internal testing equipment, implement best practices in obtaining accurate measurements.
  • Author and maintain material datasheets, characterization procedures, and technical documentation for all alloy product lines.
  • Partner with other product engineers and scientists to determine testing needs and design custom tests.

Qualifications

  • MS or PhD degree in materials science, mechanical engineering or a related field.
  • 2+ years of industry experience in metallurgy, materials engineering, or a related discipline, with demonstrated involvement in process and product development, testing, and characterization.
  • Familiarity with alloy processing techniques such as powder metallurgy, heat treatment, or additive manufacturing relevant to demanding applications.
  • Familiarity with powder characterization and material property measurements including mechanical, electrical, magnetic and chemical characterization.
  • Proven ability to develop quality assurance frameworks, write material specifications, and establish characterization test procedures.
  • Systematic, detail-oriented approach to problem-solving and process development.
  • Collaborative team player who works effectively across R&D, manufacturing, and commercial functions.
  • Comfortable operating with ownership and initiative in a fast-paced, resource-constrained start-up environment.
  • Strong technical writing skills — able to produce clear, organized documentation including datasheets, SOPs, and process specifications.


Culture

We don’t look for profiles that “fit” with our culture. We look for people that add to who we are - people with the initiative, positive approach to problem solving, and passion for something (anything!) that will make them both high impact and exciting to work alongside from day one. We know that these people come from all walks of life, with all backgrounds and levels of experience. If you’re excited about the work we can do together, please reach out. We enthusiastically welcome team members of all races, colors, religions, ages, sexes, sexual orientations, gender identities, national origins, different abilities, genetics, veteran statuses, and former incarceration statuses.


Compensation and Benefits

The success of this company will be grounded in the long-term productivity of our team. To provide everyone with the physical, mental and financial safety to operate at their long-term best, we provide the following:

  • Meaningful, challenging, impactful work, and opportunities to grow within the company at all levels
  • Competitive salary, guaranteed to rise with inflation at a minimum each year
  • Equity - People at every level will have an impact, and should benefit from their work
  • Unlimited paid vacation, with a very strong expectation that employees take a minimum of 15 days off per year, and a full week off at least once per year
  • Flexible working style. Most jobs will require people to be present in person or in office most of the time, but in general we care about what’s getting done, not when or where you’re doing it
  • Top tier health, dental and vision insurance with limited employee contributions
  • A voice in future benefits. This is the beginning, and we will work together to keep adding new, better ways to provide for everyone in the company
