title: Pharmaceutical Robotics Scientist
description:
We are seeking an associate scientist to join the Smart Lab within Drug Product Development.

The successful candidate will develop and deploy automation and technology processes for pharmaceutical drug candidates in a laboratory setting.

Position Responsibilities

  • The successful candidate will help design, prototype and develop laboratory automation solutions for formulation development applications as part of a multi-disciplinary team.
  • Assist with design and testing of modular hardware to facilitate data-rich experimentation.
  • Enable use of digital tools for machine learning and self-optimization to enhance automation goals.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to implement automated equipment and develop novel solutions for execution of laboratory experimentation.
  • Innovate with academic and industrial collaborators to identify unmet needs and develop novel solutions.
  • Partner with formulation scientists, material scientists and engineers on suitable experimentation to deliver DPD workflows for solid dosage form development.
  • Implement a robotic control system for orchestration of multiple workstreams using modular laboratory equipment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Analytics & Search
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Over 180,000 restaurant businesses run on Toast.

About the team

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our OLAP Platform team in Dublin. OLAP is the analytical data layer that powers real-time reporting, search and agentic data access for AI-driven products across Toast. We ingest events from across the business, index them into OpenSearch, and expose them to consumer teams through a federated GraphQL layer. One platform, many tenants, restaurant-critical latency and freshness.

The team is in a pivotal stretch of work: scaling the platform to support more domains and more consumers, keeping performance and cost in balance as it grows, and opening it up safely to the next wave of AI-driven products. This is platform engineering at real scale - the systems you build here are consumed by other engineering teams and, downstream, by the tens of thousands of restaurants that run on Toast.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • Strong backend engineering skills in Kotlin, Java, or another object-oriented language, with solid instincts around testing and code quality
  • Experience working with large datasets, where correctness, freshness, and query performance all matter at the same time
  • Comfort with document-based or columnar data stores (BigTable, DynamoDB or similar)
  • A strong interest in core search engineering e.g. ranking algorithms, semantic search, natural language search etc
  • Ability to work across team boundaries and pick up context quickly - OLAP touches almost every product area at Toast, and the work can be as much collaboration as execution
  • The ability to break down a problem, understand what the consuming team actually needs, and ship a clean solution. Our users are other engineers, and the ergonomics of the platform matter
  • Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your workflow, not an afterthought

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

  • Experience designing platform APIs that other teams depend on - platform thinking, not just feature delivery
  • Hands-on experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or a similar query engine at scale
  • Familiarity with data pipelines or event-driven architectures (Kafka, Pulsar, or similar)
  • Experience with federated GraphQL (ElasticGraph, Apollo Federation, or similar) and REST API design
  • Exposure to Ruby, with the ability to navigate, understand, or modify existing source code.

Our Tech Stack

  • A core of Java & Kotlin based backend services.
  • OpenSearch as the core query engine with ElasticGraph on top for federated GraphQL
  • Pulsar & Camel for message-based integrations.
  • React SPAs leveraging Tailwind, GraphQL and Storybook.
  • And many more technologies that help us build a top class platform.

This is a hybrid role requiring in-office collaboration two days per week in our Dublin office.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

title: Laboratory Technician
description:
The Laboratory Technician is primarily responsible for performing laboratory tests and analyses under the direction of a lab supervisor or scientist including specimen management, specimen pipetting, instrument operation/maintenance, data entry and specimen storage with a high degree of proficiency. Follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Ensure all laboratory equipment and work areas are clean, sterile, and in proper working order. May be responsible for calibration of instruments. Conducts routine tasks as directed. Closely supervised with little latitude for independent judgment.

Laboratory Technician Duties Include but are not Limited to the Following:

  • Examine samples for validity and other requirements (sample type, volume, etc.)
  • Perform sample preparation steps which may include specimen pipetting with a high degree of accuracy and precision
  • Operate, calibrate and maintain all assigned laboratory equipment and instruments according to standard operating procedures to ensure quality results
  • Perform reagents and materials preparation for testing
  • Maintain adequate inventory of supplies, reagents and materials needed for testing
  • Document remedial action, troubleshooting, quality assurance activities and instrument maintenance
  • Adhere to established processing timelines
  • Perform data entry into the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS)
  • Label samples and deliver them to proper area(s)
  • Retrieve and re-file samples for testing
  • Properly store specimens for short term and long term storage
  • Aid laboratory personnel in cleaning duties
  • Adhere to all quality and safety standards, as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable regulatory agencies
  • Adhere to policies and protocols in the lab
  • Work closely and communicate with other lab associates to complete daily activities efficiently
  • Represent department and the organization favorably and in accordance with established Company standards and associate attributes at all times
  • Other duties as assigned by management

Basic Minimum Education Qualifications:

  • BS or BA in Biological, Physical, or Chemical Science
  • OR BS or BA degree in related science fields with 16 hours in Biology, 16 hours in Chemistry and 3 hours of Mathematics

Basic Minimum Work Requirements:

  • Minimum 1 year data entry experience preferred
  • Previous clinical laboratory experienence preferred
  • Experience or formal training in working with potentially infectious human blood bodily fluids preferred
  • Ability to work with automated and manual platforms
  • Must possess skills required for aseptic techniques
  • Intermediate level of proficiency with PC based software programs
  • Ability to read, interpret, and comply with documents such as internal SOPs, operating and maintenance instructions, and company policies
  • Position may require evening and weekend hours
  • Goal oriented, with excellent time management and organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with ability to interact effectively and work efficiently with people at all levels in the organization
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills
  • Keenly attentive to detail
  • Ability to keep sensitive information confidential
  • Intermediate level of proficiency with PC based software programs, with database skills
  • Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Physical Requirements:

  • Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate a keyboard and other office equipment, use a telephone, access file cabinets and other items stored at various levels, including overhead
  • Ability to speak and hear well enough to communicate clearly and understandably with sufficient volume to ensure an accurate exchange of information in normal conversational distance, over the telephone, and in a group setting
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time as necessary in the laboratory (4 or more hours)
  • Ability to lift and move items weighing up to 15 pounds
  • Physical dexterity sufficient to move body frequently around laboratory equipment and instrumentation
  • Ability to continuously operate a personal computer for extended periods of time (4 or more hours)

description:
Perfec-Tone Bahamas. Nassau, in-store. Full-time or part-time.

You wax fast, you wax clean, and your clients book the next appointment before they leave the room. You know the difference between a wax that hurts more than it has to and one that respects the skin you are working on.

Perfec-Tone is a 45-year clinical skincare brand built in Nassau. We are bringing waxing in-house as a dedicated service line, with our existing 19-service waxing menu and one chair waiting for the right specialist.

What the role actually is

Run the full waxing menu: brows, lip, chin, neck, full face, underarm, half and full arm, half and full leg, bikini, Brazilian, chest, stomach, back, and body combinations. Prep each client, deliver clean fast service, book the rebook at the chair, recommend post-wax aftercare from our product line.

You own your service time, your rebook rate, and the cleanliness of your room. The Sales Associates send their wax clients to you. The Estheticians coordinate with you when a client needs both a facial and a wax in one visit.

Compensation

  • Full-time: 40 hours per week scheduled. Part-time: 15 to 30 hours per week, scheduled.

  • $300/week base floor for full-time or tiered commission on services, whichever is higher each week

  • Tiered commission accelerator: 25% up to $1,500/week services, 30% from $1,500-$2,500, 35% above $2,500

  • Performance bonuses for reviews collected and rebook target achievement

  • Part-time at the same commission rates; base floor prorated to scheduled hours per the hourly equivalent ($7.50/hour)

You will do well here if

  • You hold a current Bahamian esthetician or waxing license

  • You can do a brow wax in under 15 minutes without compromising shape

  • You stay calm and clean during a Brazilian

  • You actually book the next appointment, not just hope they come back

You will not do well here if

  • You take 30 minutes for a brow wax

Apply at . In your application, indicate whether you are open to full-time, part-time, or both.

title: Assistant Vice President - Risk & Reporting
description:
Our Company
Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,400 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide.
We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.
The Risk & Reporting (R&R) team is building a technology-enabled performance analytics, investor reporting, and reporting-automation infrastructure across Oaktree's closed-end, open-end and evergreen strategies. The team supports nearly 1,000 unique recurring and custom reports and partners across investment teams, Investor Relations / Client Services, Finance / Accounting, Valuation, Data Management, Technology, Legal / Compliance, and enterprise solution groups to improve data quality, reporting speed, and production controls.
For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at http://www.oaktreecapital.com/

Responsibilities


As an AVP technical resource for our team, you will participate in data engineering, automation, dashboards for enterprise reporting workflows in Alternative Investment Strategies.
Responsibilities include:
Data Engineering & Architecture
•Design and maintain cloud-ready data pipelines and dimensional models using SQL, Python, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric / Azure, and, where relevant, AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Snowflake or Aurora;
•Implement secure, automated ingestion from Oaktree systems, MDM, data warehouse sources, FTP / email feeds, vendor files, Salesforce, servicer or administrator reports, and governed reporting datasets;
•Build performant ELT / ETL workflows for investment, portfolio, cash activity, audit log, exception, exposure, attribution, and reporting-control data;
•Develop reusable SQL and Python utilities, including advanced SQL optimization, window functions, pandas / PySpark data engineering, REST / GraphQL integration, validation checks, and test automation.
BI, Automation & Controls
•Create institutional Power BI dashboards, semantic models, paginated reports, DAX measures, Power Query / M transformations, row-level security, and deployment pipeline assets;
•Troubleshoot refresh failures, gateway / OneLake dataset issues, data type conversion errors, transformation exceptions, and production publishing issues;
•Apply Git, CI/CD, release management, logging, documentation, and data-quality SLAs to make recurring R&R outputs auditable, repeatable, and supportable;
•Use infrastructure-as-code concepts such as CloudFormation or Terraform, and orchestration patterns such as Airflow, Step Functions or Fabric pipelines where appropriate.

Technology & Reporting Coverage
•Support Private Markets reporting workflows through controlled data models, dashboards, reusable extracts, and exception monitoring;
•Build and maintain Power BI / Salesforce-enabled pipeline and enterprise dashboard logic, including deal-stage filters, region filters, expected close dates, accruing-expense flags, and unique deal identifiers;
•Develop checks and exception logs for deal IDs, expense tracking, vendor-fee workflows, Workday tagging, budget fields, Salesforce data quality, and downstream hand-offs to Investment Operations, Fund Accounting, Tax, Investment Team, Investor Relations, Client Services and other enterprise solution users;
•Partner with investment teams, Technology, Finance / Accounting, Tax, administrators, and enterprise solution groups to improve pipeline data quality and reduce ad hoc information requests.
Partnership & Delivery
•Translate business requirements into technical specifications, delivery plans, data dictionaries, acceptance criteria, and production support playbooks;
•Review analyst and associate work, mentor junior team members, and maintain clear handoffs between US stakeholders, Hyderabad delivery, Technology, and report consumers;
•Use approved GenAI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, test-case creation, and support diagnostics.
Qualifications
•10+ years in data engineering, BI development, reporting automation, or analytics engineering, preferably in asset management, investment banking, fund administration, financial services or another data-rich domain with comparable rigor;
•Exposure to alternative investments is required, with domain experience in asset-based finance, structured credit, private credit, opportunistic credit, emerging markets debt or origination vehicle solutions strongly preferred;
•Strong hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, Power BI, DAX, Power Query / M, semantic models, paginated reports, and data validation for recurring production reporting;
•Working knowledge of cloud data platforms and architecture, including Microsoft Fabric / Azure and/or AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Snowflake or Aurora;
•Hands-on experience developing Microsoft Fabric pipelines, dataflows, Lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, together with PySpark notebooks for distributed data processing in Fabric, Databricks or Synapse Spark environments;
•Working knowledge of the broader Azure data stack, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure DevOps, and SQL Server Management Studio for querying, data modeling and performance optimization;
•Experience designing scalable, reusable Power BI solutions using common data models, common measures, standardized layouts and consistent navigation, with semantic-model security including row-level and object-level security;
• Understanding of data governance, reporting standards and compliance frameworks, with a nonnegotiable
focus on data integrity, accuracy, clear naming and documentation;
• Familiarity with return and performance concepts such as TWR, MWR, IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI and RVPI,
plus exposure, attribution, benchmark, and investor-reporting outputs;
• Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to translate investment, reporting and
data-control requirements into durable technical solutions and explain technical design choices and
trade-offs to senior stakeholders and deal-team partners.


Preferred
• Experience with schema design, CDC, orchestration, IAM / secure data-access patterns, Git, CI/CD,
CodeBuild / CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, testing, and release controls;
• Familiarity with Oaktree-style reporting systems and workflows such as Geneva, IPS, Salesforce,
Workday, AXON, eFront-style investor platforms, Jira, and Confluence;
• Experience supporting collateral performance, credit metrics, exposure analysis, portfolio construction,
investment performance, fund-level reporting, client reporting or reporting operations;
• Experience partnering directly with investment or deal teams through working sessions, borrower calls
and vendor-data validation to understand the decisions dashboards need to support and to iterate based
on live feedback;
• Strong BI design judgment across filter placement, page focus, navigation, drill-through structure,
dynamic titles, footnotes, visual conventions, refresh cadences and controls over user interactions;
• Experience contributing to BI strategy, governance standards and adoption of best practices, with the
judgment to surface trade-offs that could compromise scalability, maintainability or correctness;
• AWS Data Analytics, Power BI Data Analyst, Azure / Fabric, CFA, FRM, CAIA or CIPM credentials are a
plus.


Personal Attributes


• Builder's mindset, energized by replacing manual report production with controlled, well -engineered
data products;
• Strong point of view on how to build BI and analytical solutions, with the judgment to flag concerns
about scalability, maintainability or data accuracy and the collaborative disposition to work through
them;
• Curious, rigorous, and accountable, with the patience to investigate source-system breaks until the data,
controls, and narrative hold together;
• Pragmatic under deadline pressure, comfortable using a strong prototype as the basis for discussion
while maintaining a non-negotiable bar on data-model design, accuracy and clear documentation;
• Organized and independent, able to manage technical workstreams, production incidents,
documentation, reviews, and deadlines;
• Team-oriented and professional, with the ability to mentor analysts and associates on durable reporting
practices and technical quality standards.


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Accounting or a related analytical field, or equivalent deep work experience building data / BI solutions in investment management

title: Snowflake Data Modeller
description:
Snowflake Data Modeller

The Snowflake Data Modeller will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and evolving enterprise data models within a Snowflake environment. The role will involve close collaboration with Data Architects, Data Engineers, Business SMEs, Data Owners, Product Managers and Analytics teams to ensure that data structures are scalable, consistent, governed, and fit for business use.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with enterprise data architecture standards.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and reusable data models.
  • Design data models specifically for Snowflake data platforms and data warehouses.
  • Apply appropriate modelling methodologies, including Kimball, Star Schema, Data Vault, and normalized data models.
  • Define and document entities, attributes, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and business rules.
  • Design and structure data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in a Medallion Architecture.
  • Develop models that support data ingestion, integration, transformation, analytics, reporting, AI, and data products.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure that logical and physical models can be efficiently implemented in Snowflake.
  • Ensure consistency and alignment of data models across different business domains and data products.
  • Contribute to the definition and implementation of enterprise data standards and modelling conventions.
  • Support metadata management and data lineage by ensuring that model definitions and relationships are properly documented.
  • Work with semantic layers and Common Information Models (CIM) to ensure consistent business definitions and data consumption.
  • Apply data governance principles throughout the data modelling lifecycle.
  • Support data quality, validation, and reconciliation activities to ensure the accuracy and integrity of data structures.
  • Analyse existing data models and identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation, optimisation, and reuse.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date data model documentation and modelling artefacts.
  • Use appropriate data modelling tools to create, maintain, and communicate data models.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to resolve modelling issues, clarify requirements, and ensure alignment between business needs and technical implementation.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organisation's data architecture, modelling standards, and governance practices.
Key Technologies:
  • Snowflake
  • SQL
  • Data Modelling
  • Kimball / Dimensional Modelling
  • Star Schema
  • Data Vault
  • Normalized Data Models
  • Medallion Architecture
  • Metadata Management
  • Data Lineage
  • Semantic Layers
  • Common Information Models (CIM)
  • Data Governance
  • Data Quality & Reconciliation
  • Data Modelling Tools.

title: Vice President, Asset Backed Finance (IG)
description:
Our Company

Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with more than $220 billion in assets under management. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, equity, and real estate. The firm has more than 1,500 employees and offices in more than 25 cities worldwide.

We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture.

For additional information, please visit Oaktree’s website at

The Oaktree ABF strategy:

Oaktree Asset Backed Finance (“ABF”) is a step-out strategy which invests in pools of contractual assets, such as loans, leases, receivables, mortgages and licensing agreements, which may or may not reference property or other hard assets. Asset categories include corporate, consumer, real estate, transportation, equipment, infrastructure, energy, intellectual property and other esoteric types. On behalf of ABF funds and clients, Oaktree

  • Purchases, or commits to purchase, assets, with or without leverage

  • Lends, or commits to lend, secured by assets, in a senior or mezzanine position

  • Insures, or provides capital relief against, assets

  • Provides essential capital to a business primarily engaged in the origination and servicing of assets

While Oaktree has significant experience successfully investing client capital in ABF opportunities as a sub-allocation to existing funds, Oaktree ABF represents Oaktree’s first client offering dedicated to ABF. Based on the expanding ABF opportunity set and client demand both in unrated ABF and formally rated investment grade ABF (IG ABF), Oaktree ABF is expected to grow significantly. Oaktree judges the ABF Strategy’s success and value by outcomes delivered to clients, consistent with or exceeding expectations, over the medium and long term.

Overview of Role & Qualifications:

The Vice President will be our team’s first IG focused ABF hire and will be primarily responsible for structuring IG ABF investments and working with other members of the ABF group, contributing to all phases of the investment process, from sourcing, through decision points, to investment realization.

Primary responsibilities:

  • Multi-party coordination:

    • Identify business objectives, constraints and preferences of various stakeholders, including originators, insurance clients, rating agencies and non-insurance capital providers.

    • Design financing arrangements which are both capital efficient for insurers and acceptable to all stakeholders.

    • Credibly manage stakeholder buy-in, structuring and modeling, rating outcome and transaction execution.

  • Recognizing that Oaktree sources opportunities and leads through a variety of internal and external channels, the ABF Vice President will follow up on introductions and inquiries of potential relevance to the ABF strategy, identify the situations where an investment can be rated and work with the investment teams to negotiate appropriate terms.

  • Work with rating agencies and financing counterparties on rated asset-backed lending facilities, including warehouse facilities and term-out structures for existing or ramping pools of contractual cash-flowing assets.

  • Help guide IG ABF product development and develop creative, capital-efficient solutions for insurance-company balance sheets, considering the constraints of insurance capital, including, but not limited to, NAIC rating requirements or equivalent non-US and EU frameworks.

  • For those opportunities determined to be potentially attractive for Oaktree funds and suitable for rating and clients, lead or participate in diligence, negotiation of terms and documentation, building models and preparing investment memoranda for consideration by the ABF investment committee.

  • Train and supervise associates and analysts on the ABF team. Train and educate the ABF investment team on rating and structuring techniques.

  • Gain familiarity with Oaktree’s various pools of capital available for ABF investments, including the constraints imposed by fund investment guidelines, capital considerations, regulators, rating agencies and Oaktree’s internal policies and procedures.

Experience required:

  • 6-10 years relevant experience within asset finance or structuring at an investment bank or investing across securitized collateral types at an investment manager.

  • Facility with Excel and PowerPoint, commensurate with years of experience.

  • Strong experience reviewing financial agreements for relevant business points and to find answers to specific questions.

  • Knowledge of fixed income fundamentals, asset backed finance and securitization, commensurate with years of experience.

  • Experience executing private asset-backed investments (without relying on an arranging bank to structure the investment).

  • Experience working with rating agencies and leading processes to rate ABS securities or other asset backed investments.

  • Knowledge of rating methodologies for or ability to get up to speed quickly across various sectors.

  • Experience with CFO rating methodologies, rated feeders, NAV and ABL financing, preferred, but not required.

  • Experience with insurance companies and capital efficiency considerations for insurance balance sheets.

  • Familiarity with insurance capital, NAIC rating requirements or equivalent US and EU insurance-capital frameworks, including running processes to optimize ABS and ABF investments for insurance balance sheet investments.

  • Experience with rated warehouse facilities preferred, but not required.

Attributes:

  • Clever, intellectually curious, creative, resourceful, enjoys solving problems and going through novel, complex situations, quick study

  • Driven, productive, responsible, detail oriented, organized

  • Team oriented with high integrity.

  • Professional, relationship-oriented and a strong communicator in a variety of formats with a broad range of internal and external constituents. Collaborative partner across investment teams and counterparties.

  • Effective teacher and student. Enjoys sharing knowledge and educating team members.

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree from a top university

Base Salary Range

$225,000 - $275,000

In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives, a comprehensive benefits package and a flexible work arrangement. The base salary offered will be commensurate with experience and/or qualifications, industry knowledge and expertise, as well as prior training and education.

Oaktree does not make employment decisions on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, past or present physical or mental disability, HIV status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, veteran status, military service, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic violence victim status or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state and local laws and ordinances. This policy applies to hiring, placement, internal promotions, training, opportunities for advancement, recruitment advertising, transfers, demotions, layoffs, terminations, recruitment advertising, rates of pay and other forms of compensation and all other terms, conditions and privileges of employment. This policy applies to all Oaktree applicants, employees, clients, and contractors. title: Field Coordinator- Dist
description:
Job Title: Field Coordinator- Dist

Work Place Flexibility: Onsite

Legal Entity: Entergy New Orleans, LLC

JOB SUMMARY/PURPOSE

The Field Coordinator - Distribution is responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and high‑quality execution of all distribution construction, maintenance, restoration, and switching activities through thorough and proactive planning. This role focuses on anticipating hazards, validating switching orders, determining when EWP/DWP analysis is needed, and embedding Life Critical Rules, grounding requirements, clearance expectations, and safe‑work practices directly into pre‑job documentation – including executing where applicable. The Field Coordinator - Distribution validates all work packages against approved standards, assemblies, and work methods, performing site assessments, access reviews, and material verification to eliminate rework and prevent delays. By preparing switching packages, outage steps, and sequencing plans, the coordinator supports safe system operations and collaborates closely with Operations using DACT and OMS insights to strengthen restoration readiness.

Execution readiness is a core function—ensuring that permits, materials, equipment, logistics, environmental requirements, and jobsite conditions are fully prepared before crews mobilize. The Field Coordinator - Distribution works across Field Crews, Dispatch, and Supply Chain, teams to resolve constraints and maintain workflow continuity. Additionally, the role provides technical coaching, clarifies expectations, anticipates constructability challenges, and participates in post‑job reviews to strengthen planning quality, reinforce safe and consistent work practices, and prevent future planning‑driven issues.

JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Safety Leadership & High‑Risk Planning - Anticipates and identifies hazards in distribution work before execution; determines when EWP/DWP is required; embeds Life Critical Rules, grounding, clearances, and Safe Work Practices into all pre‑job documentation; and ensures safety controls and equipment are in place before crews mobilize.
  • Standards Compliance, Quality Control & Work Package Validation - Ensures distribution jobs align with construction and maintenance standards; performs pre‑construction reviews, site assessments, and material verification; and uses structured QA/QC (redlines, as‑builts, specification checks) to eliminate discrepancies before field execution.
  • System Operations Support, Switching Readiness & Outage Planning - Prepares and validates switching packages, isolation points, and outage steps for distribution work; coordinates with Distribution Operations Center (DOC) to ensure safe sequencing; and applies knowledge of DACT/OMS to support restoration readiness for routine and emergent events.
  • Execution Readiness & Work Enablement - Confirms distribution jobs are fully ready by validating access, environmental needs, permits, logistics, equipment staging, and material availability; resolves constraints early and coordinates across Construction, Dispatch, and Supply Chain, to ensure smooth field execution.
  • Technical Coaching, Troubleshooting & Field Support - Enhances crew success by clarifying job expectations, preparing accurate and actionable work plans, resolving planning‑phase challenges, participating in post‑job reviews, and intervening early when documentation or work‑practice gaps could compromise safety or quality

Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with $203 billion in assets under management as of March 31, 2025. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, private equity, real assets, and listed equities. The firm has over 1,200 employees and offices in 23 cities worldwide.

We are committed to cultivating an environment that is collaborative, curious, inclusive and honors diversity of thought. Providing training and career development opportunities and emphasizing strong support for our local communities through philanthropic initiatives are essential to our culture. For additional information please visit our website at www.oaktreecapital.com

Our Team

The Global Opportunities strategy started in 1988 and currently manages in excess of $46 billion in assets across a wide range of industries and geographies. It emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented, and risk-controlled approach to investments in private equity, listed equities, distressed / corporate debt, convertible securities, and real estate.

The London-based team is composed of 13 investment professionals and has a regional focus on EMEA and Latin America. Selected recent investments include:

  • Scranton Plasma (2024, Credit) - Oaktree provided rescue financing into Scranton Plasma, a subsidiary of Grifols, a Spanish biopharmaceutical company

  • LATAM Airlines (2022, Credit) – Oaktree anchored the financing required by LATAM Airlines to exit its Chapter 11 restructuring process

  • Inter Milan (2021, Credit) – Oaktree provided rescue financing into the Milan-based football club

  • LATAM Airlines (2020, Credit) – Oaktree led and provided a $1bn+ DIP financing to LATAM Airlines as part of its Chapter 11 restructuring process

  • Culmia (2020, Equity) – Oaktree acquired one of the largest housebuilders in Spain from a major bank

  • Pure DC (2017-20, Equity) – Oaktree created a data centre development platform to capitalize on the global expansion of IT hyperscalers

  • Arsenale (2022, Preferred Equity) – Oaktree provided financing and preferred equity to an Italian ultra-luxury hotel developer and operator with a luxury train business

  • Castell0 SGR (2020, Equity) – Oaktree acquired a controlling stake in an Italian fee-generating asset management business

  • Lioncor (2018, Equity) – Oaktree created and grew the largest Irish PRS residential development platform

Scope and Responsibilities

  • Creating detailed financial models and investment memoranda related to potential opportunities and existing investments;

  • Assisting in all aspects of underwriting and due diligence of investment opportunities across multiple sectors;

  • Assisting in business, market research, industry analysis, accounting and legal due diligence where applicable; and

  • Assisting in monitoring and managing existing investments.

Experience required

  • Requires 1-3 years of experience with a top-tier Investment Bank, Private Equity, Restructuring Advisory Boutique, Hedge Fund or Strategy Consulting Firm across Corporate and Real Estate;

  • Demonstrated competency in financial analysis, due diligence, valuations, preparing investment memorandums and advanced financial modeling; and

  • Proven ability to multi-task, understand and grasp new structures and concepts quickly.

Personal attributes

  • Exceptional analytical and financial modeling skills;

  • Very organized and excellent time management skills;

  • Eagerness to work hard in a team environment;

  • Solution oriented with a demonstrated ability to add value;

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; and

  • Fluency in English in addition to one other European language.

Education

Bachelor(s) degree from a top university. Advanced Degree and/or Business, Finance or Economics concentration a plus.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

Oaktree is committed to diversity and to equal opportunity employment. Oaktree does not make employment decisions on the basis of race, creed, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, past or present physical or mental disability, HIV status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, veteran status, military service, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic violence victim status or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state and local laws and ordinances. This policy applies to hiring, placement, internal promotions, training, opportunities for advancement, recruitment advertising, transfers, demotions, layoffs, terminations, recruitment advertising, rates of pay and other forms of compensation and all other terms, conditions and privileges of employment. This policy applies to all Oaktree applicants, employees, clients, and contractors. Staff members wishing to report violations or suspected violations of this policy should contact the head of their department or Human Resources.

For positions based in Los Angeles

For those applying for a position in the city of Los Angeles, the firm will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Jr Travel Planner Assistant
description:

title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
In a nutshell

As a Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes, you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.

You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Based in Barcelona, Spain; you will join a globally distributed team in support of our European Environmental Testing business, with a primary focus on chromatography data processing application.

How can you help us?

You will work on the following main areas:

Strategy & Operational Analysis, to:

  • Assess the EU Environmental Testing market, regulatory expectations, and laboratory operational data to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality improvement, and margin enhancement.
  • Support EU‑focused pricing, client segmentation, and demand modeling to guide product and investment priorities.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance turnaround time (TAT), analytical quality, data reliability, and regulatory alignment.

Product / Requirements Ownership (Chromatography Data System Software), to:

  • Serve as primary liaison between EU laboratory stakeholders and the Product Development team.
  • Elicit, document, and refine Business Requirements, User Requirements, and acceptance criteria (including non‑functional needs like performance and usability).
  • Maintain and update process documentation, including BRD (Business Requirements Document), URD (User Requirements Document), and BPMN (Business Process Model & Notation).
  • Collaborate with Product Development team to translate requirements into functional designs; help groom backlogs and support release scoping.
  • Lead EU‑regional user acceptance testing (UAT), business sign‑off, and change management for new features and workflow updates.

Cross‑Functional Business Support, to:

  • Partner with laboratory directors, technical leads, and product teams across the EU to harmonize chromatography data workflows.
  • Facilitate workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to challenge assumptions, streamline workflows, and improve cross‑site alignment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

Process Optimization & Quality Alignment, to:

  • Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.
  • Ensure alignment with Eurofins Quality System Documents (SOPs, methods, work instructions).
  • Ensure processes, requirements, and software workflows comply with key EU laboratory frameworks, including: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel testing requirements, and EU Member State national accreditation bodies operating under EA (European co‑operation for Accreditation)
  • Support audit preparation, nonconformity resolution, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.
  • Track corrective actions and measure system/process impact post‑deployment.

Data, Reporting & Financial Insight, to:

  • Build dashboards (performance, throughput, error rates, QC metrics, method performance, adoption/usage).
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational reviews with EU‑specific actionable insights.
  • Validate product requirements with data, quantify product value, and measure outcomes.

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

You have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner/Analyst in software, laboratory operations, or scientific environments.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation in an Agile environment (e.g., Jira/Confluence).
  • Familiarity with laboratory informatics such as LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) and CDS (Chromatography Data System).
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills across multi‑cultural EU teams.
  • Working knowledge of EU environmental testing compliance frameworks, including but not limited to: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel requirements, and European Accreditation (EA)
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel (SQL/BI tools a plus).

You are:

  • A strong communicator in English (written/oral).
  • A fast learner.
  • Self-motivated with a can-do attitude.

What else should I know?

The following skills are an advantage:

  • Experience in environmental (chromatography workflows is a plus), food, agroscience or biopharma testing and laboratory operations in EU‑regulated scientific environments.
  • Experience building BPMN workflows and writing functional specifications.
  • Exposure to LIMS, CDS, or scientific data management platforms; understanding of instrument integration.
  • MBA, M.Sc., or advanced scientific/technical degree.

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6,95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

title: Head of Risk FnUS
description:
Fnality is building the future of financial market infrastructure – creating regulated, blockchain-based payment systems to power tomorrow’s wholesale banking ecosystem. Backed by leading global banks and operating at the intersection of technology, finance, and regulation, we are powering the future of finance, together. There are no precedents for what we're doing. With you on our side, we'll be setting new ones every day.

Working at Fnality

Be your best: We have a supportive culture that helps to bring the best out of each and every single one of our employees.

Feel free to explore: Bring your new ideas and help us to solve problems together by joining a community of experts.

Be part of something bigger: We will support you by fostering an open, honest culture, that enables flexibility and wellbeing. Feel part of something bigger while being yourself. 

Feel empowered: We want you to feel empowered. The nature of our business can help make this a reality. We have the agility, speed and innovation of a start-up, and a flexible working environment that enables this.

Role Purpose

Here at Fnality, we are powering the future of finance, together: combining best in class technology with free-flowing creativity, and expertise that can make business better for everyone. There are no precedents for what we're doing. With you on our side, we'll be setting new ones every day.

In a complex world, we are here to bring clarity and make positive change.

Fnality US will be the newest entity within the Fnality Global Payments ecosystem, the operator of a new regulated payment system for the United States of America.

This is a foundational leadership role with broad influence, working in close partnership with the Head of Fnality US and senior stakeholders across Fnality’s international footprint.

Fnality US is seeking an experienced risk and compliance leader to develop, own, and continuously advance the risk management and compliance frameworks for the USD Fnality Payment System. You will operate as Fnality US’s primary subject matter expert across financial, operational, technology, cyber, and regulatory risk – ensuring robust controls while enabling innovation.

This role also carries oversight responsibility for BSA/AML and financial crime frameworks, ensuring the organisation meets applicable US regulatory expectations as it launches and scales.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the executive owner for all risk and compliance activities within Fnality US

  • Provide strategic leadership shaping the organisation’s risk, compliance, and resilience strategy as the USD FnPS grows

  • Partner closely with the Head of Fnality US on entity strategy, regulatory engagement, and external stakeholder management

  • Establish and lead the US risk governance structure (e.g., Risk section of the Audit & Risk Committee, policy frameworks, reporting, with a direct reporting line to the Fnality US Audit & Risk Committee.

Risk Management & Resilience

  • Deploy and operate the Fnality US Risk Management Framework, covering identification, assessment, treatment, monitoring, and reporting

  • Lead the oversight of incident management, operational events, and control effectiveness

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements related to cyber security, technology risk, and operational resilience for FMIs

  • Provide expert oversight of model, liquidity, operational, and third‑party risks

BSA/AML & Financial Crime Oversight

  • Develop and maintain BSA/AML and financial crime frameworks appropriate for a regulated FMI

  • Oversee AML/KYC standards, transaction monitoring design, suspicious activity management, and reporting obligations

  • Advise the Board and senior leadership on emerging financial crime risks and regulatory expectations

Regulator Engagement & Reporting

  • Act as a senior counterpart to the Federal Reserve and relevant US regulators, supporting the Head of Fnality US in strategic regulatory relationships

  • Ensure high‑quality, transparent reporting to regulators and the Fnality US Board

  • Represent Fnality US within global risk and compliance forums across the Fnality ecosystem

Cross‑Jurisdiction & Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Coordinate with other Fnality legal entities to ensure cross‑jurisdictional alignment of risk and compliance practices

  • Support the development of new use cases (e.g., PvP with other Fnality Payment Systems, DvP with partner platforms), managing related partnership risk

  • Double hat as an active senior member of the Group Risk function, contributing to that team objectives and deliverables.

Required competencies:

  • Operate at senior level, partnering closely with the Head of Fnality US and reporting to the Board

  • Build a strong, embedded risk and compliance culture across a new organisation

  • Design and implement the integrated risk, operational resilience, and BSA/AML frameworks for Fnality US

  • Provide authoritative guidance on regulatory expectations for FMIs, including cyber and operational resilience

  • Build Fnality US’s external credibility through confident, proactive engagement with US regulators

  • Collaborate with global colleagues to maintain consistent cross‑jurisdictional risk and compliance standards

  • Regular engagement with regulators on the US East Coast will be required, and some travel to the UK may be necessary

Required skills and experience

  • Extensive senior leadership experience in risk management or compliance within FMIs, banking, or financial services

  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a regulated environment, ideally including direct experience with the Federal Reserve or other relevant regulators

  • Proven experience engaging at Board and C‑suite level

  • Strong understanding of US regulatory frameworks for FMIs, including cyber, operational resilience, and payments regulation

  • Direct experience designing and managing BSA/AML and financial crime programmes

  • Experience working in fintech, start‑ups, or other high‑growth, fast‑evolving environments is highly desirable

  • Knowledge of wholesale payments, distributed ledger technologies, and cyber security is preferred

  • PLEASE NOTE: Operational risk experience is a must

Why should you join Fnality?

We employ curious individuals who thrive working in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment, who work best when empowered to drive their own work, and who are not afraid to fail fast and learn quicker.

You will be an analytical thinker who is able to look at tasks and understand the most efficient way to achieve the desired outcome. You will be vigilantly outcomes-focussed and have an insatiable desire to learn, adept at picking up new challenges and giving anything a go. You will want to deliver as much as learn and you will understand how important the power of the team is.

A bit more about us

Digital transformation is changing our lives, work and businesses. While other sectors evolve, however, financial markets remain slow, fragmented and siloed. What the world needs now is a future-facing financial system for the digital age.

At Fnality, we have been speaking – and listening – to the real users of today’s financial systems. From businesses to banks, there is a clear, collective ambition for a simpler, faster, safer and more resilient payment system; one that can move and settle money quickly and efficiently, with minimized risk and much more transparency.

Fnality Global Payments

We are building a network of new payment systems that will enable tokenised, peer-to-peer markets.

Fnality Global Payments (FnGP) will comprise a series of national systems, each regulated in its home jurisdiction. We call each of these a Fnality Payment System (FnPS).

In each payment system, a Fnality settlement asset will act as the settlement/payment asset for any Payment (P), Delivery v, Payment (DvP) or payment vs. payment (PvP) need.

FnGP are underpinned by Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). The nature of DLT is such that it enables FnGP to:

  • Operate a true peer-to-peer market

  • Allow for immediate settlement

  • Interoperate across business platforms and jurisdictions

The key benefits of the above are:

  • Reduced counter-party and credit risk

  • Reduced operational risk

  • Efficient liquidity management

  • An ability to move resources from risk mitigation to business growth

Eligibility

This Head of Risk role is with the entity running the US FnPS, it is a Connecticut based role and you must be eligible to work in the US. Please note we cannot sponsor visas for this role.

How will we use the information about you?

We will use your personal information to process your application, to enable us to assess your suitability for a role and for other legitimate business purposes such as improving our sites and talent management practices. We may share your data with third parties to achieve these purposes. We will not use or share your information for marketing purposes.

We will take appropriate security measures to safeguard your information in accordance with data protection legislation. If you would like further information about how your information may be processed by us, please contact us at privacy@fnality.org.

title: Directeur/Directrice, Infrastructure et Sécurité
description:
À propos de la compagnie

Plume IA révolutionne la documentation clinique pour les professionnels de la santé au Québec. Notre plateforme d'intelligence artificielle permet aux cliniciens d'économiser des heures chaque semaine sur leurs notes — leur redonnant du temps pour ce qui compte le plus : leurs patients.

Avec plus de 3 500 professionnels qui utilisent déjà notre solution et un marché de 500 000 professionnels de la santé au Québec, nous n'en sommes qu'aux débuts.

Rejoins une équipe qui façonne l'avenir du système de santé québécois. Tu ne feras pas que maintenir des systèmes — tu bâtiras les fondations sur lesquelles repose la confiance de tout un système de santé.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice), Infrastructure et Sécurité pour apporter une direction technique senior sur notre architecture cloud AWS, tout en supervisant notre programme de sécurité et de conformité. Tu relèveras du CTO.

Chez Plume IA, notre équipe DevOps opère l'infrastructure AWS au quotidien. À mesure que notre infrastructure grandit en complexité, on ajoute une couche de direction architecturale senior pour évaluer les décisions de design, les compromis et les risques — ce rôle est cette prochaine étape naturelle, avec la gouvernance de sécurité comme second mandat important.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Fournir une direction technique sur l'architecture de l'infrastructure cloud AWS — évaluer les décisions de design, les compromis et les risques, incluant l'infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK)

  • Diriger la planification et l'exécution des projets de l'équipe DevOps, en collaboration étroite avec les membres de l'équipe

  • Définir les standards CI/CD et accompagner l'évolution technique de l'équipe DevOps

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le CTO sur les décisions d'architecture technique

  • Superviser la gouvernance de sécurité et le programme de conformité (Loi 25, TGV et cadres élargis comme SOC 2 / ISO 27001), incluant la coordination des tests d'intrusion annuel

  • Diriger la réponse aux incidents de sécurité et collaborer au processus d'escalation d'incidents

  • Superviser le déploiement SSO/MFA et les travaux de contrôle d'accès en cours

Ce qu'on recherche

Essentiel :

  • 10+ ans d'expérience en gestion d'infrastructure cloud (idéalement AWS), ou une combinaison équivalente d'expérience en gestion d'infrastructure et d'expérience DevOps hands-on, incluant scalabilité, résilience et coûts

  • 5+ ans d'expérience en gestion de personnel

  • Expérience avec l'infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK ou équivalent)

  • Expérience à définir des standards CI/CD et à accompagner une équipe DevOps dans son évolution technique

  • Solide compréhension des pratiques de sécurité infonuagique (IAM, chiffrement, gestion des secrets, surveillance)

  • Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec le CTO sur les décisions d'architecture technique

  • Bilinguisme français/anglais

Atouts :

  • Expérience en sécurité applicative ou conformité (SOC 2, Loi 25, HIPAA)

  • Certification cloud (AWS Solutions Architect, Security Specialty, etc.)

  • Expérience dans une industrie réglementée (santé, finance)

  • Maîtrise des outils Google Workspace, Atlassian et Vanta.

Conditions

  • Poste entièrement en télétravail avec quelques activités de team building en présentiel

  • 4 semaines de vacances

  • Rémunération compétitive selon l'expérience + options d'achat d'actions

  • Avantages flexibles et évolutifs : allocation santé et mieux-être, télémédecine, et bénéfices additionnels qui grandissent avec l'équipe

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Une entreprise en forte croissance à une étape passionnante

  • Travailler sur un produit qui a un impact direct sur les travailleurs de la santé du système québécois

  • Une petite équipe senior — ton travail est livré et compte vraiment

  • Équipe basée au Québec, culture flexible et conciliation travail-famille

_____________________________________________________________________

About the company

Plume IA is revolutionizing clinical documentation for healthcare professionals in Quebec. Our AI-powered platform saves clinicians hours every week on their notes — giving them back time for what matters most: their patients.

With over 3,500 healthcare professionals already using our platform, and an addressable market of 500,000 healthcare professionals in Quebec, we're just getting started.

Join a team shaping the future of Quebec's healthcare system. You won't just keep systems running — you'll build the foundation an entire healthcare system's trust rests on.

About the role

We're looking for a Head of Infrastructure & Security to bring senior technical direction to our AWS cloud architecture, while overseeing our security and compliance program. You'll report to the CTO.

At Plume IA, our DevOps engineers operate our AWS infrastructure day-to-day. As our infrastructure grows in complexity, we're adding a senior architectural layer to evaluate design decisions, tradeoffs, and risk — this role is that next step, with security governance as an important second mandate.

What you'll do

  • Provide technical direction on AWS cloud infrastructure architecture — evaluating design decisions, tradeoffs, and risk, including infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK)

  • Lead the planning and execution of DevOps team projects, in close collaboration with team members.

  • Define CI/CD and infrastructure standards, and support the DevOps team's technical growth

  • Work closely with the CTO on technical architecture decisions

  • Oversee security governance and the compliance program (Loi 25, TGV and broader frameworks like SOC 2 / ISO 27001), including coordinating yearly penetration testing

  • Lead security incident response and collaborate on incident escalation process

  • Oversee the SSO/MFA rollout and related access-control work already underway

What we're looking for

Must-have:

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure management (AWS preferred), or an equivalent combination of infrastructure management and hands-on DevOps experience, including scalability, resilience, and cost

  • 5+ years of people management experience

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (AWS CDK or equivalent)

  • Experience defining CI/CD standards and mentoring a DevOps function

  • Solid understanding of cloud security practices (IAM, encryption, secrets management, monitoring)

  • Ability to work closely with the CTO on technical architecture decisions

  • Bilingual French/English

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in application security or compliance (SOC 2, Loi 25, HIPAA)

  • Cloud certification (AWS Solutions Architect, Security Specialty, etc.)

  • Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, finance)

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Atlassian, and Vanta tools.

Conditions

  • Fully remote role with occasional in-person team building

  • 4 weeks of vacation

  • Competitive compensation based on experience + stock options

  • Flexible, growing benefits: health & wellness allowance, telemedicine, and additional perks that grow with the team

Why join us

  • A fast-growing company at an exciting stage

  • Work on a product with direct impact on healthcare workers across Quebec's system

  • A small, senior team — your work ships and matters

  • Quebec-based team, flexible culture, work-life balance

title: Production Coordinator II
description:
About Young Goose

Young Goose is a science-driven skincare brand at the intersection of longevity, regenerative aesthetics, and performance biology. We develop advanced skincare products designed to support skin health and longevity at the cellular level.

As we continue to grow our product catalog and supply chain operations, we are looking for an experienced, highly organized Production Coordinator II to help ensure our products are produced accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

About the Role

The Production Coordinator II is responsible for coordinating the day-to-day production activities for an assigned group of products within the Young Goose catalog.

This role manages production timelines, vendor communication, packaging and component readiness, documentation, purchase order coordination, and production follow-through from planning through delivery of finished goods.

The Production Coordinator II reports directly to the Supply Chain Manager and works alongside another Production Coordinator who manages a different portfolio of products. While the coordinators work collaboratively and support shared production processes, each is expected to maintain clear ownership and visibility over their assigned products.

This role is best suited for someone with prior production, supply chain, manufacturing, or CPG experience who can independently manage multiple moving pieces, proactively identify risks, and maintain accurate production records.

What You Will Own

Production Coordination

  • Coordinate production for an assigned portfolio of Young Goose products.

  • Manage production timelines from purchase order placement through manufacturing, quality review, shipment, and delivery.

  • Maintain accurate production schedules and provide clear visibility into the status of each production run.

  • Coordinate production quantities, manufacturing dates, expected completion dates, and delivery timelines with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

  • Proactively follow up with vendors to ensure production remains on schedule.

  • Identify potential production delays, component shortages, capacity constraints, and other risks before they impact inventory availability.

  • Escalate significant production risks or issues to the Supply Chain Manager with clear context and recommended next steps.

Vendor and Manufacturer Management

  • Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for contract manufacturers, packaging suppliers, printers, testing partners, and other vendors supporting assigned products.

  • Request and track production updates, quotations, invoices, lead times, samples, shipping details, and required documentation.

  • Ensure vendors receive accurate production specifications, artwork, quantities, deadlines, and shipping instructions.

  • Follow up on outstanding vendor deliverables and maintain clear documentation of commitments and changes.

  • Help resolve production discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions with vendors and internal teams.

  • Maintain organized vendor communication and records so production history and decisions can be easily referenced.

Materials and Component Coordination

  • Coordinate the availability of formulas, raw materials, bottles, pumps, closures, labels, cartons, inserts, and other components required for production.

  • Track component purchase orders, production timelines, and deliveries.

  • Confirm that required components are available before scheduled manufacturing dates.

  • Compare component requirements against available inventory and outstanding purchase orders.

  • Identify potential shortages, mismatched quantities, or extended lead times and escalate them early.

  • Coordinate the movement of components and materials between suppliers, manufacturers, testing facilities, and fulfillment partners when necessary.

Purchase Orders and Production Records

  • Support the creation, tracking, and reconciliation of production and component purchase orders.

  • Verify quantities, pricing, lead times, and delivery expectations against vendor quotes and internal records.

  • Maintain accurate production trackers, purchase order records, and supporting documentation.

  • Help identify discrepancies between purchase orders, invoices, received quantities, and production records.

  • Ensure production information remains accurate across internal systems and spreadsheets.

Documentation and Quality Coordination

  • Maintain organized production documentation, including specifications, purchase orders, invoices, testing records, quality documentation, samples, and vendor files.

  • Coordinate the collection and organization of required manufacturing and quality documents.

  • Track production samples, approvals, testing requirements, and quality-control checkpoints.

  • Report discrepancies involving product appearance, packaging, labeling, quantities, documentation, or finished goods.

  • Coordinate with the appropriate internal and external partners when production or quality issues require investigation.

  • Support documentation related to product or packaging changes.

Inventory and Production Planning Support

  • Work with the Supply Chain Manager to help align production schedules with inventory needs.

  • Maintain visibility into upcoming production requirements and expected finished-goods availability.

  • Help identify products that may require accelerated production or replenishment.

  • Provide accurate production information to support inventory planning and purchasing decisions.

  • Assist with production planning for launches, promotions, seasonal demand, and other business needs.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with the Supply Chain Manager, fellow Production Coordinator, Product Development, Operations, Creative, Finance, and other internal teams.

  • Communicate production timelines, changes, risks, and dependencies to relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate artwork, label, carton, and packaging updates between internal teams and external vendors.

  • Support new product launches, reformulations, packaging updates, supplier transitions, and other production projects.

  • Participate in production and supply chain meetings and maintain clear follow-up on assigned action items.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in production coordination, supply chain, manufacturing, purchasing, operations, inventory management, or CPG/ Consumer Packaged Goods.

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple production schedules, vendors, purchase orders, or manufacturing projects simultaneously.

  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional communication with external vendors.

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, filters, sorting, conditional formatting, lookup functions such as XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP, and working with structured production or inventory data.

  • Ability to build, maintain, and interpret detailed production trackers and spreadsheets.

  • Ability to independently follow up on outstanding items and keep projects moving without constant supervision.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify inconsistencies, missing information, and production risks.

  • Ability to manage changing priorities and multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Comfortable working independently within a remote team while communicating proactively.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and with external manufacturing partners.

  • Reliable internet access and availability during agreed-upon working hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in the skincare, cosmetics, beauty, or personal-care industry.

  • Experience working with contract manufacturers, cosmetic laboratories, or CPG manufacturing partners.

  • Experience with packaging production, including bottles, pumps, labels, cartons, inserts, or other printed components.

  • Familiarity with bills of materials, production forecasting, inventory planning, and purchasing.

  • Experience reviewing or maintaining manufacturing specifications and quality documentation.

  • Experience supporting product launches, reformulations, or packaging changes.

  • Experience with Asana or another project-management platform.

  • Experience working with Cin7 or other ERP and order management system (OMS) tools.

  • Experience coordinating freight, logistics, or shipments between suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Experience working with vendors across multiple countries or time zones.

title: Maintenance Production Administrator (MPA)
description:
Position Summary

The Maintenance Production Administrator (MPA) is responsible for parts and inventory management and administration in a shop environment.

Pay Range for this position is $23.58 to $29.47 per hour.

#INDSJ

Key Responsibilities

  • Makes purchases, manages inventory, completes warranty recovery and repair order processing utilizing out maintenance management software, "Transman."
  • Maintains an organized and organized workspace and manages current and accurate records per company policy and the government agencies.
  • Executes parts inventory management processes including, conducting physical inventory, parts ordering, reviving, coordination parts pick-up and delivery as well as stocking inventory.

Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, excellent organizational skills, and a working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications are required. The ideal candidate will also be a self-directed person with a positive and professional mindset.

Attributes

Positive, team-oriented individual who is disciplined, dependable, determined, focused, and is open to personal and professional training and development.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability Insurance, Maternity & Parental Leave, Flexible Spending Accounts, Discounted Stock Program, 401K, Employee Awards, Employee Assistance Plan, Wellness Incentive, Tuition Assistance, Career Pathways, and More.

title: Packaging Coördinator
description:
Glacier wordt verenigd door een gedeelde ambitie: ijsroomexpertise van wereldklasse naar elke uithoek van de wereld brengen. Met meer dan 75 jaar ervaring op de Europese markten leveren wij diepvriesproducten van topkwaliteit voor retail-, B2B- en exportpartners. Daarbij bieden wij oplossingen op maat, gebaseerd op uitmuntendheid, innovatie en betrouwbaarheid. Als de derde grootste ijsfabrikant van Europa is onze doelstelling duidelijk: uitgroeien tot de nummer één partner voor private label- en co-manufactured ijsproducten.

Om ons team in Glacier Langemark te versterken, gaan we op zoek naar een (m/v): Packaging Coördinator

Als Packaging Coördinator ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de opvolging van verpakkingsprojecten van A tot Z. Je zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande verpakkingen correct worden geïntroduceerd en geoptimaliseerd, en speelt een cruciale rol in het administratieve proces rond packaging.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Beheren en opvolgen van verpakkingen binnen jouw klantenportfolio

  • Coördineren van de introductie en optimalisatie van verpakkingen

  • Opladen en beheren van stuklijsten (BOM) in digitale systemen

  • Controleren en verwerken van verpakkingsspecificaties en technische fiches

  • Invullen en opvolgen van klantenportalen (incl. artworkbeheer)
