title: Webflow Launch & QA Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Webflow Launch & QA Specialist owns quality assurance and launch readiness across N4's client websites and is responsible for evolving how we test. This is a senior role for someone who has done manual QA at scale, knows exactly where it breaks down, and wants to build the tooling and process that replaces repetitive manual checks with automation. Beyond QA, the role covers content migrations, CRM and marketing integrations, and SEO/AEO implementation. Working closely with Technical Delivery Leads, developers, and strategists, you'll make sure every site that leaves N4 is technically sound, content-accurate, and optimised for visibility and conversion.

About N4 Studio

N4 Studio is a global digital agency of around 60 people, specialising in Webflow design, development, and growth. We hold the distinction of being Webflow’s number one agency partner in the world.

We operate fully remote, with clients and teammates across North America, the UK, New Zealand, and Australia. Our culture is built for international collaboration: clear communication, shared ownership, and a genuine respect for people doing great work regardless of where they are located.

Who you Are

  • 5+ years experience in a digital agency or hands-on web role, with a significant portion in QA or launch/release management

  • Proven experience owning QA for website builds or migrations end-to-end, not just executing test scripts written by someone else

  • Hands-on experience building or implementing test automation, e.g. automated regression checks, link/crawl monitoring, visual regression tools, or scripted QA workflows (Playwright, Cypress, or similar)

  • Comfortable writing basic scripts (JavaScript, Python, or similar) to automate repetitive checks, or confident scoping this work for a developer to build

  • Deep understanding of SEO fundamentals and technical SEO best practices, including schema markup, metadata management, and indexing controls

  • Comfortable working with content-heavy websites and structured CMS environments, including large-scale content migrations

  • Strong working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog, and SEMRush, ideally with experience automating or scheduling parts of these workflows

  • Experience supporting CRM and marketing integrations, ideally HubSpot, including form logic, lead routing, and tracking validation

  • Familiarity with the Webflow platform specifically, including its CMS, staging/publishing workflow, and API is a strong plus

  • Methodical, organised, and reliable under delivery pressure, with the judgement to prioritise issues based on risk, impact, and launch timelines

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, you can document findings clearly and explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders

  • A track record of improving a QA process, not just following one

What you will be Doing

  • Owning website QA prior to launch, including content accuracy, functionality, and technical checks

  • Designing and running structured pre-launch and post-launch audits to ensure sites meet N4 standards

  • Identifying which parts of the QA process can be automated, and building or specifying the tooling to do it, reducing reliance on manual, repetitive testing over time

  • Managing content migrations including content mapping, validation, and quality control

  • Ensuring SEO and AEO fundamentals are implemented correctly before launch

  • Reviewing and validating metadata, schema markup, indexing rules, redirects, and internal linking

  • Identifying and resolving issues such as broken links, 404s, redirect errors, and crawl issues, ideally via automated monitoring rather than manual checks

  • Supporting CRM and marketing integrations including forms, lead routing, and tracking setup

  • Validating analytics and conversion tracking in GA4 and related tools

  • Monitoring post-launch performance and flagging issues or optimisation opportunities

  • Collaborating with Technical Delivery Leads and developers to resolve issues efficiently and to build automated checks into the delivery pipeline

  • Documenting QA findings, migration notes, launch sign-offs, and the automation tooling/processes you build, so they're maintainable by the wider team

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work environment with a globally distributed team.

  • Work with a leading Webflow partner agency.

  • Opportunity to impact processes and build innovative tools.

  • Collaborative and inclusive culture that values creativity and respect.

title: Senior Counsel
description:
About the role

We’re in an exciting new chapter at Reverb as an independent marketplace, and we’re seeking a Senior Counsel to join as the second lawyer on our legal team. This role offers a rare opportunity to join at a pivotal moment, help define how legal empowers our business, and contribute to a mission centered on making the world more musical.

You’ll operate at the intersection of law, product, payments, trust & safety, and operations, advising on complex, evolving issues while helping design practical, business-forward solutions. This is a full-time position located in Chicago, reporting to Reverb’s General Counsel. Our hybrid work model offers flexible workplace policies that can accommodate local candidates who are comfortable working from home and traveling to the office 4+ times per month.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a legal partner for marketplace-related issues, including fraud prevention, payments regulation, consumer protection, and marketplace tax compliance.
  • Advise cross-functional teams on product development, new initiatives, and operational processes to ensure compliance and mitigate risk.
  • Partner in building the legal function by designing, implementing, and scaling legal operations infrastructure, including contract lifecycle management, playbooks and templates, workflow automation, and documented legal workflows.
  • Proactively identify emerging legal and regulatory issues impacting online marketplaces and translate them into practical business guidance.
  • Serve as a go-to legal partner for day-to-day issues, while designing and refining practical legal frameworks, templates, and processes to support efficient, compliant operations.
  • Serve as a legal partner for commercial contracting, advising on structure and risk while drafting and negotiating artist, brand, technology, vendor, and licensing agreements.
  • Collaborate with and manage outside counsel as needed

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of legal experience, including in-house experience.

  • Commercial contracting experience, including drafting and negotiating a broad range of agreements such as artist partnerships, SaaS/technology, vendor, and licensing agreements.
  • Working knowledge of privacy laws and compliance frameworks, and experience partnering with cross-functional teams to operationalize legal requirements.

  • Proven ability to translate complex legal and regulatory issues into practical, business-focused guidance.

  • Strong communicator and trusted partner, able to influence across teams such as Product, Payments, Trust & Safety, Finance, and Operations.
  • Comfortable creating structure where it doesn’t yet exist, including building policies, templates, workflows, and scalable legal processes.
  • Highly organized and process-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities and both strategic and day-to-day legal needs.

Additional Information

Reverb offers a comprehensive total rewards package that combines base, bonus, and an array of benefits. Some of our key benefits include but are not limited to the following:

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
THE COMPANY

Lumion is redefining how architecture is communicated in the era of AI, from early concepts to final presentations. Our expanding portfolio helps architects, designers, and visualisation professionals communicate ideas with speed, clarity, and emotion, while making it easier for teams and stakeholders to collaborate around design.

We’re a passionate, international team of developers, designers, architects, and visualisation specialists looking to define how the AEC space collaborates on bringing design concepts to life. With a team across our Netherlands HQ, Denmark, Poland and a globally distributed remote workforce, we are at an exciting inflection point: new leadership, a growing product portfolio, and a market being rapidly reshaped by AI. The convergence of 3D rendering, real-time engines, and generative AI is accelerating, and we intend to lead it.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Frontend Developer to architect the next generation of our application UI. You will be instrumental in migrating our interface to a modern, web-based stack (React, TypeScript) integrated via Coherent Gameface. This is not a standard web-app role; you will work at the intersection of web technology and high-performance game engine architecture. You will define our design system, establish foundational patterns for our component library, and lead the incremental migration strategy that replaces our legacy UI while ensuring seamless product delivery and architectural integrity.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript, with a proven ability to architect clean, scalable, and type-safe component libraries, including proven usage with styling (e.g., HTML5, CSS, animations) and experience with web build tools (e.g., Webpack).

  • Experience working in embedded or game-engine environments (e.g., Coherent Gameface, CEF, or similar) where optimizing for resource constraints and understanding the native-to-web bridge is critical.

  • A strong track record of managing complex incremental migrations, successfully balancing the delivery of new features with the systematic deprecation and replacement of legacy code.

  • Deep architectural judgment; you understand the trade-offs between different state management patterns and know how to design interfaces that remain maintainable as the codebase grows.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both design and engine teams to ensure the UI is performant, responsive, and visually cohesive, with a strong passion for building beautiful interfaces and working closely with designers to create exceptional experiences for our users.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • UI Architecture: Designing decoupled, modular, and testable systems.

  • Bridge Design: Experience defining robust, type-safe contracts/interfaces between native C++ systems and the frontend environment.

  • Performance Profiling: Skill in identifying and resolving bottlenecks in rendering and interaction within game-integrated environments.

  • Migration Strategy: Proven ability to define and execute "strangler pattern" refactoring paths without disrupting ongoing product development.

  • Technical Communication: Ability to translate complex engine requirements into clean, usable frontend patterns.

YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF

  • You are excited by the challenge of bridging the gap between web-standard development and the high-performance constraints of a 3D rendering engine.

  • You value "Process, Not Outcome" – you enjoy building the systems and documentation that allow the entire team to move faster.

  • You are comfortable working in a hybrid environment where you influence both the UI and the underlying bridge logic that connects to the engine.

  • You want to define the future of AEC software, where 3D rendering, real-time engines, and generative AI converge.

title: 2nd Shift Operator
description:
Job Title: Operator

Location: Greenleaf, WI

Manager: Gas Production Supervisor

Pay Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

Shift: 2nd Shift (2:30pm-11pm)

Job Summary

Performs various duties essential to the operation of a dairy-based, natural gas production facility which utilizes mechanical and biological systems to process cow manure into renewable natural gas (RNG). These duties include monitoring, operating, processing, maintaining, and optimizing a wide variety of assets and systems located at the assigned facility; collection of samples (gases and manure); preparation and dissemination of various written documents and reports; other duties assigned by management. This position will include participation in an on-call rotation and may require work outside normal business hours. On-call operators are required to live not further than a 45-minute drive from their assigned facility. Direct supervision may be limited.


Sagepoint Energy embodies core values of dependability, excellence, and integrity.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Performs all duties in a manner that is safe, compliant, and efficient as well as productive.
  • Operates the full range of mechanical and biological assets at the facility. These may include manure transfer pumps and piping, anaerobic digesters, equipment for sulfur sequestration, biogas upgrading systems, emissions controls, analytical instrumentation, gas compression for tube trailer loadout or pipeline injection, and the facility SCADA.
  • Become subject matter expert (SME) of full gas production process to ensure optimal production performance at their assigned facility; record and analyze production data to identify trends, anomalies, or potential issues.
  • Respond to alarms and operational issues promptly and effectively.
  • Performs a variety of process and quality control related duties including collecting, analyzing, packaging, and shipping, documenting, and reporting samples of various gases, liquids, and solids.
  • Conducts standard maintenance activities required at the assigned facility.
  • Operates offroad utility vehicles such as skid steers, loaders, forklifts, and UTV's, as well as light trucks inside and outside of the facility as needed.
  • Conducts elevated work and/or confined space entries as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental, health and safety regulations/requirements.
  • Participates and engages in all required training, both in-person sessions and remote learning modules, in all required fields. Training topics may include various safe work practices and protocols and equipment operation and maintenance as well as company specific procedures, policies, and processes.
  • Adheres to every safety policy and procedure. These will include procedures for: control of hazardous energy (Lock-out/Tag-out), incident reporting, spill response, fire response, confined space entry, hazardous atmosphere operations, hot work, safe electrical work, and others.
  • Comfortable with some overtime hours and on-call hours

Education/Experience is required when indicated, desired otherwise.

  • Undergraduate degree in an applicable field, e.g., maintenance or engineering (electrical, mechanical, or industrial) or 3+ years' experience in the same.
  • General mechanical aptitude (required)
  • Valid driver's license (required)
  • Basic computer literacy (i.e., sufficient familiarity to know/learn and utilize Microsoft Office Suite, computerized maintenance management systems, and computerized procurement/inventory systems) (required)

Physical Demand

Field work will include work outside and exposed to the weather, high elevations, confined spaces, electrical components, both stationary and rotating equipment, manure and other agricultural wastes, gases and liquids that are compressed/pressurized, toxic, caustic, or acidic, and/or flammable, dust, exposure to high heat/cold weather, high winds, and high noise.


The physical demands described next are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


Satisfactory performance of the essential duties of this job will require standing, kneeling, sitting, and walking as well as fine motor skills (especially of the hands) and the extended reach of arms. Climbing, balancing, stooping, crouching, and crawling will be required. Regular senses of smell, hearing, and sight are required. The capacity to occasionally lift up to 75 pounds is required.


Work Environment

The duties of this job will include working both in an office environment and outdoors in the year-round weather as well as inside industrial spaces with operating machinery. Exposure to high heat and high humidity as well as cold weather and high winds can be expected. This job also includes potential exposure to high noise, fumes or airborne particles, chemicals, acids and caustic chemicals, flammable and/or poisonous atmospheres, hot surfaces/equipment, cold surfaces/equipment, high vibrations, confined spaces, elevated working surfaces, vehicle traffic, and animal manure.


Compensation

Salary is paid on a bi-weekly basis and will be consummate with the value and experience the candidate brings to the role. title: Sr Advisor III, Application Development
description:
Phillips 66 & YOU - Together we can fuel the future

As a Sr Advisor III, Application Development / Full Stack Product Engineer on our Commercial technology team, you will lead the design, delivery, and evolution of strategic, trader-facing applications that turn complex data into intuitive tools. You’ll manage a team of developers while also staying close to the code, shaping how traders, analysts, and data scientists access insights and make decisions. This is a chance to work near the desks on high-impact problems, building modern, API-first experiences over governed data products at Phillips 66.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and maintenance of strategic, business-critical applications that power trader- and analyst-facing platforms, ensuring they are reliable, secure, and performant.
  • Partner with traders, strategists, analysts, and data scientists to understand workflows, elicit complex business requirements, and translate them into intuitive tools, dashboards, and applications.
  • Define and maintain the application roadmap, including feasibility studies, cost-benefit analyses, and release plans that align with business priorities and governed data products.
  • Lead the design and build of modern user interfaces and APIs (for example, React front ends and Python/REST back ends) and oversee the full software development life cycle from concept through deployment and ongoing enhancements.
  • Analyze current (“as is”) and future (“to be”) business processes and data flows, identify gaps, and drive scalable solutions that simplify the user experience and accelerate question-to-decision time.
  • Plan, prioritize, and manage project work, budgets, and resources; assign and review work for a diverse development team and guide them toward high-quality delivery.
  • Establish and champion engineering standards, development practices, and deployment approaches (including CI/CD, versioning, and zero-downtime updates) that keep the platform maintainable and easy to extend.
  • Monitor platform usage, performance, and feedback, using data and insights to optimize features, improve adoption, and ensure the platform remains a thin, trusted layer over governed data products.
  • Provide expert technical and business advice to partners across IT and Commercial, helping teams navigate trade-offs, resolve complex issues, and shape future capabilities.

What You’ll Bring - Required

  • Legally authorized to work in the job posting country
  • Bachelors degree
  • 6 or more years of lead-level full-stack development experience with a track record of owning and supporting production web applications end-to-end.
  • Advanced proficiency in React or comparable front-end frameworks with a focus on user experience and information-dense interfaces.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python backend/API development skills using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django, including integration with enterprise data platforms.
  • Intermediate proficiency developing production web applications using modern front-end frameworks such as React.
  • Intermediate proficiency building and integrating backend services and REST APIs using languages such as Python.

What Makes You Stand Out - Preferred

  • 8 or more years of experience owning production web applications end to end in a lead or senior engineering role.
  • Experience building tools, dashboards, or platforms for traders, analysts, or other expert, time-pressured users.
  • Background in commodities, energy, trading, or financial markets.
  • Experience designing information-dense user interfaces and data- or BI-heavy applications, including real-time data or visualization libraries.
  • Experience working with governed data products, semantic layers, or lakehouse APIs.
  • Demonstrated ability to define future-state architectures, lead change, and drive continuous improvement across teams.

Compensation Range

This position has a base salary range of $180,900 - $221,100. This role is eligible to participate in the company’s commercial bonus program, offering the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on business and individual performance, in accordance with program guidelines.

At Phillips 66, we are committed to pay transparency and competitive, equitable compensation. Each role is assigned a salary grade with a defined pay range, benchmarked against industry peers. Where a candidate offer falls within the posted range depends on the candidate's experience, skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. Offers are made to ensure internal equity and market competitiveness. Our compensation programs are designed to reward performance and support career growth.

The Commercial organization works to effectively leverage assets and market knowledge to create additional value within the risk parameters of the Company. We do this by maximizing general interest profitability, enhancing return on capital employed by successfully partnering with the Refining, Transportation and Marketing functions to ensure Value Chain Integration. Our truck and rail fleets support our feedstock and distribution operations. Rail movements are provided via a fleet of more than 10,000 owned and leased rail cars. Truck movements are provided through numerous third-party trucking companies, as well as through our 100 percent-owned subsidiary, Sentinel Transportation LLC.

Total Rewards

At Phillips 66, providing access to high quality programs and care for you and your family is important to us. Maintaining a culture of well-being — physical, emotional, social, and financial — is essential for a high-performing organization. When we are at our best, we are poised to deliver exceptional results — personally and professionally. Benefits for certain eligible, full-time employees include:

title: Freelance Website Copywriter / Content Strategist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and experienced Website Copywriter/Content Strategist join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of content-first design principles and be adept at creating compelling, conversion-focused copy that aligns with our clients’ brand voice and goals. In addition to writing, this role requires the ability to produce content wireframes in Figma, outlining page narrative, content hierarchy, and the rough amount of words needed for each section.

About N4 Studio

We're a global digital agency of around 60 people specialising in Webflow design, development, and growth. We're Webflow's number one agency partner globally, which shapes how we work and where we're headed.

We partner with ambitious brands to craft digital experiences that drive growth. With a distributed team across multiple time zones, we move fast, think strategically, and bring A-team energy to everything we do.

What this Actually Is

This isn't a full-time role, and it's not a one-off gig either. We're building a pool of trusted copywriters with strong strategic skills who we can call on as projects come in.

Here's how it works: when a project lands that fits your skills, we'll reach out with the scope, timeline, and a fixed project rate. You say yes or no based on your availability. If it works, great. If not, no hard feelings, we'll come back around next time.

The writers who thrive in this arrangement are usually juggling a few clients and like the flexibility, but also want something consistent to return to rather than always hunting for the next thing. Projects come in waves so there will be quiet patches, but when we're on, we move quickly.

What the Work Looks Like

Our projects are website builds for B2B and B2C clients across a wide range of industries. Content work typically splits into two phases:

The first is narrative & messaging strategy, which involves: working closely alongside the project designer to develop the narrative and messaging direction for the site. This culminates in a client-facing presentation of strategic content recommendations and initial copy concepts.

The second is copywriting: taking the foundational work from the first phase and developing it into polished, SEO/AEO-optimised, on-brand website copy, from first draft through revision rounds to design handoff.

Who you Are

  • Strong track record writing website copy across various industries and brands, including businesses with complex offerings

  • Skilled at shifting voice and tone across projects without losing sharpness or clarity

  • Deep understanding of the relationship between copy and design, with experience working in or alongside design teams

  • Comfortable working directly in Figma, since all content work is produced and presented there alongside the project designer

  • Solid grasp of SEO/AEO principles and how content performs in search, including AI-assisted search

  • Experience running content strategy workshops or leading clients through messaging development is a strong plus

  • Methodical and collaborative, with the ability to take feedback from designers, strategists, and clients and translate it into sharper copy

To apply, please share the following:

  • Your hourly rate, please include the currency your rates are in.

  • A short note (a paragraph is fine) on the types of web copy projects you've worked on and where you'd place yourself on the spectrum from junior through to senior. This helps us understand where you fit before we bring you into a project.

  • A link to your portfolio or a couple of web copy examples. Please note we can't consider applications without this.

Location

Fully remote. We work with writers across New Zealand, the UK, Europe, North America, and beyond. So wherever you are, if your work is strong, we want to hear from you.

title: Production Tech III, II, I or CRO
description:
Job Title: Production Tech III, II, I or CRO

PS Job Title: Production Technician I

Work Place Flexibility: Onsite

Legal Entity: Entergy Louisiana, LLC

THIS POSITION CAN BE FILLED BY PRODUCTION TECHNICIAN III, II, I, CRO

JOB SUMMARY/DESCRIPTION:

Operate and maintain systems associated with a Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) facility while demonstrating safety awareness and direction that will continuously improve performance by employees and contractors through the use and strict adherence to procedures and processes.

JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain regulatory compliance and be proactive in dealing with all agencies and avoid reportable violations
  • Required participation in the multi-year Production Technician multi skill progression plan to develop key skills in maintenance and operations. Upon completion the employee should have the desire, aptitude and ability to meet board operator qualification
  • Conduct and participate in job briefings and safety meetings. Be responsible for Contractor Safety and conduct Contractor Safety Orientations as needed
  • Applies understanding and knowledge of plant systems, burner controls (where applicable), turbine controls, data acquisition, process controls, regulating devices, personal computers, troubleshooting, etc.
  • Operational duties include, but not limited to, operating the control board, making operational rounds, performing PM/PDM activities, HRSG water chemistry, CEMS monitoring and calibrations
  • Applies skills to perform inspections, calibrations, installations, repairs, diagnostics, testing and troubleshooting of complex instrumentation equipment and regulating devices in a CCGT facility, alone and as part of a team. Perform mechanical work involved in inspection, repair and installation of instrumentation and electrical equipment, and light PM of mechanical systems

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Minimum education:

  • 2 Year Associate's Degree in Industrial Electronics, Instrumentation/Controls or Production/Process Technology or equivalent work experience

Minimum experience:

  • PTECH III: 0-2 years’ experience in a CCGT facility in an Operations or Maintenance position; or 4 years of power plant operations/maintenance/electrical experience
  • PTECH II – CRO, SR: 2-5 years’ experience in a CCGT facility in an Operations or Maintenance position; or 5 years of power plant operations/maintenance/electrical experience

***Either the minimum education or minimum experience requirements must be met by the applicant for job consideration***

Minimum skills:

  • Must be good at communicating, both verbal and written, the results of evaluation of assignments to supervision
  • Ability to interpret and comprehend P&ID's, electrical schematics, network diagrams and OEM manuals

Minimum Certifications/Licensing/Testing:

  • Successful completion of the EEI POSS/MASS Test

WORK CONDITIONS

Employees are required to work 12 hour shifts with both day and night rotations. Working environment frequently requires exposure to extreme ambient conditions ranging from hot humid environments to freezing temperatures in winter months. Employees are required to climb stairs, ladders and walk or stand for extended periods. Overtime and callouts during holidays, nights and off days should be expected on a routine basis. Use of personal computer applications is necessary daily to log equipment data, log time worked and to communicate with various levels of our organization. Skills in Microsoft Word and Excel are very beneficial. As a provider of essential services, Entergy expects its employees to be available to work additional hours, to work in alternate locations, and/or to perform additional duties in connection with storms, outages, emergencies, or other situations as deemed necessary by the company. Exempt employees may not be paid overtime associated with such duties.

title: Partner Success Advisor
description:
Job Title: Partner Success Advisor

Location: Remote, USA

Compensation: $80,000-$100,000/year plus commission

About HBA

The Healthcare Businesswomen’s Association (HBA) is a global leadership accelerator, business growth partner, and enterprise solution for the healthcare and life sciences industries. As a nonpartisan, global organization active in more than 80 countries, we remain focused on building a healthcare workforce that reflects the patients it serves. Our vision is clear: We are Creating Leaders for Life.

Position Summary

The Partner Success Advisor (PSA) serves as the strategic relationship leader for a portfolio of HBA Corporate Partners. Acting as a trusted advisor and extension of each partner's team, the PSA aligns HBA solutions with organizational priorities, develops executive relationships, and creates measurable value through enterprise partnership management. Unlike a traditional account management role, this position combines strategic consulting, customer success, business development, and relationship leadership to strengthen partnerships, expand enterprise engagement, and drive sustainable revenue growth. The Partner Success Advisor is a strategic growth leader responsible for maximizing the value of HBA's Corporate Partner relationships. Through trusted advisory, strategic planning, AI-enabled account management, and cross-functional collaboration, this role deepens enterprise partnerships, expands organizational engagement, and contributes directly to HBA's long-term growth and mission.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned Corporate Partners and maintain and expand active working relationships with executive and senior leaders.

  • Develop annual Joint Success Plans with measurable objectives, quarterly milestones, and revenue forecast.

  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews focused on enterprise-level business outcomes, partnership performance, financial and strategic value.

  • Identify and lead enterprise growth opportunities aligned with partner priorities.

  • Develop and lead corrective action plans for at-risk Corporate Partner relationships, including executive intervention strategies, revised value propositions, recovery milestones, and internal accountability measures.

  • Develop and lead executive briefings and account intelligence using approved AI tools.

  • Maintain accurate partner information, forecasts, and relationship history within Protech CRM.

  • Coordinate internal resources to execute partner initiatives.

  • Represent HBA at partner meetings, conferences, and events.

  • Identifies recurring partner needs and market trends and recommends changes to HBA programs, partner offerings, pricing, processes, and engagement strategies.

  • Develops reusable account-planning tools, success-plan templates, business-review standards, and partner-health practices.

  • Shares market intelligence with executive leadership and Business Development to inform organizational strategy, product development, and revenue planning.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, Communications, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of education.

  • Seven or more years in enterprise account management, customer success, strategic partnerships, consulting, healthcare, SaaS, or association management.

  • At least three years of direct responsibility for executive-level relationships, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts, or complex organizational partnerships.

  • Demonstrated experience developing strategic account plans, leading executive business reviews, managing revenue forecasts, and coordinating cross-functional solution delivery.

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, communication, and strategic planning skills.

  • Experience with CRM platforms, Microsoft 365, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Executive relationship management

  • Strategic account planning

  • Complex partnership management

  • Revenue forecasting

  • Data interpretation

  • Executive presentations

  • Cross-functional leadership

  • CRM proficiency (ProTech, Salesforce, etc)

  • Documented success meeting retention and growth objectives

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare or life sciences sector experience

  • Hands-on experience with ProTech CRM

  • CoPilot for Sales or comparable AI sales tools experience

  • Association or Non-profit experience

  • Management of global/international accounts

Benefits:

  • The HBA offers a benefits package to full-time and qualified part-time employees through Aetna, which includes: 100% coverage of employee premium for base-level medical, dental, vision insurance and an allowance towards any dependents of 50% of premium costs.

  • A 401(k)-retirement plan which you are eligible for on date of hire through Human Interest. HBA will offer up to a 2% match that is deposited with every payroll.

  • Flexible spending accounts are also available for pre-tax contributions including FSA/HSA. Your eligibility for these benefits is subject to specific requirements and other terms, conditions, and restrictions in the applicable policy and/or plan.

  • 2 weeks of vacation annually earned with each pay period (maximum of 40 hours carryover)

  • One week of office shutdown pay between the US holidays of Christmas and New Year’s Day annually

  • 13 standard US holidays

  • 5 "floating holidays" per year (equivalent of 40 hours) can be used at any time and for any occasion you choose

  • Summer Friday employee benefit: office closes at Noon, local time, starting the Friday before Memorial Day through the first week of October

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, and gender expression), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Job Description:
This job is responsible for defining an architectural vision and solution that supports the strategic outcomes of the Business' Products and Services. Key responsibilities include defining the target operating environment, designing for client resiliency, assisting with solution design, and defining non-functional requirements. Job expectations include working with stakeholders and service providers aligned to the Business' strategic objectives, evaluating the impact of strategic design decisions, and contributing to the architecture roadmap.

  • This role is responsible for defining the architectural vision and technology solutions that support business products and services. As applications, sensitive data, and data volumes grow, the role drives scalable, secure, and efficient architectures that enable effective data management, resiliency, and operational excellence.
  • The role partners closely with stakeholders, technology teams, and service providers to evaluate architectural decisions, guide technology investments, and maintain enterprise architecture blueprints, frameworks, and reference models.

Responsibilities:

  • Works across the business, operations and technology to create the solution intent and architectural vision for complex solutions and prioritize functional and non-functional requirements into a technology backlog to enable the technology roadmap and functionality to support evolving capabilities and services
  • Contributes to the creation of the architecture roadmap of defined domains (Business, Application, Data, and Technology) in support of the product roadmap and the development of best practices including standardized templates
  • Clarifies the architecture, assists with system design to support implementation, and provides solution options to resolve any architectural impediments
  • Facilitates solution driven discussions, leads the design of complex architectures, and finds creative solutions through knowledge of domain, practical experiments, and proof of concepts while ensuring architecture is flexible, modular, and adaptable
  • Educates team members on the technology practices, standardization strategies, and best practices to create innovative solutions
  • Supports the team as needed to select the technology stack required for solutions and helps select preferred technology products
  • Performs design and code reviews to ensure all non-functional requirements are sufficiently met (for example, security, performance, maintainability, scalability, usability, and reliability)
  • Define solution architecture and technology strategy for complex business capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain architecture roadmaps across Business, Application, Data, and Technology domains.
  • Establish architecture standards, frameworks, blueprints, and reference models.
  • Lead solution design discussions and provide guidance on complex architectural challenges.
  • Ensure platforms and services are scalable, secure, resilient, interoperable, and performant.
  • Drive adoption of modern engineering and architecture practices, including APIs, microservices, containerization, automation, and hybrid cloud solutions.
  • Define standards for application development, deployment, integration, testing, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions aligned to business and technology objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, risk, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Guide teams in building reusable, enterprise-scale services and transitioning proofs of concept into production solutions.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience designing enterprise-scale applications, platforms, and data solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud, APIs, microservices, and modern architecture patterns.
  • Experience developing architecture standards, roadmaps, and governance practices.
  • Knowledge of security, resiliency, risk, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience with data management, governance, and enterprise integration.
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automation, and observability practices.
  • Architecture certifications (e.g., TOGAF) and/or cloud certifications.

title: Senior Strategy Consultant
description:
Intro

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in banking.

The Evident AI Index forms the basis of our benchmarking products, which help companies to understand their ranking in relation to peers and to accelerate their AI strategy. The Client Delivery team, sitting at the core of Evident’s value proposition to clients, is responsible for delivering bespoke benchmarking analysis to clients and shaping the strategy of our benchmarking products.

Why join us:

  • We are index experts. Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world.

  • We are building a cutting edge research team that uses the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools.

  • We are backed by some of the world’s leading tech investors, including the backers of Revolut and the tech commentator Scott Galloway, and have built a network of advisors that includes the Global AI Lead at AWS, Mastercard’s President of Cyber & Intelligence, Ocado’s former CTO, the former CCO of the Alan Turing Institute, the Chair of the UK Government AI Council and the former Head of the UK Government Office for AI.

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI here. Our commitments to diversity and inclusion are set out at the end of this job description.

The Role

We are seeking sharp, analytical and strategically minded individuals who are interested in working with C-Suite decision makers at the world’s largest financial institutions to shape AI strategies.

As part of our Client Delivery team, you will apply strategic thinking and analytical rigour to support the delivery of bespoke benchmarking analysis to clients (comparing their AI maturity against peers and industry leaders), playing a pivotal role in contributing to the team’s overarching goal of building high levels of client engagement and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Structuring and preparing content for clients - leveraging data and insights from the Index, Data and Intelligence teams to produce bespoke analysis for clients

  • Strategic analysis - applying analytical rigour to content preparation by interpreting data, developing insights and identifying strengths and opportunities

  • Subject matter expertise - developing expertise in how AI is used in financial services, including up to date examples of case studies and impact to date

  • Relationship management - supporting client management across the lifecycle: from onboarding, through all deliverables and touchpoints within the year

  • Facilitation - leading recurrent client touchpoints, supporting team members in the presentation of benchmarking content to clients.

  • Product development - support product development by sharing client feedback to evolve benchmarking products and providing input on practical ways in which the feedback can be incorporated into existing or new products.

Core Skills

  • 4+ years of experience: ideally in strategy consulting, financial services or another role that involved the key responsibilities listed above

  • Proven experience in producing strategic, analytical content for clients through data and insights, and structuring presentations from scratch.

  • Ability to proactively identify client needs and opportunities to deliver exceptional value to clients

  • Attention to detail and highly organised: able to support the team in managing multiple clients and deadlines in parallel

  • Collaborative: proven experience of working effectively with a range of cross-functional team members

  • Proactive: you take ownership without being asked

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you communicate concisely and effectively with stakeholders, internally and externally

  • Understanding of AI applications in large-scale organisations, with particular relevance to the Financial Services industry.

If you do not fulfil all requirements in the job description, we encourage you to submit your application nonetheless.

Benefits

  • Share options: we offer all employees share options over a 4 year vesting period

  • Holidays: 28 days of holiday + public bank holidays

  • Flexible working: 3-4 days per week in our Central London office, 1-2 days remote

  • Learning & development budget: £1000/year

  • Pension

  • Private health insurance

Our commitments to diversity and inclusion

  • Evident is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating all forms of discrimination. Our aim is for our workforce to be truly representative of all sections of society and our customers, and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best.

  • During our recruitment process, you will not be discriminated against for any of the following reasons: race (including colour, nationality, ethnic and national origin), age, disability, gender reassignment, being married or in a civil partnership, being pregnant or on maternity leave, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need us to make certain changes (known as reasonable adjustments) to make sure you are not disadvantaged during the recruitment process, you should contact us as soon as possible.

  • We strive to create a working environment free of bullying, harassment, victimisation and discrimination, promote dignity and respect for all, and value and recognise individual differences and the contributions of all staff.

title: Sr. Program Manager
description:
Sr. Program Manager, Data Center Buildouts

About ByteBridge

ByteBridge is a widely trusted innovator of IT services, including data center, enterprise IT, and unified communications. Founded by a team of passionate experts, ByteBridge aims to achieve customer success through technology enablement, bridging technical gaps to help enterprises expand globally. The company has gained trust from some of the world's leading international companies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager, Data Center Buildouts to lead the planning, coordination, and execution of data center buildouts across Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and Power Delivery systems. This role owns the buildout lifecycle across multiple concurrent sites, coordinating contracted labor and ByteBridge field resources to ensure installations are delivered safely, on schedule, and to specification.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of low voltage, liquid cooling, and power delivery systems with hands-on program management experience, contractor oversight, and the ability to direct both third-party crews and internal field personnel in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.

Work Location

Hybrid — Hayward, CA; Manassas, VA; or Houston, TX, with travel to project sites as needed (~25%, domestic and occasional international)

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead data center buildouts across Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and Power Delivery from project kickoff through commissioning and handoff

  • Coordinate and direct contractors and ByteBridge field resources during day-to-day buildout activities

  • Develop and maintain buildout schedules, staffing plans, and resource forecasts across multiple workstreams

  • Manage contractor relationships, including qualification, RFP/bidding, contract negotiation, contract management, and performance

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including pre-sales engineering, network, service delivery, and vendors, to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to specification

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for buildout issues, schedule delays, and field-level risks while driving mitigation plans

  • Review installation drawings, specifications, BIM models, and change orders to validate scope and identify dependencies or conflicts

  • Manage project budgets, purchase orders, cost tracking, vendor invoicing, profitability, and change orders

  • Oversee inspections and regulatory/code compliance for low voltage, cooling, and electrical work

  • Prepare executive-level program updates, including status dashboards, risk registers, and milestone reporting

  • Drive commissioning readiness and transition projects from buildout to live operations

  • Lead project closeout, including final documentation, punch-list resolution, and stakeholder sign-off

  • Conduct post-buildout reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future program planning and processes

  • Represent ByteBridge in customer meetings, site walks, and executive delivery reviews

  • Mentor and direct ByteBridge field resources and project managers supporting individual workstreams

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of program or project management experience in data center buildouts, mission-critical facilities, or large-scale infrastructure environments

  • Proven experience managing multiple concurrent buildout projects involving Low Voltage, Liquid Cooling, and/or Power Delivery

  • Strong working knowledge of low voltage systems, liquid cooling infrastructure, including CDUs, RDHx, piping and manifolds, and power delivery/electrical distribution

  • Experience coordinating and directing contractors and internal field resources on active job sites

  • Experience managing contractors and vendors, including RFP/bidding and contract negotiation

  • Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets, cost tracking, and change order processes

  • Proficiency with scheduling and project management tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Procore, Smartsheet, or similar platforms

  • Ability to read and interpret installation drawings, specifications, and BIM models using platforms such as Autodesk ACC and Revit

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with field teams and executive leadership

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred

  • Willingness to travel to project sites as needed (~25%, domestic and occasional international)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP or PgMP certification, or equivalent program management credential

  • Experience delivering hyperscale or colocation data center buildouts supporting AI and high-density computing environments

  • Familiarity with liquid cooling manufacturers such as NVIDIA, Vertiv, CoolIT Systems, Motivair, and Schneider Electric, as well as low voltage and power delivery vendors

  • Experience directly managing internal field technicians alongside contractor crews

  • Experience managing geographically distributed buildout sites simultaneously

  • Background in commissioning processes for mission-critical facilities

title: ASL/BASL Video Contributor – Remote Paid Project ($700)
description:
About the Project

DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.

The goal of this project is to help make technology more accessible for everyone and promote greater inclusion of Deaf and signing communities in the development of future technologies.

What You’ll Do

Participants will record approximately 1,000 short ASL/BASL videos from home, including phrases, numbers, fingerspelling sequences, and conversational prompts.

Each recording is approximately 10 seconds long. Completing the full set is expected to take approximately 10 hours in total.

The project can be completed remotely from home using a compatible Apple device.

Compensation

$700 USD for completing the project according to the study guidelines.

This is a project-based opportunity and not a full-time employment position.

Who Can Participate

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older

  • Be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL) and/or Black American Sign Language (BASL)

  • Currently reside in the United States, excluding Texas, Illinois, and Washington

  • Be able to understand written English instructions

  • Be comfortable recording yourself on video

  • Have a suitable environment at home for recording

  • Have access to a compatible Apple device:

    • iPhone 12 or newer

    • iPad 9th Generation (2021) or newer

    • MacBook with M1 chip or newer

    • iMac with M1 chip or newer

Why Participate?

Your contribution will help support the development of technologies that better recognize and represent ASL, BASL, and diverse signing communities.

You'll participate entirely from home, complete the recordings on your own schedule according to the project instructions, and receive $700 USD upon successful completion of the project according to the study guidelines.

How to Apply

Click Apply and complete the short application.

Our DataForce team will review your information and contact eligible participants with the next steps and detailed project instructions.

title: Chief Community Officer
description:
Title: Chief Community Officer

Specifications: Permanent, Full Time

Salary: Due to the variety of possible global south locations for this role, a single salary range is not applicable. Compensation will be benchmarked using a specialist independent third party and tailored to the successful candidate's location.

Location: We are a remote-first organisation. The successful candidate will be an established and credible Cochrane leader who is based in, from, or has strong professional and leadership roots in the Global South, with substantial experience of evidence synthesis and collaboration across complex international networks.

Closing date: 10 September 2026

Interview dates: expected to be held remotely on 28th & 29th September 2026.

Cochrane is a global, independent network committed to producing trusted evidence to support better health decisions. We are entering an important period of transformation as the evidence ecosystem changes rapidly, with growing demand for timely, living, interoperable and decision-ready evidence.

The Chief Community Officer (CCO) is the executive leader responsible for shaping and delivering Cochrane’s global community strategy. The role will strengthen the contribution, influence, and experience of members, contributors, leaders, partners, and collaborators, ensuring that the community is central to Cochrane’s strategy, transformation, and long-term sustainability.

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), the Chief Community Officer (CCO) will lead community engagement, membership, participation pathways, learning and support, events, and global partnerships. They will embed co-production, transparency, shared leadership, and equitable global participation, with particular emphasis on strengthening leadership and influence from the Global South.

The opportunity

The Chief Community Officer will develop, deliver, and evaluate a coherent global community and membership strategy aligned with Cochrane’s organisational priorities which involves inclusive participation, leadership, mentorship, and progression pathways that give community members clear routes to influence and help deliver Cochrane’s strategy.

The Chief Community Officer will be a visible, trusted, and accessible executive leader, building shared purpose, transparency, collaboration, and confidence through organisational change. Their mission will be to provide strategic and people leadership for community-facing teams and functions, setting clear priorities and aligning resources with the community strategy.

With Cochrane entering a pivotal period of transformation, the Chief Community Officer will work closely with the Chief Executive Officer to set the strategic direction and success measures for Cochrane Colloquia, learning programmes, and other major community events, ensuring scientific value, inclusion, connection, and financial sustainability.

We are looking for someone who brings

  • Significant senior leadership experience in a complex, mission-driven, volunteer-led international organisation, network, or partnership. It is expected that the right candidate would be an established and credible leader within the Cochrane community who has deep knowledge of Cochrane’s culture, values, governance, scientific mission, and collaborative ways of working, and who is based in, from, or has strong professional and leadership roots in the Global South.

  • Substantial experience of conducting or leading evidence synthesis activities involving multiple contributors, groups, or international teams, supported by a strong understanding of systematic reviews, guideline development, and evidence-informed decision-making.

  • Proven experience of leading organisational, digital, technological, or cultural change and securing commitment to new ways of working across diverse teams and stakeholder groups.

  • Demonstrated experience of advancing equity, inclusion, co-production, and global participation through locally led priorities, equitable partnerships, and inclusive leadership.

  • Proven experience of leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, managing budgets and resources, and translating strategy into prioritised delivery plans with measurable outcomes.

Inclusion statement

Cochrane is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences, and from those who share our commitment to trusted evidence, collaboration, equity, independence and public benefit.

Cochrane is proud to hold Level 3 Leader status as a Disability Confident Employer. Candidates who meet the criteria for the role and who share that they have a disability, will be eligible for a guaranteed interview.

How to apply

  • More information can be found here.

  • The deadline to receive your application is 10 September 2026.

  • The supporting statement should indicate why you are applying for the post, and how far you meet the requirements, using specific examples

  • Please read the Candidate Guide which gives you more information about our employee benefits and outlines what you can expect from the application process Candidate Pack

  • Read our Recruitment Privacy Statement

title: Expense Management & Analysis, Analyst
description:
Our Company

Oaktree is a leader among global investment managers specializing in alternative investments, with $223 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025. The firm emphasizes an opportunistic, value-oriented and risk-controlled approach to investments in credit, private equity, real assets and listed equities. The firm has over 1,400 employees and offices in 25 cities worldwide.

For additional information please visit our website at .

Responsibilities

The Expense Advisory team is a newly established function within Expense Management & Analysis, focused on improving the accuracy and consistency of expense coding and allocation decisions at the source.

This role is not a traditional processing role — it is an analytical and advisory position that partners with expense owners, Fund Accounting, and corporate functions to ensure expenses are appropriately coded, allocated, and aligned according to policy and funds’ governing documents.

The Analyst will develop subject matter expertise across vendors, business activities, and allocation methodologies, and will play a key role in identifying and preventing errors before they propagate through the expense lifecycle.

Typical responsibilities:

1. Expense Advisory & Business Partnership

  • Partner with expense owners and cost center administrators to provide guidance on expense coding and allocation
  • AdviseAdvice on appropriate corporate vs fund treatment based on nature of spend
  • Support resolution of complex or ambiguous expense scenarios

2. Vendor & Expense Expertise

  • Develop subject matter expertise on key vendors, services, and recurring expense types
  • Document and maintain standardized coding and allocation approaches
  • Identify inconsistencies and recommend improvements

3. Fund Allocation & Policy Alignment

  • Partner with Fund Accounting to understand fund expense allowability and strategy-specific nuances
  • Support interpretation of fund governing documents as they relate to expense allocation
  • Help ensure consistency in allocation instructions across similar scenarios

4. Process Improvement & Rejection Reduction

  • Analyze historical errors, rework, and Fund Accounting rejections
  • Identify root causes and recommend solutions
  • Support initiatives to reduce manual rework and improve first-pass accuracy

5. Knowledge Base & Documentation

  • Build and maintain centralized documentation of:
    • supplier relationships
    • coding standards
    • allocation methodologies
  • Contribute to development of guidance materials for the broader organization

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience, preferably in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Accounting, or Master Data Management within the financial services industry, and preferably in the investment management industry
  • Prefer experience within Public Accounting and Investment firms, preferably with a focus on consulting, audit and/or corporate finance functions
  • Track record in business analysis and process improvement
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to understand and resolve complex problems

  • Communication: strong interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills; ability to present complex material.
  • Independence & Collaboration: experience at working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment; must be able to drive work effectively with limited supervision (at times) while representing department and executive management interests and concerns.
  • Work Ethic: focus on continual development, performance, accountability, and self-motivation.
  • Flexibility & Organization: adapt to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities; proven ability to multi-task and efficiently manage time across competing activities/resources; able to effectively prioritize, execute tasks, and thrive in a high-pressure fast paced environment.

Responsibilities

Based in Downtown Los Angeles, Oaktree is seeking an associate to work within the U.S. Senior Loans Group for a 2-year program. Oaktree initially formed the U.S. Senior Loan strategy in September 2007 to capitalize on the backlog of "hung" bridge loans held by investment banks. The strategy typically invests in broadly-syndicated, senior-secured loans or other senior, non-investment-grade debt. In most instances, the instruments we target constitute the most senior component in the borrower’s capital structure. In 2012, we continued to expand the strategy with a new product, Enhanced Income, which invests in senior loans through a lightly-levered CLO structure; and in 2014, we launched a traditional CLO product. The strategy’s focus is on U.S. dollar-denominated loans secured by first-priority liens in performing companies primarily within the U.S. and Canada, but also within Europe. Though it is less common, we may also invest in second lien loans, non-dollar-denominated loans, and secured or unsecured bonds, where we believe the value of the underlying business comfortably exceeds the value of our claim in a downside scenario.

title: Principal Product Designer, Design Systems & AI
description:
Summary:


Anaconda's Design organization now owns our design system end to end, from Figma libraries and design tokens through to the code components engineers ship. We're mid-flight on a migration of our component architecture to a modern stack, converging two product surfaces into one platform, and defining how a design practice works in an agentic AI world.


As our Principal Product Designer, you'll own the design system as a product: its architecture, its governance, and its evolution across converging surfaces. You'll partner directly with engineering to land the migration, then build the AI-forward design practice on top of it: the patterns, tooling, and workflows for designing agentic product experiences. This is a senior IC role reporting to the VP of Design, operating with wide autonomy in a deliberately flat, senior team.


What You'll Do:
  • Own the design system end to end: design tokens, component libraries, documentation, and the code components engineers consume, across two converging product surfaces.
  • Lead the migration of our component architecture to a modern stack (shadcn/ui, Storybook), partnering with engineering to re-baseline scope and ship a complete, production-quality tranche.
  • Define the governance that outlives any individual: versioning, contribution model, release process, and explicit exit criteria for design handoff that both design and engineering sign.
  • Establish Anaconda's AI-forward design practice: patterns, guidelines, and tooling for agentic product surfaces, and ship the first product experiences that use them.
  • Work in design and code: prototype in the production stack and review component implementations.
  • Raise the bar across a senior design team through influence: critique, pairing, and visible craft.
  • Use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.
Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:
  • Completion and adoption of the component architecture migration across both product surfaces.
  • Reduction in design-to-engineering handoff time and rework, measured against explicit exit criteria.
  • Cross-team adoption of design system governance: versioned releases, contribution model, and shared definition of done.
  • AI-forward design patterns shipped in production surfaces and reused across the platform.
What You Need:
  • 12+ years of product design experience, including several years owning a design system at scale, tokens, component architecture, and governance, not only consumption.
  • Engineering fluency: comfortable working in TypeScript/React component codebases and Storybook, and applied in technical architecture discussions.
  • Proven experience leading a design system migration or re-platform in a production environment, including scoping what ships and what parks.
  • Demonstrated experience designing AI-driven or agentic product experiences.
  • Experience using AI assisted tools, such as Claude Code, as part of a professional workflow, including reviewing and validating AI generated output before it ships.
  • A track record of leading through influence in flat or ambiguous structures, defining the operating model rather than executing within one.
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You've taken a design system through a framework migration at enterprise scale and can walk us through what you kept, cut, and parked — and why.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or component libraries, with public work you can show.
  • Experience designing for developer tools, data science, or technical audiences.
  • You've built design tooling or automation — internal tools, Figma plugins, or AI-assisted design workflows — that other designers adopted.
  • Experience working across converging or multi-product platforms where the design system was the connective tissue.
  • A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice, shaped by hands-on work designing agentic experiences.
  • You embody our values: "Curious by Default", "Build Together", "Own It", and "Lead with Guts and Heart", and our behaviors: Clarity, Care and Candor.
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish.
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

The application deadline for this role is 11/02/2026; applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.


The base salary range for this role is $146,500 - $216,000, along with annual bonus potential, equity participation, and benefits.


Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by various factors, including work location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will provide more specific details on the salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

title: Facilities Technician
description:
Overview: As a growing 501(c)(3), non-profit organization, CRCI is always looking for new talented individuals who can be an addition to its efforts. It is CRCI’s Management's desire that each person involved with the organization (paid or not paid) has a burden for the lost, the sick, and the suffering. It is also important that all staff recognize that they are a representative of CRCI, and the actions will affect the community's outlook upon it. Staff is a representation of the CRCI program, and it will be expected for them to conduct themselves in a manner that would always promote and elevate the image of CRCI to the community. Any behavior that promotes a negative image of the organization is unacceptable.

Position Overview: The Facilities Operations Technician is responsible for maintaining the safety, functionality, and operational readiness of all CRCI physical facilities and related assets. This position performs hands-on maintenance, preventative maintenance, manages maintenance requests through Airtable and Google Workspace, conducts inspections, and manages the procurement system to ensure all departments receive operational supplies as needed (using the internal ordering system and standards).


Key Responsibilities:

Facility Maintenance and Repair:

  • Perform hands-on maintenance, repair, and upkeep of CRCI facilities, structures, and grounds;
  • Diagnose facility issues and perform appropriate repairs within authorized scope (reviewed with supervisor regularly for purchasing approval);
  • Maintain building systems including doors, fixtures, lighting, appliances, and structural components by developing and carrying out an active preventative maintenance schedule;
  • Ensure facilities remain clean, safe, and functional.

Facility Inspection and preventative maintenance:

  • Conduct routine and monthly inspections of all CRCI facilities;
  • Execute scheduled preventative maintenance across all CRCI facilities;
  • Identify maintenance needs before system failure occurs;
  • Track maintenance issues and maintain all maintenance schedules using digital systems such as Airtable;
  • Work with supervisor weekly to assess contractor needs, providing recommendations for each task regarding the skill level necessary to complete (such as whether or not it needs to be contracted out to one of CRCI’s preferred service providers);
  • Provide recommendations regarding external contractor involvement;
  • Assist with contractor coordination when assigned.

Maintenance Request and Work Order Management:

  • Monitor maintenance requests submitted through CRCI systems;
  • Evaluate requests and determine appropriate response pathway, responding to each request within 2 business days using digital tracking systems to ensure updates are communicated to the department or person who submitted the request.

Procurement and Inventory Management:

  • Work with supervisor to procure maintenance supplies and operational materials on a quarterly basis;
  • Maintain inventory of maintenance supplies;
  • Monitor supply levels and reorder proactively, developing a plan of action to align with quarterly purchasing schedule;
  • Ensure procurement follows CRCI approval procedures with departments submitted orders only during their scheduled time frame, ensuring they are fulfilled in the expected 2-3 week timeframe;
  • Procurement authority applies to operational supplies only (not capital purchases.)

Resident Work Crew Supervision:

  • Supervise residents assigned to maintenance tasks when appropriate, holding them accountable to all CRCI program standards;
  • Ensure safe and proper execution of assigned work;
  • Support resident development through responsible work participation.

General

  • Monitor email and system notifications regularly using ACT (Accurate Communication that is Timely);
  • Assist departments and facilities with maintaining a list of supply inventory and order supplies when they are low (before they are out of stock);
  • Check their inventory processes during monthly inspections;
  • Continually assess property and assets for maintenance needs.;
  • Ensure all facilities are stocked with Naloxone and that all staff is trained in how to administer in the event of an overdose emergency;
  • Facilitate and/or schedule training for staff and residents in basic areas of safety, such as CPR, first aid, choking, and AED (if applicable);
  • Attend all training sessions as required or requested.

title: Software Engineer – Network
description:
Role

Build the software that moves data through Azora's space-ground optical network: link control, data plane services, scheduling, and the ground-side services that turn raw optical downlinks into reliable customer data delivery. You will implement the protocols and services the Network Architect defines – and help shape them with real implementation feedback.

Responsibilities

  • Implement networking software for the ground segment: link management, framing/ARQ logic, data ingest pipelines, store-and-forward services, and customer delivery APIs.

  • Build the pass scheduling and orchestration services that coordinate satellites, ground stations, and weather data in near-real time.

  • Develop telemetry, tracking, and command (TT&C) software paths, including encrypted command uplink and telemetry processing.

  • Write high-throughput data plane code capable of sustaining multi-Gbps downlink rates from receiver hardware to storage and network egress.

  • Build monitoring, logging, and operational tooling for a distributed, multi-site network.

  • Develop simulation and test harnesses for protocol behavior over fading optical channels (packet loss, burst errors, outages).

  • Participate in on-call support of operational ground stations as the network scales.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant work in networked systems or distributed services.

  • Strong skills in at least one of: Go, Rust, C++, or modern Python for backend/network services.

  • Solid understanding of TCP/UDP, sockets, serialization, and performance tuning of network services.

  • Experience with Linux systems programming and deployment (containers, systemd, CI/CD).

Preferred

  • Experience with satellite ground systems, CCSDS protocols, or SDR/communications software.

  • High-performance networking experience (DPDK, io_uring, kernel bypass, or 10/25/100GbE pipelines).

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), message queues, and time-series telemetry stacks (Prometheus, InfluxDB, Grafana).

  • Exposure to DTN, custom ARQ protocols, or erasure coding for lossy links.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

The Opportunity:

title: Ophthalmic Assistant
description:
Company Intro

At American Vision Partners (AVP), we partner with the most respected ophthalmology practices in the country and integrate best-in-class management systems, operational infrastructure, and advanced technology to provide the highest quality patient care possible.
