As an Ophthalmic Assistant, you’ll be responsible for preparing the patient for the exam with the doctor. You’ll gather important medical information from the patient, perform preliminary tests, and gather measurements while providing highest quality of care and an exceptional patient experience.

  • Contribute to demand planning inputs, incorporating historical data and operational insights.

General

  • Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and support system data integrity.

  • Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Finance, and external partners.

  • Support ad-hoc supply chain projects as the business requires.

  • 2–3 years of experience in a supply chain, procurement, or logistics role.

  • Solid understanding of procurement processes and supplier management.

  • Experience working with or coordinating 3PL providers, ideally across multiple geographies.

  • Familiarity with inventory management principles and tools.

  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail.

  • A collaborative team player who communicates clearly and follows through reliably.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; experience with supply chain or ERP systems (specifically CIN7, NetSuite) is a plus.

title: Pediatric OT | Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX
description:
Pediatric Occupational Therapist — Per Session

Do the work you love, session by session, on a schedule that fits your life.

Oaklin Lane is hiring a pediatric Occupational Therapist on a per-session basis at our neighborhood clinic in Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX — a clinician who wants meaningful caseload time without giving up flexibility.

On our Lane, every session counts

You got into occupational therapy because you believed in the work — the first time a kid zips their own jacket, holds a pencil with confidence, or finds calm in a body that used to feel too loud. At Oaklin Lane, we’ve built a place where that belief drives everything: purpose-built sensory and treatment spaces, materials ready when you arrive, and a team that celebrates every milestone alongside you.

About Oaklin Lane

Oaklin Lane is your neighborhood pediatric therapy clinic — a growing network of purpose-built clinics providing compassionate, expert care to kids from infancy through adolescence. We believe in evidence-backed therapy where hard work feels like play, and progress happens on each kid’s own terms.

At Oaklin Lane, sensory integration is core to how we practice. All clinicians—across speech, occupational, and physical therapy—are expected to incorporate sensory-based techniques into their work with the children we serve. If you don't yet have experience with sensory integration, that's okay: we provide dedicated training and mentorship to help you build these skills and apply them confidently within your discipline.

What you’ll do

  • Provide one-on-one, play-based occupational therapy sessions for kids from infancy through adolescence

  • Deliver evidence-based treatment across fine motor, visual-motor, sensory processing, and self-care skills

  • Build treatment plans and goals that meet each kid where they are

  • Document sessions in our EMR with accuracy and care

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately with kids, families, and your interdisciplinary teammates

  • Coordinate care with SLP and PT so every kid gets one connected plan

  • Create a play-based environment where kids are treated like kids first

Why this role at Oaklin Lane

Pay tied to the work itself. You earn $50–$70 per hour — clear, simple, and connected directly to the care you provide.

A schedule that works for you. Per-session means flexibility. Build a caseload that fits your life — whether that’s a few sessions a week or a full schedule.

A space built for the work. Our clinics are purpose-built from the ground up for pediatric therapy. Designed for how kids actually move, play, and learn.

A team that shows up for each other. We celebrate progress, support each other, and create a place people genuinely want to be. That’s how culture works on our lane.

Who you are

You are:

  • Self-motivated and mission-driven

  • Deeply knowledgeable in pediatric development and sensory integration

  • Someone who meets kids where they are

  • A clear, compassionate communicator

  • A team player who cares as much about the clinicians around you as the kids on your schedule

You bring:

  • Current Texas licensure as an Occupational Therapist (OT) in good standing

  • Pediatric experience across fine motor, visual-motor, sensory processing, and self-care skills

  • Comfort using EMR systems and keeping documentation accurate and timely

  • A team-first mindset aligned with Oaklin Lane’s values

What to expect

  • Pay: $50–$70 per hour, based on experience

  • Schedule: Per-session · Flexible caseload built around your availability · Clinic is open 8:00AM to 6:00PM

  • All therapy materials, supplies, and equipment provided

  • A collaborative, interdisciplinary team around you

  • In-person at an Oaklin Lane clinic in Lake Highlands, Dallas, TX

Come see what we are building

The first move is the hardest one — we’ll take you through the rest. If you’re curious, we’d love to start the conversation. Reach out to meet the team or schedule a time to visit the clinic.

Oaklin Lane is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a workplace where every clinician is welcome on our lane.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
BUSUP

BUSUP is a global corporate mobility company helping organizations rethink how their people get to work. Through a technology-driven, asset-light model, we combine data, AI-powered route optimization, operational expertise, and a trusted network of local transport operators to make employee commuting more efficient, flexible, and sustainable.

We partner with large companies across Europe, Latin America, and North America to design, manage, and continuously improve shared mobility solutions that reduce costs, lower emissions, and create a better commuting experience for employees. At BUSUP, we believe the future of corporate mobility is smarter, more connected, and built around people, helping companies move their teams with greater efficiency, visibility, and impact.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and evolving our test automation strategy, ensuring quality across web, mobile, and API products throughout the entire development lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building frameworks from the ground up, promoting modern quality practices, and collaborating closely with development and product teams to deliver high-quality software.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and develop test cases using BDD methodologies and Gherkin language.

  • Create, maintain, and optimize automated E2E tests for web and mobile applications.

  • Design and develop automated API and integration tests.

  • Design and develop automated tests for native Android and iOS mobile applications.

  • Collaborate with development teams from early stages of the software lifecycle, driving Shift Left Testing practices.

  • Integrate and maintain test suites within CI/CD pipelines.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our automation framework and associated tooling.

  • Identify, document, and track defects.

  • Analyze quality risks and propose improvements to processes, tools, and methodologies.

  • Promote a quality culture within cross-functional teams.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in QA Automation.

  • Design or evolution of automation frameworks.

  • Strong development knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python.

  • Proven experience designing and maintaining E2E automation with Cypress.

  • Solid experience automating API tests through code and tools such as Postman.

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL and data validation.

  • Experience working with version control systems (Git).

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

  • Analytical mindset, quality orientation, and ability to work collaboratively.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Application of AI to testing and quality assurance processes.

  • E2E automation using Playwright.

  • Quality strategies for distributed architectures and microservices.

TECH STACK

  • Backend & Data: PHP / Laravel, MySQL

  • Tools: Postman, Jira, Confluence, Git, Bitbucket, Docker

WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL

  • You are proactive and take ownership of your work.

  • You enjoy proposing new ideas and challenging the status quo.

  • You stay up to date with quality and automation trends.

  • You are comfortable working in evolving environments where continuous improvement is encouraged.

BUSUP BENEFITS🎁

If you believe you match these values, we look forward to meeting you! 💚

title: Senior Platform Engineer (DevOps)
description:
Fnality is building the future of financial market infrastructure – creating regulated, blockchain-based payment systems to power tomorrow’s wholesale banking ecosystem. Backed by leading global banks and operating at the intersection of technology, finance, and regulation, we are powering the future of finance, together. There are no precedents for what we're doing. With you on our side, we'll be setting new ones every day.

Working at Fnality

Be your best: We have a supportive culture that helps to bring the best out of each and every single one of our employees.

Feel free to explore: Bring your new ideas and help us to solve problems together by joining a community of experts.

Be part of something bigger: We will support you by fostering an open, honest culture, that enables flexibility and wellbeing. Feel part of something bigger while being yourself. 

Feel empowered: We want you to feel empowered. The nature of our business can help make this a reality. We have the agility, speed and innovation of a start-up, and a flexible working environment that enables this.

Role Purpose

We are looking for two DevOps engineers, one to be based out of our London office (hybrid) and one to work out of our Connecticut office (hybrid).

The DevOps Engineers will play a key role in the strategic design, hands-on delivery, and oversight of workstreams relating to Cloud Platform, DevOps, Security and Network support for the Fnality Payment System. As the SME, this person will be tasked with auditing the current technology ecosystem and making recommendations which future-proof the Platform model to support long term business growth. Having worked in a similar industry, the DevOps Engineer will have the knowledge and experience, basing their decision-making around considerations relating to the storage of highly sensitive data. The engineer will be expected to be a proactive and confident practitioner of AI technologies, continually identifying responsible, secure and practical ways to use AI to increase their own throughput, improve the quality of engineering outcomes, and help the wider team deliver faster and more effectively.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Apply your deep knowledge of Kubernetes and the application stack to bring new services to production through resilient, fully automated, cloud‑native delivery.

  • Deploy and support Fnality highly resilient and scalable technology products and platforms to customers

  • Demonstrates strong security awareness, with the ability to identify potential vulnerabilities and proactively remediate security risks.

  • Working with the wider team to create, maintain and deliver against an organised and cross organisation aligned backlog of delivery and support operations

  • Collaborate with Development, QA, Cyber Security, and SRE teams to deliver platform changes and ensure smooth, reliable operations.

  • Maintain and enforce compliance standards across the platform, embedding controls into day‑to‑day engineering and operations.

  • Drive observability and resilience by owning application monitoring, alerting, and event management.

  • Reviews technical designs and provides well-founded input or challenges assumptions based on practical experience and industry best practices.

  • Contributes to 24×7 operational support and incident management – please note our on-call requirements are not fully defined as yet, but there will eventually be an element of this

Skills And Experience

  • Hands-on experience with AI-enabled engineering workflows, including agentic AI tools, code assistants, and automation patterns that improve platform delivery and operational effectiveness. Ideally with Claude or Copilot.

  • Ability to integrate AI capabilities responsibly into DevOps and CI/CD practices, with consideration for security, governance, data protection, and safe use in regulated environments.

  • Experience working as a DevOps/Cloud/Platform Senior or Lead Engineer as it relates to the seniority and complexity of the role

  • Experience of successfully delivering secure, large-scale projects in a cloud environment

  • Experience in supporting the development of DevOps pipelines

  • Mandatory knowledge:

o Kubernetes and related tools (e.g: Docker, helm, Flux, EKS)

o CI/CD implementation and source control (Gitlab/Github)

o Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code

o Main AWS services (EC2, ELB, S3, RDS etc) and architecture concepts

  • Knowledge of some of the following tech stack:

o Scripting languages

o AWS multi-account structure

o Prometheus, Grafana, ELK

o Microservices Architecture

o PKI / secret management

o Java and Golang

o SSO integration (AD/Okta)

o Hyperledger Besu

  • Understanding of network and security concepts

  • Strategic, forward-thinking approach with a passion for innovation and change

  • Willingness to get involved with a multitude of work and changing priorities in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

  • Comfortable working with limited resources and tight deadlines

  • Attention to detail

Ideally you will have

  • Experience in a DevOps Engineer role adhering to regulatory compliance and information security management frameworks (e.g. IS027001, NIST, etc) and as of late had chances to flex your competency, ideally in an agile, fast growing scaleup

  • Platform Engineering expertise (e.g. service, design, engineering) coupled with an understanding of financial services and relevant regulations and laws.

  • Knowledge of and/or interest in blockchain, security operations, financial services back-office processes, systems and products

However, if your experience isn't an exact match, please apply if you are interested and we can see if there is a potential opportunity for you with Fnality.

Why should you join Fnality?

We employ curious individuals who thrive working in a fast-paced and constantly changing environment, who work best when empowered to drive their own work, and who are not afraid to fail fast and learn quicker.

You will be an analytical thinker who is able to look at tasks and understand the most efficient way to achieve the desired outcome. You will be vigilantly outcomes-focussed and fully agile in your approach to working. You will have an insatiable desire to learn, adept at picking up new challenges and giving it a go. You will want to deliver as much as learn and you will understand how important the power of the team is.

Eligibility

These roles will be either London or Connecticut based and you must be eligible to work in the UK or the US. Please note we cannot sponsor visas for these roles.

A bit more about us

Digital transformation is changing our lives, work and businesses. While other sectors evolve however, financial markets remain slow, fragmented and siloed. What the world needs now is a future-facing financial system for the digital age.

At Fnality, we have been speaking – and listening – to the real users of today’s financial systems. From businesses to banks, there is a clear, collective ambition for a simpler, faster, safer and more resilient payment system; one that can move and settle money quickly and efficiently, with minimised risk and much more transparency.

Fnality Global Payments

We are building a new payment system that will enable tokenised, peer-to-peer markets.

Fnality Global Payments (FnGP) will comprise a series of national systems, each regulated in its home jurisdiction. We call each of these a Fnality Payment System (FnPS)

In each payment system, a Fnality settlement asset will act as the settlement/payment asset for any Payment (P), Delivery v, Payment (DvP) or payment vs. payment (PvP) need.

FnGP are underpinned by Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). The nature of DLT is such that it enables FnGP to:

  • Operate a true peer-to-peer market

  • Allow for immediate settlement

  • Interoperate across business platforms and jurisdictions

The key benefits of the above are:

  • Reduced counter-party and credit risk

  • Reduced operational risk

  • Efficient liquidity management

  • An ability to move resources from risk mitigation to business growth

How will we use the information about you?

We will use your personal information to process your application, to enable us to assess your suitability for a role and for other legitimate business purposes such as improving our sites and talent management practices. We may share your data with third parties to achieve these purposes. We will not use or share your information for marketing purposes.

We will take appropriate security measures to safeguard your information in accordance with data protection legislation.

If you would like further information about how your information may be processed by us, please contact us at privacy@fnality.org.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
As part of Endava's strategic partnership with WTW, who provide data-driven, insight-led solutions in the areas of people, risk and capital, we're building dedicated software engineering teams to support WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology Division.

WTW's Insurance Consulting and Technology business is a global leader in P&C, Life and Health insurance software and advisory services, with over 1,700 colleagues across 35 markets. More than 1,000 insurers worldwide trust our combination of advisory insight and advanced software to help them navigate complexity and drive sustainable growth.

Joining Endava, you'll work exclusively with WTW to help embed AI-enabled engineering practices, modern ways of working and deep insurance technology expertise, contributing to the next generation of products and services for insurers worldwide. Working as part of a dedicated team established through a Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) model, you'll collaborate closely with WTW while building your career as an Endava employee, supporting the long-term success of this strategic partnership.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you will help build, operate and evolve ICT's internal AI Engineering Platform, working on the services and tooling that enable AI-assisted software engineering across the technology delivery organisation.

You will join the Engineering Enablement team, which develops the internal engineering platform used by software engineers across the organisation. Rather than delivering business applications directly, you will focus on the platform capabilities, automation and developer experience that help engineering teams adopt Agentic Engineering practices safely and effectively.

WTW has developed an agentic engineering harness which combines GitHub Copilot, AI agents, engineering loops, Azure cloud services and developer tooling to accelerate software delivery, automate engineering activities and improve the overall developer experience. Your role will be supporting the continued development and operation of this harness and the surrounding engineering platform toolset which supports it.

This is an ideal opportunity for engineers who enjoy solving infrastructure and platform challenges, working across cloud infrastructure, automation, observability, AI tooling, developer platforms and engineering governance, and contributing to one of ICT's strategic investments in AI-assisted software engineering.

The role includes independent ownership of significant platform capabilities and work packages, with responsibility for making technical decisions within the agreed AI engineering platform direction

What Success Looks Like

In this role you will:

· Help build, operate and evolve ICT's internal AI Engineering Platform, enabling software engineering teams to adopt AI-assisted and Agentic Engineering practices.

· Develop secure, reliable and reusable platform services across AI tooling, developer enablement, observability, automation and engineering governance.

· Improve developer experience by creating self-serve capabilities, clear documentation, integration patterns and automation that make engineering workflows easier to adopt.

· Design, automate and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Infrastructure as Code and modern CI/CD practices.

· Strengthen the reliability, scalability, security and operational resilience of shared engineering platform services.

· Collaborate with Engineering Managers, Architects, Platform Engineers and software engineering teams to support platform adoption and continuous improvement.

· Actively learn, share knowledge and contribute to a positive engineering culture within the engineering enablement team and wider ICT engineering community.

· Take ownership of delivery, dependencies and technical trade-offs for assigned capabilities and help less experienced engineers through constructive reviews, knowledge sharing and mentoring

Key Responsibilities

AI Engineering Platform

· Develop, maintain and evolve platform services supporting AI-assisted software engineering.

· Build capabilities that enable software engineering teams to adopt Agentic Engineering practices.

· Support continuous evolution of WTW's internal AI Engineering Platform.

· Improve developer experience through reusable engineering platform capabilities and automation.

· Lead focused technical work packages from design through production readiness, ensuring that platform capabilities are maintainable, secure, observable and usable by multiple engineering teams.

Platform Services

· Own and evolve internal platform services including RAG knowledgebase systems, observability, package management and code quality tooling.

· Support operational ownership of GitHub Copilot enablement services.

· Contribute to engineering governance capabilities supporting AI-assisted development.

· Maintain platform services that enable engineering teams to safely and efficiently consume AI capabilities.

· Contribute technical designs and implementation standards for shared platform services, identifying integration risks and balancing reliability, scalability, security and developer experience.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

· Design, automate and maintain cloud infrastructure running on Microsoft Azure.

· Develop Infrastructure as Code using OpenTofu/Terraform.

· Build and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting engineering platform services in both Azure DevOps and GitHub.

· Develop automation solutions supporting engineering workflows and platform operations with a high emphasis on self-serve operations.

· Improve scalability, reliability, and operational resilience of engineering platform services.

· Own the technical follow-through of reliability improvements, including root-cause analysis, operational readiness, documentation and agreed remediation actions.

Observability & Operations

· Implement and operate monitoring, telemetry and observability solutions supporting engineering platform services.

· Improve operational visibility through logging, tracing and metrics.

· Troubleshoot platform issues and support engineering teams adopting platform capabilities.

· Participate in production support and operational improvements where required.

Engineering Enablement

· Work closely with software engineering teams to support adoption of AI-assisted development tools.

· Collaborate with Engineering Managers, Architects and Platform Engineers to continuously improve engineering workflows.

title: Space Systems Lead
description:
Role

Lead the development of Azora's space segment: the flight terminals and supporting avionics that carry our optical communications technology to orbit. You will own the space system architecture, requirements, and verification program – and build and lead the multidisciplinary team taking flight hardware from concept through launch and on-orbit commissioning.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end space segment architecture: optical terminal, avionics, structures, thermal, power, and interfaces to host spacecraft or bus.

  • Lead requirements development and flow-down from mission and link-budget level to subsystem and component specifications.

  • Drive the design review cadence (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and the verification and validation program, including environmental qualification (vibration, shock, TVAC, EMC, radiation).

  • Manage technical interfaces with launch providers, bus manufacturers, and hosted payload partners, including ICD development and negotiation.

  • Build and lead the space systems team: systems engineers, AIT engineers, and technicians; establish processes proportionate to a startup (tailored ECSS/NASA standards, not bureaucracy).

  • Own risk management, parts and materials assurance strategy (EEE parts, radiation lot testing), and reliability analysis for the flight program.

  • Plan and lead assembly, integration, and test (AIT) campaigns and launch site operations; oversee on-orbit commissioning and anomaly resolution.

  • Support business development with technical input to proposals, customer engagements, and program schedules/costing.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Aerospace, Electrical, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related field.

  • 8+ years in spacecraft or space payload development, with at least one program taken through full qualification and launch.

  • Strong systems engineering foundation: requirements management, budgets (mass, power, link, pointing), V&V planning, and risk management.

  • Direct experience with environmental qualification and AIT of flight hardware.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership of multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Preferred

  • Experience with optical payloads, laser communication terminals, or precision pointing systems in space.

  • Familiarity with smallsat/NewSpace development models and hosted payload integration.

  • Knowledge of radiation effects and mitigation for electronics and optics.

  • Experience interfacing with government customers and programs (NASA, ESA, DoD/SDA) and associated review processes.

  • Prior startup or small-team experience scaling engineering processes.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: Talent Pool
description:
Fnality is building the future of financial market infrastructure – creating regulated, blockchain-based payment systems to power tomorrow’s wholesale banking ecosystem. Backed by leading global banks and operating at the intersection of technology, finance, and regulation, we are powering the future of finance, together. There are no precedents for what we're doing. With you on our side, we'll be setting new ones every day. We are always keen to hear from candidates who have what it takes to help drive the future of finance. Please apply below and we will be in touch should any suitable roles come up.

Working at Fnality

Be your best: We have a supportive culture that helps to bring the best out of each and every single one of our employees.

Feel free to explore: Bring your new ideas and help us to solve problems together by joining a community of experts.

Be part of something bigger: We will support you by fostering an open, honest culture, that enables flexibility and wellbeing. Feel part of something bigger while being yourself. 

Feel empowered: We want you to feel empowered. The nature of our business can help make this a reality. We have the agility, speed and innovation of a start-up, and a flexible working environment that enables this.

That being said, we would love for candidates to be able to demonstrate:

  • Agility

  • Collaboration

  • Empowerment

  • Outcomes Driven

  • Thirst for learning

  • Adaptability

Why should you join Fnality?

We employ curious individuals who thrive working in a fast paced and constantly changing environment, who work best when empowered to drive their own work, and who are not afraid to fail fast and learn quicker.

You will be an analytical thinker who is able to look at tasks and understand the most efficient way to achieve the desired outcome. You will be vigilantly outcomes-focussed and fully agile in your approach to working. You will have an insatiable desire to learn, adept at picking up new challenges and giving anything a go. You will want to deliver as much as learn and you will understand how important the power of the team is.

A bit more about us

Digital transformation is changing our lives, work and businesses. While other sectors evolve, however, financial markets remain slow, fragmented and siloed. What the world needs now is a future-facing financial system for the digital age.

At Fnality, we have been speaking – and listening – to the real users of today’s financial systems. From businesses to banks, there is a clear, collective ambition for a simpler, faster, safer and more resilient payment system; one that can move and settle money quickly and efficiently, with minimized risk and much more transparency.

Fnality Global Payments

We are building a network of new payment systems that will enable tokenised, peer-to-peer markets.

Fnality Global Payments (FnGP) will comprise a series of national systems, each regulated in its home jurisdiction. We call each of these a Fnality Payment System (FnPS).

In each payment system, a Fnality settlement asset will act as the settlement/payment asset for any Payment (P), Delivery v, Payment (DvP) or payment vs. payment (PvP) need.

FnGP are underpinned by Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT). The nature of DLT is such that it enables FnGP to:

  • Operate a true peer-to-peer market

  • Allow for immediate settlement

  • Interoperate across business platforms and jurisdictions

The key benefits of the above are:

  • Reduced counter-party and credit risk

  • Reduced operational risk

  • Efficient liquidity management

  • An ability to move resources from risk mitigation to business growth

Eligibility

Please note we cannot sponsor visas at Fnality. We have offices in London, Connecticut and Eschborn and you must have the right to work in the location you apply for.

How will we use the information about you?

We will use your personal information to process your application, to enable us to assess your suitability for a role and for other legitimate business purposes such as improving our sites and talent management practices. We may share your data with third parties to achieve these purposes. We will not use or share your information for marketing purposes.

We will take appropriate security measures to safeguard your information in accordance with data protection legislation.

If you would like further information about how your information may be processed by us, please contact us at privacy@fnality.org.

title: Head of Outcomes Analysis
description:
Introduction

We are building the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in business.

Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI in Banking by creating the most complete, unbiased and transparent public benchmark of corporate AI capability. Our inaugural product launch, the Evident AI Index, was covered by the New York Times and many other outlets.

Why join us:

  • We are index experts. Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world.

  • We are building a cutting edge research team that uses the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools.

  • We are backed by some of the world’s leading tech investors, including Lance Uggla, the backers of Revolut, the tech commentator Scott Galloway, and have built a network of advisors that includes the Global AI Lead at AWS, Mastercard’s President of Cyber & Intelligence, Ocado’s former CTO, the former CCO of the Alan Turing Institute, the Chair of the UK Government AI Council and the former Head of the UK Government Office for AI.

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI here. Our commitments to diversity and inclusion are set out at the end of this job description.

The Role

As our Head of Outcomes Analysis, you will be the point person for delivering, scaling and evolving the methodology system behind Evident’s private benchmarking (‘Outcomes’) products.

This is a senior, high-impact role where you will shape the way AI adoption, usage and business impact is measured across various financial services sectors and functions. You will begin as a hands-on architect, designing core frameworks, scoring models, and maturity metrics, whilst gradually transitioning into a player-coach, building and mentoring a high-performing team of methodologists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, own and evolve the overarching AI benchmarking framework, to include taxonomy, maturity models, and scoring systems.

  • Deploy frameworks across sectors (banking, insurance, asset management) and functions (risk, operations, front office), ensuring these map to a unified system.

  • Design and maintain our indicators, scoring methodologies, and weightings.

  • Balance analytical rigour with usability for internal teams and clients.

  • Define governance for creating new benchmarks, modifying existing frameworks, and maintaining consistency.

  • Continuously evolve frameworks in line with emerging AI trends and industry practices

  • Act as the internal authority on AI maturity and impact across financial services, whilst also providing support in client meetings and external engagements.

  • Partner with Product to translate methodology into dashboards, reports, and modules.

  • Lead production and QA of benchmark outputs, assessing results critically to ensure defensibility.

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10 - 12+ years in analytics, research, strategy, or quantitative roles.

  • Demonstrable experience in either banking, insurance, or asset management.

  • Experience building frameworks, indices, benchmarking systems, or measurement methodologies.

  • Experience leading - and scaling - analytical or research teams.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise AI use cases, deployment, and maturity assessment.

  • Familiarity with data infrastructure and operating models supporting AI.

  • Ability to assess real-world AI maturity versus theoretical capability.

  • Familiarity with key business functions (risk, operations, distribution).

  • Strong written and verbal communication, capable of explaining complex methodology to non-technical audiences.

  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders.

title: Spectrum Engineer
description:
BryceTech is seeking a Spectrum Engineer to support the Space Development Agency (SDA) in the acquisition and deployment of advanced space-based communications and transport capabilities. The Spectrum Engineer will support spectrum management, frequency coordination, and spectrum authorization activities for SDA satellite and ground systems, working across government, industry, SETA, FFRDC, and other stakeholder organizations.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with the DoD spectrum management and authorization process, including preparation and coordination of DD Form 1494, use of spectrum management tools such as EL-CID, E2ESS, and Stepstone, and development of frequency plans in accordance with NTIA and ITU regulations. This individual will help shepherd spectrum requests through the appropriate government approval processes and analyze potential interference and compatibility issues associated with SDA's evolving space architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support spectrum certification and authorization activities for SDA space and ground systems, including satellite communications and transport systems
  • Develop, prepare, and coordinate DD Form 1494 spectrum support requests and shepherd documentation through the required review and approval processes
  • Use NTIA and DoD spectrum management tools, including EL-CID, E2ESS, Stepstone, and other applicable systems
  • Develop and coordinate frequency plans in accordance with the NTIA Manual of Regulations and Procedures for Federal Radio Frequency Management (Redbook) and applicable ITU regulations
  • Develop and submit Advanced Publication Information (API) packages to support ITU coordination, notification, and protection of space and terrestrial systems
  • Conduct radio frequency interference and electromagnetic compatibility analyses to identify potential impacts to existing and planned RF systems
  • Coordinate with incumbent spectrum users and other stakeholders to resolve interference concerns and develop appropriate mitigation procedures
  • Apply relevant DoD-specific spectrum management requirements and footnotes contained within the NTIA Redbook, including requirements applicable to Link-16 and other DoD radio communication systems
  • Support coordination with spectrum management organizations, committees, and working groups, including the NASA-DoD-DoC (NDD) coordination group and NTIA Spectrum Planning Subcommittee (SPS)
  • Coordinate spectrum certification activities with organizations such as the Air Force Spectrum Management Office (AFSMO), Navy Marine Corps Spectrum Center (NMSC), and Space Systems Command Spectrum Management Office (SSC SMO)
  • Apply knowledge of RF fundamentals, including transmitter, receiver, and antenna characteristics, emission designators, frequency assignments, and ground terminal interactions
  • Analyze spectrum requirements within the context of space vehicle and ground system architectures
  • Provide technical support for the acquisition and deployment of SDA transport and communications satellites and associated ground systems
  • Develop technical analyses, reports, briefings, and other materials for government and senior decision makers
  • Participate in technical interchange meetings and coordinate with government, SETA, FFRDC, contractor, industry, and other external stakeholders
  • Track spectrum authorization actions, identify potential issues or delays, and work proactively with stakeholders to achieve required approvals
  • Provide additional spectrum management, RF engineering, and technical support as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility (TS/SCI)
  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 5 years of relevant experience
  • Prior professional experience in spectrum management and the spectrum authorization process
  • Experience supporting the preparation, submission, and coordination of DD Form 1494
  • Experience with DoD or federal spectrum management processes and organizations
  • Ability to possess and maintain a Secret security clearance
  • Working knowledge of RF systems and spectrum-dependent communications systems
  • Ability to communicate effectively with government, contractor, industry, and external stakeholders
  • Strong written and oral communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in STEM (science, technology, engineering, or mathematics)
  • Experience with EL-CID, E2ESS, Stepstone, or comparable DoD/NTIA spectrum management tools
  • Experience developing and submitting ITU Advanced Publication Information (API)
  • Experience developing frequency plans in accordance with the NTIA Redbook and applicable ITU regulations
  • Experience conducting RF interference analysis, spectrum compatibility assessments, or electromagnetic compatibility analysis
  • Familiarity with DoD-specific NTIA Redbook footnotes and spectrum requirements associated with Link-16 and other DoD communication systems
  • Experience working with AFSMO, NMSC, SSC SMO, or comparable spectrum management organizations
  • Experience with the NDD coordination group, NTIA SPS, or other federal spectrum coordination bodies
  • Experience supporting space vehicle, satellite communications, SATCOM, or ground terminal systems
  • Experience with RF system analysis, modeling, and simulation at the individual system or constellation level
  • Familiarity with modeling and simulation tools such as STK, AFSIM, and Coast
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and persist through complex interagency and regulatory approval processes
  • Ability to develop and deliver clear technical briefings to senior government and program leadership

BryceTech offers a full range of benefits, including competitive salary, a comprehensive health plan including dental and vision coverage, company-paid life & disability insurance policies, 401(k) plan with company match, and an educational reimbursement program.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Head of Research, Banking & Payments
description:
Introduction

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity across financial services.

Over the past year, Evident has expanded the scope of our benchmarking efforts beyond Banking to include Payments, Insurance, and Asset Management. As our coverage continues to expand, we are staffing both Content & Client Services teams with senior subject matter experts that demonstrate deep, industry-specific expertise.

The Role

To that end, we are searching for a Head of Research (Banking & Payments) to execute and deliver research insights tailored to a sector-specific audience.

Leveraging the data produced by the Evident AI Index (as well as private surveys), this role will be responsible for end-to-end production of original research insights – spanning ideation, research design, hypothesis testing, analysis, authorship, and delivery of key insights.

The ideal candidate will combine proficiency in research with technical expertise acquired through past work with leading global banks (either directly or on a consulting basis). Ultimately, the Head of Research will be expected to define the changing parameters of “frontier” AI applications and pace of deployment within the enterprise – by building out a supporting team of junior analysts to go deeper into individual lines of business.

Successful candidates will demonstrate equal comfort with quantitative (data) and qualitative (interview) methods and sources. Most of all, we’re looking for candidates that exhibit intense intellectual curiosity and a passion for data-driven storytelling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research Content

    • On a quarterly basis, author a Key Findings Report in tandem with an updated ranking release, including: Banking, Payments, and Regional perspectives (MEA, LATAM)

    • Maintain a State of AI x Banking briefing deck that includes: hypothesis-based trends, latest overview of use case landscape, recent examples of “frontier” use cases, and curated topics of critical enablers (previewing future inputs into the next ranking release)

  • Analyst Coverage

    • Partner closely with client strategists to define and iterate Evident’s current point-of-view, expanding our library of Analyst Briefing materials to better address incoming customer questions on trending topics

    • Regularly interact and interview subject matter experts and industry practitioners across our client base to validate our point-of-view and stay ahead of emerging trends (filtering those insights back into our knowledge base and research outputs)

  • Coordination & Alignment

    • Partner with Outcomes team to ensure our LoB-specific taxonomy remains up-to-date and maturity models for discrete use cases reflect “best-in-class” implementation

    • Liaise with cross-sector Research Analysts focused on our thematic research (Talent, Innovation, Leadership, Responsible AI, Outcomes) to hone sector-specific messaging and key takeaways

Core Skills

  • 8-12 years of research and/or consulting experience

  • Direct experience covering the Banking & Payments industry

  • Proficiency across both insight generation and insight delivery to customers

  • History of cross-team collaboration / orchestration (especially in regards to Data, Engineering, and Marketing teams)

Key Experience

  • Understanding of key issues facing leadership teams in global banks on topics related to artificial intelligence and/or other emerging technologies

  • Experience adapting and publishing primary or secondary research in different form factors (written reports, presentations, social media posts, webinars/podcasts)

  • Experience working with data scientists, engineers, and design teams to create supporting interactive visualization and/or rich media assets

  • Intellectual curiosity about AI topics, trends, and tech impacting the banking industry

Benefits

  • Share options: we offer all employees share options over a 4-year vesting period

  • Holidays: 28 days of holiday + public bank holidays

  • Flexible working: 3-4 days per week in our Central London office, 1-2 days remote

  • Pension

  • Private health insurance

Our commitments to diversity and inclusion

  • Evident is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating all forms of discrimination. Our aim is for our workforce to be truly representative of all sections of society and our customers, and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best.

  • During our recruitment process, you will not be discriminated against for any of the following reasons: race (including colour, nationality, ethnic and national origin), age, disability, gender reassignment, being married or in a civil partnership, being pregnant or on maternity leave, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need us to make certain changes (known as reasonable adjustments) to make sure you are not disadvantaged during the recruitment process, you should contact us as soon as possible.

  • We strive to create a working environment free of bullying, harassment, victimisation and discrimination, promote dignity and respect for all, and value and recognise individual differences and the contributions of all staff.

title: Product and Mechanical Engineering Lead
description:
About the role

You’ll lead the design and industrialization of Azora’s optical communication terminals — both terrestrial and space-bound. The goal is hardware that’s not just functional in the lab but repeatable, reliable, and producible at volume. If you’ve taken compact optical or imaging products from a working prototype to a mass-producible design, this is built for you. You’ll own system architecture and partner closely with electrical, mechanical, and optical engineers to deliver compact, integrated products that survive real-world environments and a real production line.

What you’ll do

  • Lead optical, electrical, and mechanical integration into compact, manufacturable terminals.

  • Own full system architecture, working with electrical and mechanical engineers to hit size, performance, and producibility targets.

  • Drive robustness and tolerance engineering — tolerance stack-ups, worst-case analysis, and design margins drawn from consumer or industrial product practice.

  • Design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA), and stand up a repeatable build process across internal and external manufacturing.

  • Plan and oversee electrical safety and EMC/EMI compliance testing (e.g., FCC Part 15, CE/UKCA, relevant IEC safety standards).

  • Balance cost and performance across the design, making the trades that keep the product both buildable and competitive.

What you bring

  • Track record taking compact, complex products from design through to mass production.

  • Hands-on experience with optical, electrical, and mechanical integration.

  • Strong robustness and tolerance engineering for consumer or industrial products.

  • Demonstrated ownership of full system architecture in a cross-disciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with electrical safety and EMC compliance testing.

Nice to have

  • A hands-on engineer who wants technical contribution across every part of the product.

  • Autonomous systems experience, including software control of complex hardware.

  • Experience managing both internal and external manufacturing.

  • Cost/performance engineering at the product level.

  • Free-space optics, laser comms, or precision optical product background

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Level 1 (starting from $130,000 USD): 3-5 years of experience in relevant roles.

  • Level 2 (starting from $160,000 USD): 5-15 years of experience in relevant roles.

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: Assisterende senterleder SATS Langnes
description:
💪 Assisterende senterleder i SATS

Har du et ønske om å jobbe med mennesker, samtidig som du vil bidra til å bekjempe en av vår tids største helseutfordringer? Det er nettopp det vi gjør i SATS ved å inspirere medlemmene våre og gjøre dem sunnere og gladere. Som assisterende senterleder støtter du senterleder i den daglige driften av senteret, med særlig fokus på salg, medlemsservice og renhold. Du bidrar til at senteret fremstår innbydende, er godt vedlikeholdt og gir medlemmene en best mulig opplevelse.

Du er «manager on duty» og har det overordnede ansvaret på sentret når senterleder ikke er til stede. Trives du i en aktiv og variert rolle der ingen dager er like, kan dette være stillingen for deg!

🏋️ En viktig lederrolle i en kompleks drift

SATS-sentrene våre er aktive møteplasser med høy aktivitet gjennom store deler av dagen. Som assisterende senterleder har du en sentral rolle i å sikre at den daglige driften fungerer sømløst for både medlemmer og medarbeidere. Stillingen innebærer ansvar for mennesker, drift, medlemsopplevelse og resultater, og du må trives med å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig. Du er en tydelig leder i hverdagen, tar beslutninger når det er nødvendig, og bidrar til at senteret holder høy standard innen service, salg, renhold og sikkerhet. Dette er en operativ lederrolle for deg som ønsker å ta ansvar, trives i et høyt tempo og evner å skape struktur og gode opplevelser i en variert og til tider hektisk arbeidshverdag.


🌟 Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Salg og medlemsvekst: Aktivt samarbeide med ditt team for å ønske nye medlemmer velkomne og levere eksepsjonell kundeservice til en hver tid.

  • Yte eksepsjonell service: Være tilstede og imøtekommen både i resepsjonen og i treningsområdet for å sørge for at våre medlemmer blir ivaretatt.

  • Sørge for et rent og trygt senter: Passe på at alle områder er ryddige, godt vedlikeholdte og oppfyller SATS sine høye standarder.

  • Bistå med administrative oppgaver: Støtte med administrative oppgaver, organisering og planlegging for å sikre fremdrift.

  • Fleksibilitet: Arbeidstiden din vil variere fra tidlig morgen til sent på kveld samt i helger for å sikre tilstedeværelse i de mest travle tidspunkter.


🤩 Kjenner du deg igjen?

  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner, og har en sosial tilnærming til andre mennesker.

  • Du er strukturert og ryddig, samt ansvarsfull og pliktoppfyllende.

  • Du liker salg, kundeservice og renhold.

  • Snakker flytende norsk og engelsk.

  • Etterlever våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional, and Extraordinary.


🚀 Hvorfor jobbe i SATS:

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell: Hjelpe mennesker med å bli sunnere og lykkeligere.

  • Bli en del av et mestringsteam: Du vil jobbe med likesinnede mennesker som deler de samme verdiene og lidenskap.

  • Utvikling: Gode utviklingsmuligheter blant annet gjennom vårt interne utdanningstilbud - SATS Academy.

  • Flere appellerende personalgoder.


🤝 Samarbeid:

Du vil jobbe tett med senterleder, og få hjelp fra våre støttefunksjoner, inkludert HR og regionale ledere.

Er du klar for en spennende og givende rolle med store utviklingsmuligheter og ønsker å gjøre en forskjell? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!


Ønsket oppstart i denne stillingen er snarest, eller etter nærmere avtale.

title: Financial Aid Officer (On-Site) - 1K Sign-On Bonus
description:
Why You Should Work With Us:

Arizona College of Nursing is a rapidly growing, nursing school that transforms people's lives by preparing them for careers in nursing and improving communities through the care its graduates provide. As a leading nurse educator, Arizona College of Nursing offers students the opportunity to earn a bachelor's in nursing in 3 years or less with qualified transfer credits. Our quality nursing curriculum prepares students for an in-demand career to help communities overcome the chronic, well-known, and increasing nursing shortage. Through the execution of a targeted growth strategy, the college plans to meet the growing demand for nurses by launching campuses in markets where bachelor's prepared nurses are needed.

Putting students first, we are dedicated to providing students with an exceptional education in growing healthcare fields; teaching them relevant, required skills for today and the future. Our culture is positive, supportive, and collaborative. As a team, we continually embrace our core values:

Passion: We love helping others succeed.

Excellence: We strive to be the best.

Adaptability: We learn, in part by trying new ideas.

Accountability: We own our results.

Integrity: We do the right thing.

What You'll Do:

Arizona College of Nursing is seeking a Financial Aid Officer to join our growing Hartford campus!

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 9:30am - 6:30pm, plus occasional Saturdays

100% Full-Time On-Site

The Financial Aid Officer (FAO) serves as the first-level position within the financial aid colleague job family. FAOs are essential in supporting student success by delivering personalized, proactive financial aid guidance throughout the student lifecycle—from initial enrollment to graduation.

Essential Functions:

Financial Aid Counseling & Support

  • Advise students and families on financial aid eligibility, application procedures, and available funding sources, including Title IV aid, institutional loans, scholarships, and agency assistance.
  • Support students through FAFSA completion, verification, and award acceptance.
  • Cleary explain loan terms, repayment obligations, and core financial literacy concepts to students and families, ensuring they understand the long-term impact of borrowing and budgeting.
  • Provide guidance to help students resolve financial aid issues that may affect their ability to enroll or continue their education.

File Compliance & Processing

  • Accurately package and process financial aid awards in full compliance with federal, state, and institutional regulations.
  • Ensure student records are complete and up to date to facilitate timely and accurate disbursement of financial aid.
  • Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies in student accounts to maintain financial integrity.
  • Stay informed on changes to financial aid laws, policies and best practices to ensure ongoing compliance and service excellence.

Student Retention & Success

  • Initiate timely communication with students regarding documentation requirements, award status updates and available funding opportunities.
  • Regularly review student accounts to ensure financial aid is applied accurately and disbursed on schedule.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with academic and student services teams to deliver a cohesive and supportive student experience from start to finish.
  • Foster professional, positive relationships with students, colleagues, and external agencies to support service excellence.
  • Partner with the Sr. FAO or Director of Financial Aid to enhance operational efficiency, improve student outcomes and achieve department goals.
  • Maintain detailed records of all student interactions and ensure financial aid documentation is accurate, complete and compliant.

At Arizona College of Nursing, we believe in a collaborative approach where all colleagues work together towards our shared goals. It's important to note that this list doesn't cover everything you'll be asked to do or need to do. We value adaptability and flexibility as we grow and evolve as an organization.

What We Need From You:

To perform this job successfully, an applicant must have professional demeanor, the ability to work independently, understand goals and deadlines and possess excellent communication and organizational skills.

Must Have

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience in financial aid, student services, customer service, or a related field.
  • Strong customer service orientation with a genuine passion for helping others.
  • Detail-focused with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and counseling skills.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment.
  • Must be eligible to enroll in the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS)

Nice to Have

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Prior experience in higher education or financial aid administration.
  • Familiarity with Title IV regulations and institutional financial aid policies.
  • An understanding of financial literacy principles and student loan repayment options.

What We Are Offering You:

Hourly pay range of $25.50-$28.00 per hour based on experience. Opportunities for professional development. Dynamic organizational culture within a supportive working environment. Rest and relaxation with generous PTO and holiday benefits. Robust health and welfare benefits package including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision. Preparation for the future with a 401(k) and company match. For consideration, only online applications will be accepted. No phone calls, please. Our schools prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, marital status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law to the extent prohibited by law.

title: Tijdelijke administratieve versterking R&D
description:
Glacier wordt verenigd door een gedeelde ambitie: ijsroomexpertise van wereldklasse naar elke uithoek van de wereld brengen. Met meer dan 75 jaar ervaring op de Europese markten leveren wij diepvriesproducten van topkwaliteit voor retail-, B2B- en exportpartners. Daarbij bieden wij oplossingen op maat, gebaseerd op uitmuntendheid, innovatie en betrouwbaarheid.

Als de derde grootste ijsfabrikant van Europa is onze doelstelling duidelijk: uitgroeien tot de nummer één partner voor private label- en co-manufactured ijsproducten.

Om ons team in Glacier Langemark te versterken, gaan we op zoek naar een (m/v) tijdelijke R&D versterking om administratieve ondersteuning te geven aan het R&D team. Een opdracht waarbij nauwkeurigheid en structuur centraal staan.

Jouw takenpakket:

· Administratieve ondersteuning bij receptuurswijzigingen.

· Je vergelijkt informatie die door leveranciers wordt aangeleverd met de bestaande gegevens, en signaleert waar zaken kunnen verbeteren.

· Je vult productspecificaties aan en werkt ze bij in onze interne systemen.

· Je werkt gestructureerd en respecteert de vooropgestelde deadlines.

· Je krijgt opdrachten van verschillende collega's binnen het team en schakelt daar vlot tussen.

Jij:

· Je bent nauwkeurig en werkt gestructureerd.

· Je hebt sterke computervaardigheden; ervaring met een ERP-systeem is een pluspunt, kennis van een PLM-systeem is mooi meegenomen maar geen vereiste.

· Je kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.

· Je beheerst het Engels goed; kennis van Frans is een troef.

· Een achtergrond in voeding is niet vereist, maar een plus.

Praktisch:

· Locatie: Langemark

· Voltijds, 5 dagen per week

· Tijdelijke opdracht van 3 maanden, mogelijks verlengbaar

· Marktconforme verloning, afgestemd op je profiel en ervaring

Onze waarden

Bij Glacier vormen onze waarden de leidraad voor alles wat we doen: van de manier waarop we ons ijs maken tot de manier waarop we elke dag samenwerken.

Agility (Wendbaarheid) betekent dat we snel, flexibel en klaar zijn om ons aan te passen aan een dynamische markt. We zoeken voortdurend naar nieuwe manieren om onze klanten te verrassen en te ondersteunen.

Frugality (Zuinigheid) weerspiegelt onze overtuiging dat we meer kunnen bereiken met minder. We gaan efficiënt om met onze middelen, maken doordachte keuzes en behandelen onze ingrediënten, apparatuur en budgetten met zorg, zodat we kunnen investeren waar het echt het verschil maakt.

Quality (Kwaliteit) vormt het hart van ons vakmanschap. We zijn trots op het produceren van uitzonderlijk ijs, het handhaven van hoge standaarden en het garanderen dat elke batch voldoet aan het kwaliteitsniveau dat onze klanten van ons verwachten.

Respect is een waarde waarmee we voorop lopen. We tonen respect voor elkaar, onze leveranciers, onze gemeenschappen en onze planeet. Respect bepaalt hoe we samenwerken, hoe we beslissingen nemen en hoe we een werkomgeving creëren waarin iedereen kan bijdragen en groeien.

Samen helpen deze waarden ons om te groeien, te innoveren en ijs te maken dat we met trots met de wereld delen.

Benieuwd naar meer? Contacteer dan Simon Santy, Talent Partner op simon.santy@glacierglobal.com voor meer informatie.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Fnality is building the future of financial market infrastructure – creating regulated, blockchain‑based payment systems to power tomorrow’s wholesale banking ecosystem. Backed by leading global banks and operating at the intersection of technology, finance, and regulation, we are powering the future of finance, together.

There are no precedents for what we're doing. With you on our side, we'll be setting new ones every day.

Working at Fnality

Be your best: We have a supportive culture that helps to bring the best out of every employee.

Feel free to explore: Bring new ideas and help us solve complex problems within a community of specialists.

Be part of something bigger: Experience an open, honest culture that promotes flexibility, wellbeing, and genuine belonging.

Feel empowered: We combine the agility and pace of a start-up with the mission and scale of a global market‑infrastructure provider.

Role Purpose

We are seeking a strategically minded Senior Product Manager to play a pivotal role in shaping product direction, driving change initiatives, coordinating delivery, and translating complex client and regulatory requirements into high‑value solutions.

You will operate at the critical intersection of product, technology, operations, regulation, and customer engagement, ensuring that Fnality Payment Systems (FnPS) in EUR, USD and other currencies meet the highest standards of usability, reliability, and strategic impact.

Reporting to the Head of Product Delivery and Change, you will work closely with Senior Product Managers and cross‑functional teams to deliver product features, market‑driven changes, and the organisational capabilities required for the next generation of blockchain‑enabled wholesale payments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Management & Strategy

  • Facilitate collaboration across product, technology, operations, risk, legal, and customer teams to deliver outcomes aligned with strategic goals.

  • Define and prioritise product features in coordination with Senior Product Managers, particularly for EUR and USD FnPS.

  • Drive continuous discovery, incorporating customer feedback, regulatory developments, and market changes (e.g., SWIFT, T2, Fedwire).

  • Complete clear business requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring review and alignment with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Participant Management.

  • Support translation of business requirements into user journeys and technical specifications.

  • Evaluate and understand emerging DvP, PvP, and digital‑asset use cases to determine necessary FnPS support and produce corresponding requirements in order to build market problem statements tailored to US market segments.

  • Produce high‑quality internal and external documentation (business requirements, feature descriptions, release notes).

  • Operate effectively in an agile delivery environment, managing the full lifecycle from concept through release.

  • Define product goals, KPIs, and value metrics, communicating insights and progress to leadership.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of the software development and release lifecycle.

2. Product Ownership & Delivery

  • Act as a liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, Participants, and external partners.

  • Lead product definition and market-facing delivery for USD FnPS, translating US participant, legal, regulatory, and market-structure requirements into a coherent product roadmap and executable delivery backlog, cooperating with and agreed with the Global Product Guild.

  • Translate between technical requirements and commercial priorities, ensuring clear, structured communication across all audiences.

  • Maintain and communicate product roadmaps that reflect shifting customer, regulatory, and market needs.

  • Support technical delivery teams by ensuring clarity, alignment, and timely execution.

  • Drive structured customer and user engagement through working groups, forums, and testing cycles.

  • Ensure product development aligns with participant needs, regulatory requirements, and business strategy.

3. Delivery Coordination

  • Support Senior Product Managers in determining feature release sequencing and defining the critical path for EUR and USD FnPS delivery.

  • Maintain and update detailed delivery plans, assigning tasks, tracking progress, and following up with owners.

  • Maintain risk, issues, and dependency logs, escalating where needed.

  • Identify key blockers to the critical path and coordinate stakeholders across Legal, Risk, Operations, and Tech to drive resolution.

  • Represent Product in governance meetings (e.g., SteerCos) alongside senior leadership.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of RTGS systems, high‑value payments, and settlement processes including DvP and PvP.

  • Practical experience with SWIFT ISO 20022 MX messaging and familiarity with MT/MX formats.

  • Knowledge of the US Clearing, and Settlement Landscape – e.g. FEDWIRE, USD liquidity (such as intraday and overnight funding, operating windows), Collateral Management and securities settlement, as well as Digital asset knowledge, exposure and experience is advantageous

  • Experience working within a regulated payment institution (bank, fintech, FMI) and engaging with legal, risk, and compliance stakeholders.

  • Understanding of financial services regulation as it relates to payments and market infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with blockchain and distributed ledger technology; strong interest in decentralised financial market infrastructure.

  • Understanding of distributed systems, reliability, security, and high-performance architectures.

  • Experience working with engineering teams and integration partners.

  • Practical experience using Confluence, Jira, and other collaboration tools.

  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and agile delivery methodologies.

Business & Communication Skills

  • Strong ability to translate between technical and non‑technical audiences.

  • Excellent written communication skills, including structured documentation for stakeholders and customers.

  • Ability to influence without authority across complex, matrixed environments.

  • Proven stakeholder‑management experience, including risk, issue, and dependency management.

Ways of Working

  • Highly organised, structured, and detail‑oriented.

  • Comfortable working in innovative, fast‑moving, ambiguous environments.

  • Skilled in facilitation of customer and user working groups.

  • Willing to roll up sleeves and support hands‑on delivery as needed.

Personal Attributes

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and outcomes‑driven.

  • Collaborative, transparent, and committed to continuous improvement.

  • Strong holistic thinker with excellent problem-solving skills.

  • Customer-obsessed, ensuring solutions deliver real, measurable value.

Why Join Fnality?

We employ curious, adaptable individuals who thrive in high‑change environments and value autonomy, learning, and team collaboration. You’ll be part of a mission to build resilient, transparent, and efficient payment systems for the digital age—powered by DLT and designed for tokenised financial markets.

Eligibility

This role is based in Connecticut, and applicants must reside within the tri-state area. You will be expected to attend the office 2–3 days per week.

How will we use the information about you?

We will use your personal information to process your application, to enable us to assess your suitability for a role and for other legitimate business purposes such as improving our sites and talent management practices. We may share your data with third parties to achieve these purposes. We will not use or share your information for marketing purposes.

We will take appropriate security measures to safeguard your information in accordance with data protection legislation. If you would like further information about how your information may be processed by us, please contact us at privacy@fnality.org.

title: Engineer
description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances. Working here means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else — you'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About the role

Being an engineer at Klarna means building and owning the systems that move money for millions of people — and that responsibility doesn't end when those systems ship. Your team and your focus can also change as the business changes, and the domain you join may look different in a year.

We are searching for someone whose work is already ahead of where their experience says it should be - that means we care more about what you've built than how long you've been building. We want to hear about a problem you spotted yourself and then solved.

What you'll do

  • Own real production code from day one.

  • Take a problem that's vaguely defined, ask the questions that sharpen it, and come back with something working rather than something planned.

  • Learn a large unfamiliar codebase faster than feels comfortable, and be the person who then documents the part nobody had written down.

  • Make small decisions well and say what you decided against - the habit matters more at this stage than the size of the decision.

  • Use AI as a working method rather than a demo, and know why the output is right before you ship it.

  • Ask for review, act on it, and give it back. The engineers here will spend time on you; the trade is that you use it.

Who you are

  • You've built things beyond what a course, a job description or an assignment required, and you can talk about why you chose to.

  • You learn fast and you can show it - something you knew nothing about six months ago that you're now the go-to person for.

  • You can explain a system you built to someone outside your field.

  • You're specific about what you personally did versus what your team or your tooling did.

  • You're comfortable being the least experienced person in the room and asking the question anyway.

  • You've had something go wrong that was yours, and you can say what you changed afterwards.

  • You want to be pushed. This is not a role for someone optimising for comfort.

Things you should know before applying

  • Working together: We value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.

  • Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.

  • Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.

  • This is a general Engineer opening, not tied to one fixed team. Depending on need at the time of hiring, you could be placed in one of several domains. A domain is a group of teams working on a related set of problems — for example, everything to do with risk, or everything to do with checkout.

Please include a CV in English. Concrete beats comprehensive — what you built, what it did, what it cost. Curious about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site.
