title: Therapist Acute, BayPointe
description:
Overview

Our children's hospital serves children ages 5 to 12 years and adolescent’s ages 13 to 19 years who are in psychiatric crisis. Children whose behaviors are life threatening, destructive or disabling or that require 24-hour monitoring and assessment meet criteria for admission. The program provides assessment and stabilization of psychiatric symptoms. The goal of treatment is to promote the highest level of functioning through an individualized treatment plan. The focus is on returning consumers to their homes or to the least restrictive level of care as quickly as possible, with comprehensive aftercare plans. The estimated stay in this BayPointe program is three to ten days.

Responsibilities

Therapist in a hospital acute setting provides individual, group and family therapy. They formulate treatment plans, behavioral management plans and provides clinical assessments of the consumers. They respond to crisis situations to help deescalate and resolve the situation, as well as assisting with seclusion and restraining as required.

Essential Functions

  • Utilizes assessment data to support a DSM V, DSM IV- TR or DSM IV diagnosis
  • Provides effective clinical assessment of the consumer
  • Provides individual, group, family and play therapy mode, utilizing basic therapeutic models and theories according to consumer needs as stated in the treatment plan
  • Formulates appropriate treatment plan along with consumer and family/guardian, as appropriate
  • Acts as a team leader providing clinical direction and training to the behavioral staff
  • Assists with seclusion and restraint as required, per AltaPointe policy and procedure
  • Formulates and oversees implementation of appropriate behavior management plans
  • Evaluates the consumer for discharge planning or movement to a less restrictive environment and arranges such services, as needed
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize the elements of a crisis state and knows how to deescalate or resolve the situation
  • Effectively collaborates with the treatment team members and outside sources in the delivery of clinical services
  • Assists in approving movies, television programs, etc. as appropriate to program guidelines
  • Assures that certification/program standards and objectives are met
  • Participates in late night, weekend, and holiday therapist rotation providing group and family counseling, crisis intervention and overseeing on site consumer visitation facility wide (if applicable)
  • Adheres to professional code of ethics
  • Documents in a timely fashion per AltaPointe policy
  • Documents appropriate, complete, and clinically comprehensive mental health assessments
  • Documents in a clear and concise manner, types of consumer problems, treatment goals addressed, services, and techniques used
  • Effectively manages caseload based on consumer needs
  • Maintains current license and requirements for renewals (i.e. CEU’s), if applicable, and attends regular workshops and in-services
  • Seeks clinical supervision and consultation as needed
  • Accepts and employs suggestions for improvement
  • Actively works to enhance clinical skills
  • Documents measurable and specific goals in the treatment plan
  • Documents case disposition, case closings, follow-up and referrals
  • Documents legibly
  • Meets AltaPointe productivity standards
  • Treats consumers with care, dignity and compassion
  • Respects consumer’s privacy and confidentiality
  • Is pleasant and cooperative with others
  • Assists consumers and visitors as needed
  • Personal values don’t inhibit ability to relate and care for others
  • Is sensitive to the consumer’s needs, expectations and individual differences
  • Is gentle and calm with consumers and families
  • Actively participates in Performance Improvement activities
  • Actively participates in AltaPointe committees as required
  • Completes assigned tasks in a timely manner
  • Accesses appropriate community resources according to consumer needs
  • Follows AltaPointe policies and procedures

Physical Requirements

  • There is frequent standing, sitting, and walking which are in bursts of 5 to 10 minutes. However, there are times when this can be extended to pacing with the consumer (time could be undetermined), and at times sitting and standing can be extended with the employee having the ability to change positions as permitted by the observance and behavior of the consumer at that time.
  • There is occasional forward bending from the hips while kneeling to reach to the side.
  • There is an occasional need to be able to assume a full squat/lunge from a standing position.
  • There is an occasional need to maintain back extension while being on stomach with one’s own body weight on hips and legs. This position is maintained for several minutes.
  • Occasionally, be able to put one’s own body weight on one knee and one elbow on the same side of one’s body.
  • Occasionally, be able to kneel and reach to same side toward the floor.
  • Lift up to 15 pounds from the floor to various levels, including from floor to overhead occasionally during shift.
  • Have the ability to lift up to 50 pounds to assist in activities of daily living, as required. Be able to lift up to 50 pounds from floor to waist.
  • Strong grasp is needed to use keys to open doors throughout the facility, and to maintain constant contact with a consumer during a restraint procedure or with other hold techniques.
  • Pushing/pulling force up to 25 pounds occasionally during shift.
  • At times, be able to ambulate in a quick manner (jog/run) for distances up to 50 feet.
  • Carrying up to 15 pounds various distances throughout the facility.
  • Occasional step ladder climbing to retrieve medical records that are on higher shelves.
  • Fine manipulation/dexterity to handle medical records and complete documentation.
  • At times therapy may be inside or outside the facility; therefore, some activities will dictate physical requirements for playing or games.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in a mental health discipline.

title: Productiemedewerker Sample Reception & Registration
description:
Jij zorgt dat onze monsters correct worden ontvangen, geregistreerd en verwerkt. In deze rol werk je met uiteenlopende producten en systemen, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Je houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk gebeurt, werkt nauwkeurig en ziet direct het effect van jouw werk op de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening. Jij bent de schakel tussen ontvangst, laboratorium en partnerlabs, en daarmee een belangrijke bijdrage aan de voedselveiligheid in Nederland.

Wat maakt deze functie bijzonder?

  • Jij zorgt dat monsters correct worden geregistreerd, zodat analyses betrouwbaar kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
  • Je werkt met een grote variatie aan voedingsmiddelen, grondstoffen en importproducten uit o.a. de havengebieden.
  • Je krijgt ruimte om mee te denken over procesverbeteringen en innovatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Op de afdeling Sample Reception & Registration komen dagelijks monsters binnen die getest worden op voedselveiligheid. Als Productiemedewerker Sample Reception & Registration ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontvangen, controleren, registreren, sorteren en prioriteren van deze producten.

Je controleert of het aangeleverde product overeenkomt met de opdracht. Klopt het niet? Dan neem je proactief contact op met de klant om te achterhalen wat de bedoeling is. Zo voorkom je fouten in het verdere proces en zorg je dat het laboratorium precies weet welke analyses uitgevoerd moeten worden.

Je werkt met verschillende systemen en codes om ervoor te zorgen dat elk monster op de juiste manier wordt verwerkt. Dat vraagt nauwkeurigheid, overzicht en een gestructureerde manier van werken.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, efficiënt en volgens richtlijnen.
  • Je bent proactief, resultaatgericht en behoudt overzicht.
  • Je werkt graag in een team en communiceert duidelijk.
  • Je zoekt een baan voor 32–40 uur met doorgroeimogelijkheden.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband (32–40 uur).
  • Salaris tussen €2.650,00 en €3.000,00 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
  • 25 vakantiedagen (40 uur) en mogelijkheid om extra verlof te kopen.
  • Volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten of reiskostenvergoeding bij gebruik van de auto.
  • Pensioenregeling met flexibiliteit om minder te werken zonder verlies van opbouw.
  • Winstdelingsregeling en individueel keuzebudget voor extra flexibiliteit.
  • Inclusieve werkomgeving met keuzevrijheid voor feestdagen die jij belangrijk vindt.

Over Eurofins

Bij Eurofins Food, Feed & Water werken we vanuit tien locaties in Nederland aan veilig voedsel, diervoeding en water. Eurofins LabCo in Barendrecht is gespecialiseerd in analyses van grondstoffen en voedingsmiddelen uit de Rotterdamse haven. We werken met collega’s van verschillende achtergronden en geloven in gelijke kansen. Bij ons draait het om jouw talent en motivatie.

Solliciteren

title: Donation Pick Up Specialist
description:

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Introduction

Evident is an intelligence platform that benchmarks and tracks AI adoption across the financial services sector. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AI across the sector by creating the most complete, unbiased, and transparent benchmarks of AI capability.

Since the launch of our flagship product in January 2023, the Evident AI Index has rapidly become the global standard benchmark for AI maturity in financial services. We now have an evolving suite of products that power strategic decision-making for the world’s largest institutions.

Why join us

  • We are index experts: Our Co-Founders Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Annabel Ayles have more than 30 years of experience building complex indices that drive positive change in the world.

  • We are building a cutting-edge research team: We use the latest techniques in machine learning to build faster and better data collection and analysis tools.

  • World-class backing: We’ve been backed by some of the world’s leading tech investors, including the backers of Revolut and the tech commentator Scott Galloway.

  • Market Impact: We’re working with some of the world's largest banks, helping them shape their AI strategies impacting millions of customers.

If you are interested in advancing your career at a fast-growing, innovative and impact-driven company, you can read about Our Values and Our Commitment to Responsible AI.

The Role

We are looking for an execution-focused Product Manager to own the evolution of our core products. You will be the architect of our value proposition, sitting at the intersection of commercial strategy, client delivery, data, design and engineering.

Your goal is to continue to develop our world-class benchmarking data into a scalable, multi-vertical platform. You will be responsible for productizing our deliverables, and creating a seamless interface between our proprietary data and the leaders who need it to make decisions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own the product vision across banking, payments, insurance and new industries - for our Index Benchmark and/or Intelligence Platform.

  • Translate commercial targets and feasibility considerations into a prioritised roadmap.

  • Identify and execute on opportunities for product evolutions or expansion, in collaboration with other teams.

2. Productization and Scalability

title: Finance Lead
description:
About Us


At Butterfly Effect, we believe bold creativity transforms communities and brands alike. We are a creative house of community builders, conversation drivers and chaos-makers. Our mission is to harness the power of culture, creativity and strategic insight to elevate brands, shape conversations and spark lasting impact.


Role Brief


This role is in the heart of the Butterfly Effect. As a Commercial Finance Lead you will take ownership of finance across the business from day-to-day financial control through to commercial decision support for our sales and leadership teams. This is a broad, business-

partnering role suited to someone who equally comfortable in the detail of an

invoice run and in the boardroom challenging a pipeline forecast.


Your Impact


  • Financial Control Run the day-to-day finance operation: invoicing, payment runs, supplier set-up, and managing our external bookkeeper. You'll own the integrity of our numbers in Xero and make sure billing happens on time, accurately, and in line with project delivery.

  • Credit Control & Supplier Management Own the working capital cycle end to end. Chase outstanding invoices, build strong relationships with client AP teams, and keep DSO under control. On the other side, manage supplier relationships, payment terms, and the payment run making sure talent, freelancers, and partners are paid on time and we're getting the best terms.

  • Cash Flow Forecasting Build and maintain a 13-week rolling cash flow forecast that the leadership team can actually rely on. Tie it to the live pipeline, project delivery, and supplier commitments, and use it to flag pressure points early and inform decisions on hiring, investment, and timing.

  • Project Accounting Own the financial picture at a project level. Track revenue recognition against delivery milestones, monitor project margins as work progresses, manage WIP and accruals, and make sure each engagement is billed and reported accurately. You'll be the link between what the delivery team is doing and what shows up in the numbers.

  • Commercial Finance & Sales Support Partner closely with the sales team to provide the reporting, margin analysis, and decision support they need to win profitable work. You'll own pipeline reporting (HubSpot through to revenue), deal-level margin reviews, and help shape pricing on new opportunities.

  • Operational Analysis Translate the numbers into insight. Track performance against quarterly targets, flag risks early, and provide the leadership team with a clear view of where revenue, margin, and capacity are heading. Build and maintain the reporting that helps us run the business week to week.

  • Leadership Team Partnering Sit alongside the LT as a trusted commercial sounding board. Bring a frank, evidence-based view to resourcing, investment, and growth decisions. Prepare the financial inputs for management meetings and help turn strategy into numbers.



Your Experience


  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) or strong QBE with relevant experience

  • Background in a creative, influencer, or social agency (or wider professional services) you understand project margins, talent and production costs, and the rhythm of client billing in a campaign-led business

  • Strong commercial instincts; you can read a P&L, a cash flow, and a sales pipeline and tell us what matters

  • Hands-on experience running credit control and managing a 13-week cash flow in a working-capital-sensitive business

  • Comfortable being the only finance person in the room proactive, organised, and able to set your own priorities

  • Direct, plain-spoken communicator who can flex from detail with the bookkeeper to strategic conversations with the LT

  • Claude-savvy and AI-curious - we want someone who actively uses Claude (or equivalent tools) to work smarter, automate the routine, and reimagine how a finance function operates. If you've already built workflows, drafted models, or streamlined reporting using AI, we want to hear about it.

  • Confident in Xero, HubSpot (or similar CRM), and Excel



Celebrating Diversity


At Butterfly Effect, we champion diversity and inclusivity in every sense of background, experience, thought and identity. We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and invite applications from people of all genders, ethnicities, experiences and orientations. We’re committed to building an environment where everyone can thrive and bring their full selves to their work.


We want this to be the best place you’ve ever worked, a place where you are heard, supported and empowered to make a real difference.

title: Damage Specialist
description:
Job Summary
Project Resources Group (PRG) is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Cable & Telecom Damage Specialist in the Minneapolis, MN area. In this hands-on role, you will collect, analyze, and review evidence related to third-party utility damages to determine liability. This role is ideal for someone who thrives working independently and takes pride in delivering precise, professional results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform on-site assessments of underground and aerial cable plant damages.
  • Conduct interviews at damage sites with contractors, technicians, witnesses, police, homeowners, etc.
  • Professionally photograph and document the damaged scene to accurately portray and determine liability.
  • Collaborate with the client’s locate company and exchange relevant damage information.
  • Analyze and review all evidence related to third-party utility damage for the purpose of determining a liable party.
  • Learn, understand, and apply State Dig Laws and Statutes, excavator requirements, and NESC standards.
  • Build and develop a professional working relationship with the client, contractors, technicians, management team, and other personnel.
  • Work with the client and contractors to obtain and write up job repair costs from the damage.
  • Compile all case-related material and email it to the local handling office.
  • Assist the Claims Recovery team with follow-up actions after damage site reviews.
  • Develop and maintain monthly market reporting and lead client meetings to review updates.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of the entire PRG claims process.

Required Qualifications

  • Must possess a valid and current driver’s license, reliable personal vehicle suitable for representing the company, and auto insurance meeting both federal and state requirements, with minimum auto liability coverage of 100/300/100 for bodily injury and property damage.
  • Must be willing and able to utilize a personal vehicle for work-related travel as required.
  • Must possess strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and comfortable using public or shared computer systems
  • Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills
  • Familiarity with the cable industry and/or utility locating industry
  • Previous experience in the telephone industry, including equipment and job costing is highly desirable
  • Background in business operations with a strong attention to detail
  • Proven ability to multitask and effectively manage time in a dynamic environment
  • Claims background is also a plus

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to drive a personal vehicle to various damage sites, including daytime and nighttime travel.
  • Ability to walk and work on uneven terrain and in varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, or reach as necessary to perform essential job duties.

Compensation and Benefits

We offer a competitive salary ($51,000 - $54,000 based on experience), plus overtime for any hours worked over 40 hours per week. Along with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • National mileage reimbursement for vehicle use
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
  • 401(k) retirement plan, with company match after 1 year
  • Short-term disability coverage after 1 year
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Additional perks such as company-paid life insurance, and other supplemental insurances available

title: Production Planner-Iksan
description:
Primary Responsibilities:

The Production Planner coordinates, plans and manages the production schedule for the Suez Water Technologies & Solutions manufacturing facility or toller, and develops initiatives to improve inventory levels, minimise scrap/waste and slow moving non-moving materials.

The Production Planner will not only participate, but take a lead role in continuous improvement activities of diverse scope and complexity to improve the efficiency of planning to meet customer demand. In addition, they will monitor production progress and identify possible problem areas in time to take corrective action and meet the customer OTD.

You will be required to focus on achieving performance objectives which are in line with the organisation’s vision and overcome those obstacles that may inhibit Suez from achieving these business goals.

You are required to:

  • Investigate and develop new avenues to achieve optimum production and throughput
  • Accurately monitor and maintain production schedules to satisfy customer orders and forecasts
  • Coordinate with the Commercial team to maintain a strong demand planning rigor
  • Manage planning performance by addressing day-to-day issues and adjust operations to meet changing demands

As the Production Planner, it is expected that you continuously raise the standard of your plant/site performance by developing, inspiring, challenging and demonstrating operational excellence for the region.

This critical role has the following key accountabilities:

  • Plan, schedule, coordinate and approve release of process orders to manufacturing based on material and capacity availability.
  • Provide input to management; reschedule and/or interface with customer service, PSI, customers and operations to reschedule production in the event of demand changes, labour and material shortages, backlogs and other potential schedule interruptions.
  • Utilise the current SAP system and worksheets that support production planning, capacity planning, and operational management.
  • Analyse customer demand information, forecasts, customer orders, vessel optimisation, labour and material availability and develop a flexible yet efficient production schedule.
  • Review MRP prompts, demand plans, Inventory reports to determine what changes need to be made to the schedule to accommodate latest demand change with balance between production optimisation and inventory levels.
  • Create and maintain production plans while considering the raw materials and resources available to manufacture products by the customer required dates.
  • Perform the detail capacity planning on constraints on equipment, labour, and vessel space; review the scheduled load and compare it to available tank or toller capacities and adjust the schedule to alternative with maximum capacity optimisation.
  • Manage and update the production schedule based on demand and availability of Raw Materials
  • Work with Sourcing to coordinate the timing of materials required to be delivered
  • Work with Production/Toller to ensure the planned schedule is executed efficiently and meets current demand
  • Analyse inventory levels associated to production in comparison to demand variation and future forecast to determine best combination of raw materials and reasonable stocks.
  • Participate in daily production review meeting on production to track output and issues in real-time; interact with Supply Chain team on a daily basis to resolve issue regarding production schedules and adjust schedule upon latest change to meet service requirement by minimised interruption
  • Provide suggestions to Production Manager, PSI, Supply Chain leaders on process improvements
  • EHS, Quality and compliance
  • Challenge and influence others on Safety and Compliance standards.
  • Contribute to culture of continuous improvement, open communication and learning.
  • Demonstrate active safety, quality & environmental leadership and take ownership / responsibility
  • Build and maintain a risk management culture by forming positive relationships with Safety, Quality, Environment, Community with all stakeholders
  • Demonstrate a commitment to continually improving quality, environment, health and safety performance.
  • Become familiar with and abide by all applicable Suez policies and guidelines, and relevant statutory obligations and ensure comprehensive permit compliance for the facility and region.
  • Developing and leading by example on a positive safety culture that drives down the number of recordable incidents and accidents, as well as first aids.
  • Report all occupational injury, illness, near miss incidents, environmental spills, and quality issues regardless of its severity.

Core Duties

  • Production Control
  1. Monitor & review production plan/progress against deadline targets to ensure on time delivery.
  2. Adjust the production schedule as required and communicate any change to delivery date with the PSI, commercial team, and customer service accordingly.
  3. Ensure that all production related activity is value added & cost effective.
  4. Be capable of translating the production plan into a time-phased planning schedule.
  5. Implement the most cost effective bills of material (BOM’s) are used as part of the production of finished goods
  6. Utilise supply chain methodologies to ensure accurate and timely production order generation
  7. Understand the role of managing stock in SAP and manage schedule changes through the SAP
  • Demand management and forecasting
  1. Understand the principles and applications of demand forecasting.
  2. Have knowledge of the critical requirements for effective forecasting: establishing time horizons, determining the level of forecasting detail, and determining the forecastable database.
  3. Be capable of establishing a close relationship with the commercial team to ensure forecast accuracy.
  4. Be able to apply various methods to work with random, seasonal, trend, and cyclical impacts.
  5. Establish key performance indicators of forecast accuracy.
  6. Ensure the interaction with the PSI and commercial team, and track and maintain the forecast through timely and accurate feedback

  1. Understand capacity management relationship to MRP.
  2. Establish, measure, monitor, and adjust capacity levels to execute all production schedules.
  3. Determine available capacity before planned Purchase Rec’s and PO’s are released.

  2. Project inventory levels on a quarterly basis and achieve desired inventory turn targets.

title: IT Business Analyst - LIMS Process Expert
description:
In a nutshell

As a Business Analyst, expert in LIMS Processes, you will support our in‑house chromatography data processing application. You will translate laboratory and business requirements into clear deliverables, optimize analytical workflows for quality and efficiency, and ensure compliance with major EU environmental testing laboratory standards.

You’ will partner with laboratory leaders, product and engineering teams, finance, and commercial stakeholders to standardize processes and guide delivery of features that streamline instrument data capture, processing, quality control (QC), technical review, and reporting across hyphenated and non-hyphenated analytical workflows (gas chromatography GC, liquid chromatography LC, inductively coupled plasma ICP and mass spectrometry (MS).

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Based in Almeria, Spain; you will join a globally distributed team in support of our European Environmental Testing business, with a primary focus on chromatography data processing application.

How can you help us?

You will work on the following main areas:

Strategy & Operational Analysis, to:

  • Assess the EU Environmental Testing market, regulatory expectations, and laboratory operational data to identify opportunities for efficiency, quality improvement, and margin enhancement.
  • Support EU‑focused pricing, client segmentation, and demand modeling to guide product and investment priorities.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance turnaround time (TAT), analytical quality, data reliability, and regulatory alignment.

Product / Requirements Ownership (Chromatography Data System Software), to:

  • Serve as primary liaison between EU laboratory stakeholders and the Product Development team.
  • Elicit, document, and refine Business Requirements, User Requirements, and acceptance criteria (including non‑functional needs like performance and usability).
  • Maintain and update process documentation, including BRD (Business Requirements Document), URD (User Requirements Document), and BPMN (Business Process Model & Notation).
  • Collaborate with Product Development team to translate requirements into functional designs; help groom backlogs and support release scoping.
  • Lead EU‑regional user acceptance testing (UAT), business sign‑off, and change management for new features and workflow updates.

Cross‑Functional Business Support, to:

  • Partner with laboratory directors, technical leads, and product teams across the EU to harmonize chromatography data workflows.
  • Facilitate workshops with subject matter experts (SMEs) to challenge assumptions, streamline workflows, and improve cross‑site alignment.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across operations, R&D, quality, IT, and commercial units.

Process Optimization & Quality Alignment, to:

  • Map current vs. future‑state EU laboratory workflows; identify gaps, risks, and compliance needs.
  • Ensure alignment with Eurofins Quality System Documents (SOPs, methods, work instructions).
  • Ensure processes, requirements, and software workflows comply with key EU laboratory frameworks, including: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel testing requirements, and EU Member State national accreditation bodies operating under EA (European co‑operation for Accreditation)
  • Support audit preparation, nonconformity resolution, CAPAs, and continuous improvement.
  • Track corrective actions and measure system/process impact post‑deployment.

Data, Reporting & Financial Insight, to:

  • Build dashboards (performance, throughput, error rates, QC metrics, method performance, adoption/usage).
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and operational reviews with EU‑specific actionable insights.
  • Validate product requirements with data, quantify product value, and measure outcomes.

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

You have:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Science, Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • 3+ years as a Business Analyst or Product Owner/Analyst in software, laboratory operations, or scientific environments.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional documentation in an Agile environment (e.g., Jira/Confluence).
  • Familiarity with laboratory informatics such as LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) and CDS (Chromatography Data System).
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills across multi‑cultural EU teams.
  • Working knowledge of EU environmental testing compliance frameworks, including but not limited to: ISO/IEC 17025, EU Ecolabel requirements, and European Accreditation (EA)
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel (SQL/BI tools a plus).

You are:

  • A strong communicator in English (written/oral).
  • A fast learner.
  • Self-motivated with a can-do attitude.

What else should I know?

The following skills are an advantage:

  • Experience in environmental (chromatography workflows is a plus), food, agroscience or biopharma testing and laboratory operations in EU‑regulated scientific environments.
  • Experience building BPMN workflows and writing functional specifications.
  • Exposure to LIMS, CDS, or scientific data management platforms; understanding of instrument integration.
  • MBA, M.Sc., or advanced scientific/technical degree.

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6,95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

title: Director, Data Center Operations
description:
Position Summary

The Director, Data Center Operations is responsible for the day-to-day operation, readiness, utilization, customer support, capacity planning, vendor coordination, and operational execution across the Company's data center operations.


This position is accountable for ensuring safe, efficient, and highly available operations while supporting the Company's AI infrastructure, bare metal cloud services, and customer deployments. This role requires a hands-on leader who can operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while balancing strategic planning with direct operational execution.


The Director operates within a matrix organization. While certain supporting organizations, including the NOC, RMA, deployment technicians, logistics, and other specialized teams—may report through separate management structures, this role is responsible for coordinating and directing all operational activities occurring within the data centers to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Functional reporting relationships for those teams remain with their respective department leaders.


The Quality & Compliance, Logistics, Facilities and Asset Management functions report directly to this position and are responsible for supporting the Company's quality programs, operational compliance initiatives, inventory control, asset lifecycle management, movement material between data centers and certifications, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701.


Key Responsibilities

Data Center Operations

  • Lead the daily operation of the Company's data center facilities.
  • Ensure maximum uptime, operational readiness, and service quality.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities, customer work, installations, and operational changes.
  • Support capacity planning for power, space, cooling, and infrastructure utilization.
  • Implement and continuously improve operational standards and procedures.
  • Coordinate customer installations, expansions, maintenance windows, migrations, and decommissioning activities.
  • Manage third-party vendors and contractors performing work within company facilities.

Operational Leadership

  • Coordinate activities between Operations, Engineering, NOC, Deployment, Logistics, Security, Facilities, Procurement, and Customer Success.
  • Prioritize data center, operational work across multiple sites.
  • Ensure resources are aligned with customer commitments.
  • Remove operational bottlenecks and improve execution.
  • Lead daily operational meetings and escalation activities.
  • Ability, and more importantly the willingness, to be hands-on to support challenges and escalations.

Capacity Planning

  • Coordinate capacity planning for rack space, power, cooling, and infrastructure.
  • Assist with forecasting future operational requirements.
  • Support new site readiness and facility expansions.
  • Improve operational utilization and efficiency.

Strategic Planning

  • Participate in operational planning initiatives supporting company growth.
  • Recommend operational improvements and process enhancements.
  • Assist leadership in developing operational roadmaps and infrastructure plans.

Change Management

  • Coordinate operational maintenance activities.
  • Ensure readiness before production changes.
  • Coordinate planned maintenance windows and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Reduce operational risk through standardized change management practices.

Budget Support

  • Work with executive leadership on operational budgets and forecasting.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.
  • Monitor operational expenditures and vendor performance.

Compliance & Quality

  • Provide leadership and oversight for operational compliance programs.
  • Manage the Quality & Compliance Manager.
  • Support compliance with:
    • SOC 2
    • ISO 27001
    • ISO 27701
    • Customer security requirements
    • Company operational policies and procedures


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in data center operations or mission-critical facilities.
  • 3–7 years of leadership or management experience.
  • Experience operating multi-megawatt data center environments.
  • Strong organizational, operational, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
  • Experience operating successfully within a high-growth or rapidly evolving start-up environment
  • Proven ability to balance strategic leadership responsibilities with hands-on operational execution.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AI, HPC, GPU, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with NVIDIA or AMD GPU environments.
  • Experience with high-density liquid-cooled infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2 and ISO compliance programs.
  • Experience in colocation or managed services environments.


Compensation and Benefits

We are committed to supporting the people who help us grow. We offer a competitive compensation package that includes base salary, performance bonuses and stock option opportunities.


The base salary range for the Director, Data Center Operations is $170,000 to $200,000 This pay range reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay range for this job for the location for which it has been posted. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data.


Our benefits package includes comprehensive medical, dental, vision coverage, 401(k) with company match, generous paid time-off and professional development support.


Why Join Cirrascale?

Join a growing team that's pushing the boundaries of AI infrastructure. At Cirrascale, you’ll contribute to projects powering next-generation AI applications while working with top-tier hardware in a collaborative and innovative environment. From custom deployments to hands-on customer support, every role here plays a part in enabling breakthroughs in AI.

title: Er du vår nye superhelt medarbeider? 20-30% stilling
description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Sartor?

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger.

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg!

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite.

title: Assisterende senterleder SATS i Bergen
description:
💪 Assisterende senterleder i SATS

Har du et ønske om å jobbe med mennesker, samtidig som du vil bidra til å bekjempe en av vår tids største helseutfordringer? Det er nettopp det vi gjør i SATS ved å inspirere medlemmene våre og gjøre dem sunnere og gladere. Som assisterende senterleder støtter du senterleder i den daglige driften av senteret, med særlig fokus på salg, medlemsservice og renhold. Du bidrar til at senteret fremstår innbydende, er godt vedlikeholdt og gir medlemmene en best mulig opplevelse.

Du er «manager on duty» og har det overordnede ansvaret på sentret når senterleder ikke er til stede. Trives du i en aktiv og variert rolle der ingen dager er like, kan dette være stillingen for deg!


🏋️ En viktig lederrolle i en kompleks drift

SATS-sentrene våre er aktive møteplasser med høy aktivitet gjennom store deler av dagen. Som assisterende senterleder har du en sentral rolle i å sikre at den daglige driften fungerer sømløst for både medlemmer og medarbeidere. Stillingen innebærer ansvar for mennesker, drift, medlemsopplevelse og resultater, og du må trives med å håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig. Du er en tydelig leder i hverdagen, tar beslutninger når det er nødvendig, og bidrar til at senteret holder høy standard innen service, salg, renhold og sikkerhet. Dette er en operativ lederrolle for deg som ønsker å ta ansvar, trives i et høyt tempo og evner å skape struktur og gode opplevelser i en variert og til tider hektisk arbeidshverdag.

📍 Våre sentre i Bergen

Vi rekrutterer nå assisterende senterledere til SATS Vestkanten, SATS Wergeland og SATS Danmarksplass. Selv om arbeidsoppgavene og ansvarsområdene er de samme, har hvert senter sin egen identitet, medlemsmasse og energi.

SATS Vestkanten er et moderne og attraktivt treningssenter i Vestkanten Storsenter. Senteret har et bredt treningstilbud og tiltrekker seg medlemmer i alle aldre, noe som skaper en variert og spennende arbeidshverdag med høyt aktivitetsnivå.

SATS Wergeland er et populært nærmiljøsenter med en sterk lokal tilhørighet. Her møter du mange faste medlemmer og får muligheten til å bygge gode relasjoner gjennom tett oppfølging, service og synlig tilstedeværelse i hverdagen.

SATS Danmarksplass er et sentralt plassert bysenter med høy medlemsaktivitet gjennom hele dagen. Senteret kjennetegnes av et høyt tempo, et mangfold av medlemmer og et dynamisk miljø hvor ingen dager er helt like.

Når du søker, kan du selv velge hvilket av disse sentrene du ønsker å søke deg til. Oppgi gjerne ditt foretrukne senter i søknaden, så vil vi ta dette med i vurderingen.

🌟 Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Salg og medlemsvekst: Aktivt samarbeide med ditt team for å ønske nye medlemmer velkomne og levere eksepsjonell kundeservice til en hver tid.

  • Yte eksepsjonell service: Være tilstede og imøtekommen både i resepsjonen og i treningsområdet for å sørge for at våre medlemmer blir ivaretatt.

  • Sørge for et rent og trygt senter: Passe på at alle områder er ryddige, godt vedlikeholdte og oppfyller SATS sine høye standarder.

  • Bistå med administrative oppgaver: Støtte med administrative oppgaver, organisering og planlegging for å sikre fremdrift.

  • Fleksibilitet: Arbeidstiden din vil variere fra tidlig morgen til sent på kveld samt i helger for å sikre tilstedeværelse i de mest travle tidspunkter.


🤩 Kjenner du deg igjen?

  • Du har gode kommunikasjonsevner, og har en sosial tilnærming til andre mennesker.

  • Du er strukturert og ryddig, samt ansvarsfull og pliktoppfyllende.

  • Du liker salg, kundeservice og renhold.

  • Snakker flytende norsk og engelsk.

  • Etterlever våre verdier: Members First, Accountable, Professional, and Extraordinary.


🚀 Hvorfor jobbe i SATS:

  • Mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell: Hjelpe mennesker med å bli sunnere og lykkeligere.

  • Bli en del av et mestringsteam: Du vil jobbe med likesinnede mennesker som deler de samme verdiene og lidenskap.

  • Utvikling: Gode utviklingsmuligheter blant annet gjennom vårt interne utdanningstilbud - SATS Academy.

  • Flere appellerende personalgoder.


🤝 Samarbeid:

Du vil jobbe tett med senterleder, og få hjelp fra våre støttefunksjoner, inkludert HR og regionale ledere.

Er du klar for en spennende og givende rolle med store utviklingsmuligheter og ønsker å gjøre en forskjell? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!


Ønsket oppstart i denne stillingen er snarest, eller etter nærmere avtale.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. We challenge where it matters and own the outcome. We combine strategic thinking, customer-centric service design, and agile engineering practices to accelerate innovation in a tech-driven world.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

  • Join our Digital & Data team working alongside product, design and a wide range of other experts and cross-disciplinary teams to bring ideas to life through innovative software solutions.
  • Grow a flexible and unique career within a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation, and curiosity. You have the option to progress with us on a technical career track. No need to go onto the Partner career track if this doesn’t align with what you want to do.
  • Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week.
  • Work on a broad variety of projects and tech stacks for clients across seven sectors - no project is ever the same
  • Join other experts within our supportive and collaborative tech community through knowledge-sharing and peer-level support, coaching and mentoring
  • Deepen your expertise through our a culture of learning and growth – you’ll have budget to take courses (technical and non-technical training), plus gain certifications

Our tech stack 🚀

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, you can expect to work with the following technologies to ensure scalable, high-performance applications:

  • AWS is a significant growth area for us with a diverse and growing capability and we are looking for a Data Engineer with experience in AWS cloud technologies for ETL pipeline, data warehouse and data lake design/building and data movement.
  • AWS data and analytics services (or open-source equivalent) such as EMR, Glue, RedShift, Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB.

What you can expect 🌱

  • Work to agile best practices and cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. You’ll be using your technical skills to problem solve with our clients, as well as working on internal projects
  • Live in-person whiteboarding sessions to problem solve as a team, alongside asynchronous communication on Teams
  • Hybrid working with the team on client site or in our office a minimum of two days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site.
  • An environment that deeply cares about its values Values | PA Consulting
  • You’ll work alongside colleagues from across PA – delivering transformative digital solutions to today’s most complex business challenges.
  • You’ll be designing and building for the AWS cloud

Essential requirements ✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

  • You thrive in problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in the design and deployment of production data pipelines from ingestion to consumption within a big data architecture, using Java, Python, Scala, Spark, SQL.
  • Experience performing tasks such as writing scripts, extracting data using APIs, writing SQL queries etc.
  • Experience in processing large amounts of structured and unstructured data, including integrating data from multiple sources through ingestion and curation functions on AWS cloud using AWS native or custom programming.

Assessment process ⚖️

Please note that the interview stages may be subject to change based on the specific requirements of the role.

  • Quick call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
  • Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
  • Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
  • Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a mini case study and discussion around your client-centricity (60 mins)

title: Pointing and Tracking Optomechanical Engineer
description:
Role

Own the productization of compact pointing, acquisition, and tracking (PAT) optomechanical subsystems for Azora's modular optical ground stations and space terminals. You will guide the process of fine-steering and coarse-pointing systems from commercial prototype through field qualification, ensuring microradian-class stability no matter the weather or platform where the Azora systems are located.

Responsibilities

  • Design optomechanical assemblies for beam steering: gimbals, fast-steering mirrors (FSMs), telescope mounts, relay optics, and fiber-coupling stages.

  • Perform structural, thermal, and STOP (structural-thermal-optical performance) analysis to verify line-of-sight stability and wavefront error budgets.

  • Develop pointing error budgets covering base motion, jitter, thermal drift, and control-loop residuals, and flow them down to component requirements.

  • Design, select and qualify actuators, encoders, bearings, and flexures for ground and space environments.

  • Lead alignment, integration, and test of optical assemblies in the field.

  • Support acquisition and tracking field campaigns at ground station sites, including troubleshooting under real atmospheric conditions.

  • Work closely with software, electrical and network engineers to close the loop between lab-based mechanical design and to autonomous optical communications with space assets.

Required Qualifications

  • BSc or MS in Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

  • 3+ years of optomechanical design experience for precision optical systems (laser communications, telescopes, directed energy, or similar).

  • Proficiency with CAD (SolidWorks, NX, Creo, or similar) and FEA tools (ANSYS, Nastran, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience aligning and testing optical assemblies in a lab environment.

  • Working knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, and precision machining practices.

Preferred

  • Experience with fast-steering mirrors, gimbal design, or telescope pointing systems.

  • Familiarity with STOP analysis workflows and optical design tools (Zemax/OpticStudio, CODE V).

  • Experience qualifying hardware for launch and on-orbit environments (vibration, shock, thermal vacuum).

  • Field experience with optical ground stations or astronomical instrumentation.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

title: Project Manager
description:
About Lazo

Lazo is a B2B platform that handles the back office — tax, bookkeeping, legal, and payroll — for founders building companies with US entities. We're a fast-growing, fully remote team that combines expert services with technology to take operational complexity off founders' plates so they can focus on building.

We're building toward an AI-first operating model — where technology handles the repetitive work and our people focus on judgment, expertise, and clients. This PM role is central to making that shift real.

We're looking for a Project Manager to keep our cross-functional work moving.   • Document with rigor. Keep processes, decisions, and knowledge organized and easy to find.

title: Space Systems Optical Engineer
description:
Role

Support the development of Azora's space segment: the flight terminals and supporting avionics that carry our optical communications technology to orbit. You'll work hands-on across system architecture, requirements, and verification as part of a small hardware team.

Responsibilities

  • Own space segment architecture work across the optical terminal, avionics, structures, thermal, power, and interfaces to host spacecraft or bus.

  • Contribute to requirements development and flow-down from mission and link-budget level to subsystem and component specifications.

  • Own the design review cadence (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) and the verification and validation program, including environmental qualification (vibration, shock, TVAC, EMC, radiation).

  • Assist with technical interfaces to launch providers, bus manufacturers, and hosted payload partners, including ICD development.

  • Support risk management and parts/materials assurance activities (EEE parts, radiation lot testing) for the flight program.

  • Own assembly, integration, and test (AIT) campaigns and launch site operations; support on-orbit commissioning and anomaly resolution.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Aerospace, Electrical, Optical Engineering, Physics, or related field.

  • Hands-on experience with real flight hardware or flight-like hardware—through research, or industry. We're looking for demonstrated contact with actual systems (built it, tested it, broke it, fixed it).

  • Working knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals: requirements, budgets (mass, power, link, pointing), V&V planning.

  • Some exposure to environmental qualification or AIT (vibration, shock, TVAC, EMC).

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and take technical ownership of a problem.

Preferred

  • Experience with optical payloads, laser communication terminals, or precision pointing systems in space.

  • Familiarity with smallsat / NewSpace development models and hosted payload integration.

  • Knowledge of radiation effects and mitigation for electronics and optics.

  • Prior startup or small-team experience scaling engineering processes.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for test campaigns and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting careers@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: Mixed-Signal Engineer
description:
Role

Design the mixed-signal electronics that sit between Azora's photonic front ends and digital processing: high-speed ADC/DAC chains, amplifiers and driver circuits, precision bias and control loops, and the FPGA interfaces that tie them together. Your boards will fly in space terminals and run in ground station receivers, where every dB of implementation loss matters against a quantum-limited budget.

Responsibilities

  • Design schematic and PCB layouts for mixed-signal boards: high-speed data converters, transimpedance amplifiers, laser/modulator drivers, low-noise bias supplies, and clocking.

  • Perform signal integrity and power integrity analysis for multi-GHz analog paths and high-speed serial links (JESD204, SerDes).

  • Develop precision analog control loops: laser temperature/current control, photodiode bias, FSM drive electronics, and AGC chains.

  • Bring up, debug, and characterize boards in the lab; own noise, linearity, and bandwidth verification against link budget allocations.

  • Define and implement FPGA interfaces to data converters and control peripherals; collaborate on (or implement) RTL for data capture, calibration, and real-time control.

  • Design for reliability and environment: derating, worst-case analysis, and parts selection for space applications (rad-tolerant/rad-hard component trades).

  • Support EMC/EMI design and testing, and environmental qualification campaigns.

Required Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

  • 4+ years of mixed-signal hardware design experience, including high-speed PCB design (Altium, Cadence Allegro, or similar).

  • Strong analog fundamentals: noise analysis, op-amp and TIA design, PLLs/clocking, power supply design.

  • Hands-on lab experience with oscilloscopes, spectrum/network analyzers, and automated board characterization.

  • Experience interfacing data converters to FPGAs.

Preferred

  • FPGA development experience (VHDL/Verilog/SystemVerilog) on Xilinx/AMD or Intel platforms, including high-speed transceivers.

  • Experience with optical transceiver electronics, coherent receivers, or photon-counting detector readout (APD/SPAD/SNSPD bias and readout).

  • Familiarity with space-grade electronics design: radiation effects (TID, SEE), redundancy, and derating standards (ECSS or NASA EEE-INST-002).

  • Experience with low-jitter clock distribution and time-transfer systems.

Location

This is an onsite/hybrid role based in Tempe, AZ or the Bay Area, CA – hardware work that’s hard to do remotely. Some travel expected for field deployment and vendor/manufacturing visits.

Benefits:

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive healthcare (including options for vision and dental)

  • 401(k)

  • Unlimited PTO

EEO & Reasonable Accommodations

  • Azora is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

  • If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know by contacting info@azora.space

Export Control

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicants must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (iii) protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or (iv) be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Salary ranges are based on the following criteria:

  • Final salary is based on geographic location, experience, skills, and qualifications.

About this Company

Azora is building high-bandwidth communications infrastructure for environments where fiber can’t reach. This work spans LEO spacecraft constellations, lunar exploration missions, GEO satcom, deployable optical ground for defense, and data centers both on- and off-world. To enable rapid global proliferation Azora is developing compact and modular optical terminals small enough to deploy from a backpack, and space terminals that support high speed optical links from LEO out to the Moon.

title: QA & Compliance Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Responsible for quality management and compliance work for the company's data center products and solutions, establishing and improving the product quality management system to ensure that the entire process—from design, procurement, manufacturing, testing, to delivery—complies with company quality standards, customer requirements, and international regulatory certification requirements. Through quality risk management, supplier quality management, and continuous improvement, enhance product reliability and customer satisfaction, supporting the smooth delivery of global data center projects.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Product Quality Management & Continuous Improvement Responsible for establishing and optimizing the product quality management system and quality control processes, formulating product inspection standards and quality specifications, and supervising quality execution throughout design, procurement, production, testing, delivery, and on-site installation. Analyze quality data and customer feedback, identify quality risks, organize quality issue investigations, and drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA, and continuous improvement to constantly enhance product quality and reliability.

  2. Product Compliance & Certification Management Responsible for regulatory compliance and certification management of data center products, ensuring products comply with target market laws, regulations, and industry standards, including certification requirements such as CE, UL, FCC, RoHS, REACH, IEC, CB, and UKCA. Coordinate with third-party laboratories and certification bodies to complete product testing, certification applications, and maintenance work, continuously track changes in international regulations, and drive products to meet global market access requirements.

  3. Supplier Quality & Project Quality Support Responsible for supplier quality management, including supplier audits, quality evaluations, incoming quality control, and quality improvement, driving suppliers to implement corrective and preventive actions. Participate in New Product Introduction (NPI), product design reviews, and global data center project quality management, formulate project quality control plans, and support customer factory audits, quality audits, and project deliveries to ensure product quality meets customer requirements.

  4. Quality System Construction & Cross-Functional Collaboration Maintain the effective operation of quality management systems such as ISO 9001, draft and improve quality management documents, standards, and standard operating procedures, and organize internal quality audits and quality training. Collaborate closely with R&D, Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, Project, and After-Sales teams to drive the execution of quality standards, enhance full-lifecycle quality management capabilities, and establish quality KPIs and management mechanisms to support the company in continuously improving product quality and operational efficiency.

Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Management, or related majors.

  2. 3+ years of experience in product quality, quality management, quality systems, or product compliance, with industry experience in data centers, UPS, PDU, cabinets, batteries, liquid cooling, HVAC, network equipment, or electro-mechanical products preferred.

  3. Familiar with ISO 9001 quality management systems and quality tools such as FMEA, 8D, CAPA, RCA, SPC, PPAP, etc., with strong problem analysis and continuous improvement capabilities.

  4. Familiar with international product certification and regulatory requirements, including CE, UL, FCC, RoHS, REACH, IEC, etc., with experience in global product certification or market access preferred.

  5. Possess strong communication, coordination, and project execution skills, with the ability to collaborate efficiently with R&D, supply chain, manufacturing, project teams, and third-party certification bodies.

  6. Good command of English reading and writing, capable of supporting routine communication with overseas clients, suppliers, and certification bodies, with the ability to adapt to necessary domestic and international business travel.

title: BMS Software Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Responsible for the software integration of data center integrated monitoring and Building Management Systems (BMS), establishing data links between building infrastructure equipment (chillers, HVAC, power distribution, fire safety, access control, etc.) and upper-level control systems to ensure stable operation, visual monitoring, and automated control of data center infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for software integration and development between data center BMS and various subsystems (power distribution monitoring, chiller plant group control, UPS, generators, fire alarms, access control security, etc.), completing communication protocol integration and data point list configuration, including but not limited to industrial standard protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, OPC UA, and SNMP.

  2. Participate in control system logic programming and debugging, including PLC/DDC control programs, group control strategies, and linkage logic implementation and optimization, ensuring the reliability of collaborative equipment control.

  3. Responsible for developing and maintaining monitoring interfaces (SCADA/HMI) to achieve visual display of equipment status, alarms, energy consumption, and other data.

  4. Prepare and maintain interface documentation, point lists, and integration test plans, collaborating with third-party vendors to complete equipment integration and joint commissioning.

  5. Participate in on-site commissioning (FAT/SAT), system go-live, and troubleshooting, responding promptly to resolve software and hardware issues during integration.

  6. Continuously optimize system architecture and drive the implementation of intelligent data center operations functions (such as DCIM platform integration, energy efficiency management, and predictive maintenance).

  7. Support the operations team in handling online issues, ensuring 7x24 continuity and stability of critical systems.

Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or related majors, with 3+ years of software integration experience in industrial control systems or BMS; data center project experience is preferred.

  2. Familiar with at least one mainstream BMS/SCADA platform (such as Honeywell, Siemens Desigo, Schneider EcoStruxure, Johnson Controls Metasys, etc.).

  3. Familiar with industrial communication protocols, such as BACnet, Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, SNMP, MQTT, etc., with practical protocol integration and debugging experience.

  4. Proficient in programming languages such as C#, Python, Java, or C/C++, with the ability to independently complete interface development, data processing, and scripting.

  5. Understanding of data center infrastructure knowledge (HVAC, power distribution, UPS, chillers, etc.) and relevant standards and specifications.

  6. Strong on-site troubleshooting skills, capable of adapting to project site travel and joint commissioning work.

  7. Good communication and collaboration skills, able to work cross-functionally with equipment vendors, civil/electrical teams, and operations teams to advance projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience with Tier III/IV data center projects.

  2. Familiar with DCIM systems (such as Schneider EcoStruxure IT, Nlyte, etc.).

  3. Hold relevant industry certifications (such as BICSI, CDCP/CDCS).

You will be key to the success of Onera’s next generation sleep diagnostic service. We offer a great opportunity for professional growth in an ambitious and fast-growing scale-up. This role is open to candidates located in the Eastern Time Zone to ensure sufficient overlap with our Europe-based team.

About Onera Health
Onera Health is a leader in transforming sleep medicine and remote monitoring. Their breakthrough diagnostic solutions and services are poised to help millions of people struggling with sleep-related ailments, while also impacting other medical fields by monitoring a variety of chronic conditions, ultimately improving the health and quality of life for patients around the world. The company’s innovative solutions provide comprehensive sleep test data to physicians in a variety of clinical and non-clinical environments to optimise patient care and reduce healthcare costs.

What you will do:

Operate our cloud based application used by (Healthcare Provider) customers:

  • Operate cloud based product

    • Operate and maintain AWS infrastructure supporting our AWS-based platform used by healthcare providers

    • Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of our production environments

  • Deployment Support: Support the EU based engineering team in deploying code to US production environments.

  • Inform Product Development: Provide input and requirements to development team on backup, disaster recovery security, monitoring, operations, release and deployment best practices.

  • Incident Response: Participate in incident response and root cause analysis for system outages. Act as the primary technical point of contact for US-based infrastructure alerts and security incidents.

  • Documentation: Maintain detailed system documentation and operational runbooks and playbooks. Contribute to definition of procedures, policies and work instructions.

  • Application technical support: Investigate and troubleshoot cloud based application issues and ensuring timely resolution for customers .

  • Compliance Certification: Help define and shape the procedures, policies and work instructions required for achieving SOC2 and FedRamp certifications. Lead the technical preparation and evidence collection for first time and annual SOC2 audits and FedRAMP authorization packages.

  • Compliance Maintenance: Ensure the US cloud infrastructure remains in a "continuously compliant" state, managing the automated patching and configuration hardening required for HIPAA, SOC2, and FedRAMP.

Manage general IT systems used by our US based team:

  • Systems Access Management: Manage IT systems and providing/revoking access to employees (e.g., EntraID).

  • Device & Asset Management: Procure, configure, and manage all US-based company hardware, including laptops and mobile devices, using the Mobile Device Management (MDM) solution of Microsoft Intune.

  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Implement and regularly test data backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure business continuity and data integrity in case of a system failure or cyberattack.

  • System Monitoring: Monitor systems performance, uptime and security applying patches, updates and security fixes when needed.

  • User & Helpdesk Support: Act as the first line of support for all US employees, resolving issues with hardware (laptops, printers, mobile devices), software (Microsoft 365, Office365, specialised applications), and network connectivity. Register, monitor, and resolve tickets in Jira Service Management.

  • Documentation: Meticulously document IT procedures and keep IT records in line with our procedures. Create and update user guides and training materials.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field

  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS SysOps Administrator Certification, AWS Security certification, ITIL ) are a plus.

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in cloud and IT system management, with at least 3 years in a healthcare setting.

  • You have a good understanding and know-how of AWS services (e.g. Lambda, API Gateway, IoT Core, DynamoDB, S3, Batch, EC2, SageMaker, etc) having worked with at least a subset of these

  • You have hands on experience using AWS security, compliance and monitoring services (AWS WAF, Config, GuardDuty, CloudWatch, Cloud Trail)

  • Proficiency with server administration, virtualisation technologies, and IT security

  • Proven experience working within HIPAA, SOC2 and HITECH frameworks.

  • Deep familiarity with NIST 800-53 (FedRAMP) and Trust Services Criteria (SOC2).

  • Hands-on experience maintaining systems under SOC2 Type II and FedRAMP (NIST 800-53) frameworks.

  • Proficiency in Linux/Windows Admin, Docker, and Scripting (Python/Bash/Typescript)

  • Excellent problem-solving skills , communication and organisational skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken)

  • May require occasional evening or weekend work for system maintenance or emergency support.
